knowing-god.label: Knowing God

prayer.label: Prayer

faith.label: Faith

holy-spirit.label: The Holy Spirit
holy-spirit.definition: Life in the Spirit; power, anointing, and guidance.

obedience.label: Obedience
obedience.definition: Acting on instruction; submission to God's commands.

holiness.label: Holiness and Purity
holiness.definition: Sin, conscience, sanctification, and clean living.

destiny.label: Purpose and Destiny
destiny.definition: Calling, uniqueness, and the shape of a life.

perseverance.label: Perseverance and Warfare
perseverance.definition: Adversity, opposition, endurance, and standing firm.

diligence.label: Diligence and Excellence
diligence.definition: Work, discipline, attitude, preparation, and results.

provision.label: Provision and Prosperity

waiting.definition: Readings for the gap between the promise and its arrival — delay, patience, and holding on when nothing has changed yet.

opposition.label: When you are under attack
opposition.definition: Readings for seasons of resistance: hostility, spiritual conflict, and the temptation to withdraw when the battle line is drawn.

hardship.label: When life is hard
hardship.definition: Readings for difficulty itself — trials, loss, and the question of what God is doing when circumstances are against you.

entries.title: You Are at Your Best When You Are in the Spirit!
entries.summary: The believer’s habitat is the Holy Spirit just as water is to fish, hole is to foxes and nest is to birds. Therefore, as a child of God, YOU ARE AT YOUR BEST WHEN YOU ARE IN THE SPIRIT.
entries.key_scripture_text: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is dissipation; but be filled with the Spirit

blocks.text: The believer’s habitat is the Holy Spirit just as water is to fish, hole is to foxes and nest is to birds. Therefore, as a child of God, YOU ARE AT YOUR BEST WHEN YOU ARE IN THE SPIRIT. However, to be spirit full, you must be prayerful and addicted to fasting.

Prayer and fasting connects us to the Holy Spirit and the Holy Spirit release the power to perform - Philippians 1:19 For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,.’ When you are filled up with the Spirit, you are filled up with so much power and no man can withstand you – Isaiah 59:19 So shall they fear The name of the LORD from the west, And His glory from the rising of the sun; When the enemy comes in like a flood, The Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.

From today, get into prayer and fasting so as to access the fullness of His power. To be prayerless is to be powerless and fireless. Empty your stomach by waiting on God in fasting to fill tour spirit. Afflict your body to fatten your spirit man. As you sow to your spirit, you will reap power and glory.
As a serious Christian , let prayer and fasting be your obsession. YOU SHALL SEE THE GOODNESS OF THE LORD IN THE LAND OF THE LIVING IN JESUS NAME!

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to always seek Your face in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am full of the Spirit!

entries.title: You Must Spend Quality Time in God’s Presence
entries.summary: Beloved, you must do everything possible to walk in the power of God. This is because, the only language the devil and his cohorts understand is power. However, no one can gain access to a thing from a man unless he first gains access to his person.
entries.key_scripture_text: 1 O God, You are my God; Early will I seek You; My soul thirsts for You; My flesh longs for You In a dry and thirsty land Where there is no water. 8 My soul follows close behind You; Your right hand upholds me.

blocks.text: Beloved, you must do everything possible to walk in the power of God. This is because, the only language the devil and his cohorts understand is power. However, no one can gain access to a thing from a man unless he first gains access to his person.

Therefore, to access the power of God you must know the God of the power. It is the custodian of a treasure that determines the measure you can access. Know him little and you will have access to little of His power; know him much and you will have access to much of His power. Dan. 11:32.

In order for you to know, you must spend much time with Him. Qualitative time in the Presence of God produces quantitative power. It is only those who seek His face that can move his hand. II Chr. 7:11, 12. Do not just seek His power, seek his face; His power flows where His face shows. Ps. 63:1, 8, 105:4.
It is the longing of your soul for Him that commands the flow of His power. Until you have power with God you cannot draw power from God. Gen. 32:28; 33:4.
Knowledge of God is the fountain of power. Fullness of God brings about fullness of power (grace) that results in fullness of blessings. John 1:16, Is.44:3, II Cor.9:8.

Men will unconditionally become eager to meet and help you when you have met with God. Gen. 33:4. When you long to see the face of God, men will also long to see your face. From today, pursue God like a predator pursues its prey and by so doing you will be connecting to the greatest and the most authentic source of power in the entire universe.

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to know you more in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: God is my obsession!

entries.title: Loving God
entries.summary: This generation really need people who genuinely love God with all their hearts. We don’t just need Church members; we need God lovers. We don’t just need Men of God; we need lovers of God.
entries.key_scripture_text: But as it is written: Eye has not seen, nor ear heard, Nor have entered into the heart of man The things which God has prepared for those who love Him.

blocks.text: This generation really need people who genuinely love God with all their hearts. We don’t just need Church members; we need God lovers. We don’t just need Men of God; we need lovers of God.

Church members and Men of God are not scarce to find but lovers of God are few and not easy to come by. When God is looking for a man to enthrone and promote, he always looks for a person with a heart for Him. That is why, when God wanted a king to replace King Saul, he settled on David a man after His heart – Ac 13:22 And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

Love for God will give you exclusive access to God and His secrets- I Corinthians 2:9. Your passion for God will determine your portion from God. Your passion for God will determine your place with God. Your passion moves the might and strength of God in your direction - 2Ch 16:9 For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him.

Without a heart for God, you can never make a mark on earth. Therefore, in this New Year, always cry for the love of God to be released into your heart by the Holy Spirit (Rom. 5:5). Let nothing separate you from the love of God; simply value God above all else. You will surely see what no eyes have seen and hear what no ears have heard when you become a lover of God!

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a heart for You in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never stop loving God!

entries.title: Your Point of Uniqueness
entries.summary: In life, you must understand that although you don’t have everything, you definitely have something. In fact, there is something within you that the world cannot do without.
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise

blocks.text: In life, you must understand that although you don’t have everything, you definitely have something. In fact, there is something within you that the world cannot do without. You are not like others and others are not like you; you are gloriously unique and hence there is no basis for comparison. There are many people who always want to compare their lives with those of others. This makes them to eventually lose grip of what they have and the resultant effect is inferiority complex.

What makes you unique is inside you – dig it out. Your greatness will not come from outside but from within. The poor widow’s children nearly lost his two sons to the creditors because he underestimated the bottle of oil that was in her house (II Kings 4). It was the rod in the hands of Moses that God used to do wonders in the land of Egypt. THIS MEANS THAT WHAT IS IN YOUR HOUSE OR HANDS CAN CREATE THE WONDERS YOU DESIRE!

Focus on what you have, build around it and make the most of it. In the process, you will suddenly discover that you have no basis for comparison with others. You may not have what others have but you possess within you what make you!
In 2023, look upward for divine help and look inward for what you can do! It is a sign of foolishness to be comparing your life with other unique destinies!

entries.prayer: O Lord, open my eyes to what You have placed within me in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am gifted and I will surely be lifted!

entries.title: The Best Is Yet to Come
entries.summary: As a child of God, the best of life must always answer to your destiny. Eternal life connects you to the best of Heaven. However, one of the modes of operation of the devil is to set a limit on your destiny.
entries.key_scripture_text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over.

blocks.text: As a child of God, the best of life must always answer to your destiny. Eternal life connects you to the best of Heaven. However, one of the modes of operation of the devil is to set a limit on your destiny. The devil sometimes says, “You have gotten to your peak, this is the best you can be; you can’t go any further. But hear the Word of the Lord today, “God is about to bless you beyond limits” A limit is the highest point, degree or boundary especially one that cannot or should not be passed or exceeded. A limit is also a feature or circumstance that restricts what can be done. There are certain restrictions in every family. They include financial restrictions (you can’t exceed a million, you can’t build etc.), age restrictions (you can’t exceed the age of 40), marital restrictions (you can’t marry until you have given birth to one child), academic restrictions (you can’t get to the university). In spite of the restrictions; God is giving you a new name; you will surely achieve what has never been achieved in your family or country in Jesus Name!

When John the Baptist was born, his family members wanted to restrict his destiny by giving him a family name although Heaven had a special assignment and name for his life. His mother however vehemently opposed that decision. Luke 1:59-63 says, “59 So it was, on the eighth day, that they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him by the name of his father, Zacharias 60 His mother answered and said, “No; he shall be called John. ” 61 But they said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.” 62 So they made signs to his father- -what he would have him called. 63 And he asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, saying, “His name is John.” So they all marvelled.”

God really wants to give you everything you need with “plenty left over” but we have to do it HIS WAY” Deuteronomy 28:11,13, “11 “And the LORD will grant you plenty of goods, in the fruit of your body, in the increase of your livestock, and in the produce of your ground, in the land of which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you. 13 “And the LORD will make you the head and not the tail; you shall be above only, and not be beneath, if you heed the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today, and are careful to observe them.
Walk in obedience and you will begin to experience your convenience. Always declare confidently over your life, the best is yet to come!

entries.prayer: O Lord, remove any demonic restriction from my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: The best of Heaven is my portion!

entries.title: You Must Stretch Out to Spread Out — Part 1
entries.summary: Life without a bearing is a burden. You must have a burning desire if you really want to achieve something worthwhile with your life.
entries.key_scripture_text: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am till it is accomplished

blocks.text: Life without a bearing is a burden. You must have a burning desire if you really want to achieve something worthwhile with your life.

In life, only goal setters will ever become goal getters. Your goals determine where you reach in life. What you set before your eyes is what you will get with your hands. If you stand for nothing; you will fall for anything.

Goals motivate you; stretches you; releases your potential and compels action. Luke 12:50. A man without a goal will end as a goat. A goat is an animal without aim, objective and purpose and as a result is vulnerable to all kinds of danger and assault. There is no animal that suffers assault more than a goat. In the same way, there is no man that suffers assault like a goal-less man. To be goal-less is to guideless and to be guideless is to run into trouble without knowing. If you lack clear guidance, you will lack defense.

One must therefore always keep defining and redefining his goals in the journey of life. The more you re-define your goal, the clearer, sharper, brighter and finer it becomes. Re-defining your goal brings it closer to your eyes and your heart.
If you don’t make clear definitions, you will suffer many deviations and with deviations begins the journey of detention, devastation, destruction and frustration.
From today , re-define your goal in life if you desire to experience a change of level.

entries.prayer: O Lord, wherever I am out of your will for my life, re-direct my steps in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never be diverted from my God-given destiny!

entries.title: You Must Stretch Out to Spread Out — Part 2
entries.summary: Don’t give up! You are advancing and exceling no matter what in Jesus Name! Yesterday, we learnt about the importance of goals in a man’s life. Today, we want to learn about the process of setting and re-defining your goals.
entries.key_scripture_text: Then the LORD answered me and said: “Write the vision And make it plain on tablets, That he may run who reads it.

blocks.text: Don’t give up! You are advancing and exceling no matter what in Jesus Name! Yesterday, we learnt about the importance of goals in a man’s life. Today, we want to learn about the process of setting and re-defining your goals.
The goal setting process includes;
1. Decide exactly what you want in a specific area of your life.
(Spiritual Goals, Academic Goals, Career goals, Financial Goals, Health Goals, Marriage Goals).
2. Write it down. Habakkuk 2:1-2
A goal that is not in writing is not in writing is merely a wish or fantasy
3. Set a deadline for your goal. Habakkuk 2:3-4, Eccl. 3:1-2
A goal without a deadline has no urgency. We have Immediate goals (within 1 year), short-term goals ( 1-3 years), long-term goals (4-10 years).
4. Identify the obstacles that you would have to overcome in order to
achieve your goals .
Internal or personal obstacles: Laziness, too much leisure (TV etc.), dislike for certain subjects etc.
External obstacles: Wrong associations – Psalm 119:163
5. Make a list of everything you have to do in order to achieve your goals
and organize the list into a comprehensive plan. Prov. 16:1-3; Prov. 16:9
6. Take action on your plan immediately. An average plan vigorously
executed is far better than a brilliant plan on which nothing is done. Eph. 5:16, Col. 4:5
7. Decide to do something every day that will move you towards the
achievement of your goals.
You must be self-disciplined. You must submit yourself under rules if you want to be a ruler. There are two kinds of pain: the Pain of Discipline & the Pain of Regrets.
8. Depend on God’s Grace. GRACE= (G) God in the Race. When you have
God in the race of your life; you will eventually emerge as a winner. I Cor. 15:10

entries.prayer: O Lord, inject into me the spirit of self-discipline in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will not miss my crown of glory!

entries.title: Think About the Effect of Your Actions
entries.summary: One of the things you must always guard is your conscience. There are people who simply don’t have conscience - 1Ti 4:2 Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron; . Such people act carelessly and are heartless.
entries.key_scripture_text: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.

blocks.text: One of the things you must always guard is your conscience. There are people who simply don’t have conscience - 1Ti 4:2 Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron; . Such people act carelessly and are heartless. They also don’t think about the effect of their speech and deeds on other people.

We need people of integrity in our world today; people whose yes is their yes and their no is their no. The world openly and hypocritically speaks against men of integrity but they admire the virtues and seek such men to work for them. Even thieves want to employ honest men and engage them as staff.

A man of integrity bother less about the praise and applause of men. He focuses on his unseen friend who lives in his inner most being – His Conscience. He seeks to maintain inner peace with himself. That is the most valuable thing to him than any other thing or position he may be given by any man on earth.

From today, decide to have a conscience void of offence toward God and men. Do not follow the crowd to do evil. Follow your inner compass that points in the same direction not minding the fashion or trend in the society! Maintain your integrity no matter what. What you do today is a seed; what you experience tomorrow is your harvest. Think about the effect of your actions.

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to have a clear conscience in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will not follow the crowd to do evil!

entries.title: How to Access Heaven’s Blessings
entries.summary: The Almighty God has a lot in store for His children. However, prompt and consistent obedience to His commands is what gives us access to Heaven’s blessings.
entries.key_scripture_text: If they obey and serve Him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures

blocks.text: The Almighty God has a lot in store for His children. However, prompt and consistent obedience to His commands is what gives us access to Heaven’s blessings. In order for you to access your inheritance in Christ, you must develop a quality walk with God. Our walk with God is however made possible by continuous obedience to God’s commandments (Deut. 28:1-14). Abraham practically walked with God by his lifestyle of obedience to God. He promptly obeyed God when he was told to move out of his father’s house, he obeyed God and circumcised the men in his entire household and when God asked him for Isaac, he didn’t hesitate at all.

You cannot walk with God unless you please Him and obedience is the only way to please Him. But obedience is made easy by a deep affection for God. So love Him to obey Him to please Him and to ultimately enter into a quality walk with Him.

From today, may obedience to His instructions be your daily delight. Whatever He tells you to do, DO IT! Don’t succumb to the spirit of disobedience operating in our world today. As you constantly follow God’s instructions in every area of your life, you will continuously access His blessings.

entries.prayer: O Lord, destroy any trace of the spirit of disobedience from my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am always obedient to His commands!

entries.title: The Spirit of the Overcomer
entries.summary: There is no war-free zone in life. If there is nothing to overcome how can we become overcomers and eventually emerge as more than conquerors. There is a race to run and a battle to be fought once you become a Christian.
entries.key_scripture_text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

blocks.text: There is no war-free zone in life. If there is nothing to overcome how can we become overcomers and eventually emerge as more than conquerors. There is a race to run and a battle to be fought once you become a Christian. The devil who walks about as a roaring line seeking someone to devour will try to put you down and cause you to stay down. You must however get up and run again! Proverbs 24:16 says, ‘For a righteous man may fall seven times And rise again, But the wicked shall fall by calamity.’
Victory belongs to those who keep looking at the goal, not the going; not the process but the prize, not the trial but the treasure that’s promised to those who persevere!

A two-fold theme of Christianity is RISING AGAIN AND GETTING BACK INTO THE RACE! But you can’t win if you don’t run and risk falling. No matter what caused you to fall, the word for you today is, TAKE GOD’S HAND, GET UP & RUN! In the mighty Name of Jesus, I declare over you that you will fight the good fight, you shall finish your course and you shall keep the faith! The Spirit of the overcomer is upon you.

entries.prayer: O Lord, fortify me with the spirit of endurance in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am winning again!

entries.title: You Must Always Be in Touch with Heaven
entries.summary: Those who are in touch with Heaven are empowered to change their world. As a child of God, don’t just pray; learn to listen for His voice. Have you ever wondered why Jesus never made a single misstep?
entries.key_scripture_text: I can of Myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and My judgment is righteous, because I do not seek My own will but the will of the Father who sent Me.

blocks.text: Those who are in touch with Heaven are empowered to change their world. As a child of God, don’t just pray; learn to listen for His voice. Have you ever wondered why Jesus never made a single misstep? He tells us the secret in John 5:19-20, ‘“Most assuredly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of Himself, but what He sees the Father do; for whatever He does, the Son also does in like manner. 20 “For the Father loves the Son, and shows Him all things that He Himself does; and He will show Him greater works than these, that you may marvel.’

The voice you hear will determine the choice you will make. Jesus often prayed all-night, yet few of His prayers are recorded. Why? Because He didn’t just talk to His Father, He took time to listen and get instructions. Prayer and listening to God were as natural to Him as breathing; it was the spiritual oxygen he thrived on. When the Bible says pray without ceasing (I Thess. 5:17), it means we are to stay in touch with God at all times, to be spiritually sensitive and attuned to the still small voice of His Spirit within us. That calls for having an uncluttered mind and heart.

Thank God for the understanding of who we are in Christ, and our authority as believers. But there is more to prayer than coming boldly unto the throne of Grace (Heb. 4:16) with what we want. We must also listen to what God wants for our lives. Now since God designed the plan for your life, don’t you think it is wise to be quiet before Him, so He can tell you about it?
Don’t just pray, listen for His voice!

entries.prayer: O Lord, open my ears to hear your voice in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am always in touch with Heaven!

entries.title: You Must Always Act on His Instructions
entries.summary: Most modern day Christians are revelation rich and application poor. Whenever you pray, you must first listen to the voice of God and after that act on the instructions you received.
entries.key_scripture_text: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word

blocks.text: Most modern day Christians are revelation rich and application poor. Whenever you pray, you must first listen to the voice of God and after that act on the instructions you received. Don’t just pray and fold your arms, start taking the right steps that will take you to your next level. Intimidation narrows down destiny. Fear hinders people from faring well. Fear is what makes people get unfair treatment. It takes bravery to be out of slavery, only the daring will become the darling of all around them. The Bible calls the Christian a lion and an eagle. These two creatures are bold and fearless. Proverbs 28:1 says, “The righteous are as bold as the lion...” Boldness will naturally result into step taking which brings a man out of mediocrity and limitation. Bravery will make you step ahead in the place where others are wondering what will happen. Don’t be a prisoner of your past. What you have in your hand today is more important than what you have lost. Stop looking at where you have been and start looking at where you can be. Life’s only limitations are what you set on yourself!

Start moving and begin acting now! When you move, God will also move. Heaven acts after man has acted (Matt. 18:18). A ship in the port is safe but that is not what a ship was built for. Don’t be afraid to take action! While others are wondering you are generating wonders, while they are asking questions you are making exclamations! God has not given you the spirit of fear but of love, of power and of a sound mind (II Tim. 1:7). Always ask for the spirit of boldness. When the disciples were being intimidated, they asked God to grant them boldness. You can do the same thing today.
Don’t just pray; take action! From today, be determined to act on every divine instruction.

entries.prayer: O Lord, grant me holy boldness to take the right steps this year in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always act on divine instructions!

entries.title: The Way of Purity
entries.summary: The most authentic source of spiritual authority is purity. Sin is a destroyer, a blocker and a sinker. It blocks the ears of God and shortens the hands of God. Reuben and Samson due to sexual immorality missed their greatness.
entries.key_scripture_text: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

blocks.text: The most authentic source of spiritual authority is purity. Sin is a destroyer, a blocker and a sinker. It blocks the ears of God and shortens the hands of God. Reuben and Samson due to sexual immorality missed their greatness.

Sin will bring you low - Ps 106:43 Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity. However, righteousness will take you up - Pr 14:34 ¶ Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

Never allow sin to contaminate your destiny. You must learn to deal with sin the right way by confessing and forsaking it - Pr 28:13 ¶ He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy. At that point, you must believe that the Blood of Jesus Christ has cleansed you from all sins; then get up and go on with God; don’t wallow in self- condemnation.

If there is something rotten in your refrigerator, you know it every time you open the door. You may not know exactly where it is located, but the smell tells you it’s in there. Our lives are like that. If there is something wrong within us, those we come into contact with are going to sense it, whether or not they know where it is or what it is. It gives off an odour that is detectable. That’s why we must continually open ourselves to God and allow the Holy Spirit to come in, cleanse our hearts and remove whatever and remove whatever is hindering us in our walk with Him. From today there will be no more contamination in your life in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, by Your mercies, let the Blood of Jesus cleanse me from all sins in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: Purity is my way of life!

entries.title: Your Attitude Is Important to Your Success — Part 1
entries.summary: In life, you have no control over the actions of others but you have absolute control over your reactions. Your attitude is so important to your success in life. Every day, you choose the clothes you wear, the food you eat, and the attitude to adopt.
entries.key_scripture_text: Finally, brethren, whatever things are true, whatever things are noble, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report, if there is any virtue and if there is anything praiseworthy--meditate on these things.

blocks.text: In life, you have no control over the actions of others but you have absolute control over your reactions. Your attitude is so important to your success in life. Every day, you choose the clothes you wear, the food you eat, and the attitude to adopt. And there are only two kinds of attitudes; the good or right ones and the wrong or bad ones. The right attitude is the optimistic one the Psalmist adopted when he woke up each morning; ‘This is the day that the Lord has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it – Psalm 118:24.

Your ability to succeed in life often comes down to a single choice: how you react to what has been done to you in the past, or is being done to you right now. Dr. Viktor Frankl endured the Holocaust by this principle. The Nazis killed his family, placed him in a concentration camp, starved and beat him. When the war ended, Frankl was neither broken, bowed nor bitter. When asked how he endured such treatment with a positive outlook, he said, ‘EVERYTHING CAN BE TAKEN FROM A MAN BUT ONE THING: THE LAST OF HUMAN FREEDOMS, TO CHOOSE ONE’S ATTITUDE IN A GIVEN SET OF CIRCUMSTANCES, TO CHOOSE ONE’S WAY.’
From today, no matter what happens at any time, just declare, ‘IT IS WELL WITH MY SOUL.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me inner strength to stand no matter what comes my way in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: It is well with my soul!

entries.title: Your Attitude Is Important to Your Success — Part 2
entries.summary: Your attitude is your attraction. It is the magnet that attracts or repels the right people into your life. Ruth was a servant, her humble attitude got the attention of Boaz.
entries.key_scripture_text: 39 And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

blocks.text: Your attitude is your attraction. It is the magnet that attracts or repels the right people into your life. Ruth was a servant, her humble attitude got the attention of Boaz. Your attitude determines what comes towards you or moves away of you - Ruth 3:1-5, 9-11
Your attitude can make your life a living hell or a wonderful Heaven on earth

Two thieves were hanging with Jesus Christ ..... One went to Heaven and one went to hell. The major determinant was attitude. One had a sober and right attitude but the other had a harsh and bad attitude - Luke 23:39-43, ‘39 And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us. 40 But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation? 41 And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss. 42 And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom. 43 And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

Your attitude can decide the entrance or exit of a miracle in your life Your attitude is affecting every relationship in your life. The woman with the issue of blood had an attitude of expectancy and she received a notable miracle. She refused to give up even after spending all she had on the best doctors - Mark 5:24-29.
Your attitude is more powerful than your gifts and talents.

Many gifted and talented people never taste the fruits of their labour because their attitudes make them undesirable to be near - Eg. Samson. May God give you a new heart and a new spirit in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, by Your Spirit, create in me a clean heart in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I operate with a positive attitude!

entries.title: You Must Believe to Understand
entries.summary: In the journey of Christianity,you must believe, then later on you will understand. There are things going on in your life today that you don’t understand.
entries.key_scripture_text: But now, O LORD, You are our Father; We are the clay, and You our potter; And all we are the work of Your hand.

blocks.text: In the journey of Christianity,you must believe, then later on you will understand. There are things going on in your life today that you don’t understand. You may be asking, ‘Why am I going through all these storms and challenges?’ Today God wants to give you an answer. Your life is like a clay in the hands of the Potter (God). He wants to make something beautiful out of your destiny but the process of doing so is painful and difficult.

Imagine a beautiful China tea cup saying: ‘I wasn’t always like this’. There was a time when I was just a cold, hard lump of clay. One day the potter picked me up and said, ‘I could do something with this.’ Then he started to put pressure on me and change my shape. I said, ‘What are you doing.? That hurts. Stop! But he said, ‘Not yet.’ Then he put me on a wheel and began to spin me around and around until I shouted, ‘Let me off.’ He replied again, ‘Not yet.’ Then he shaped me into a cup and put me in a hot oven. I cried, ‘Let me out of here, I am suffocating.’ But he looked at me and said, ‘Not yet.’ When he took me out, I thought his work was over, but then he started to paint me. I couldn’t believe what he would do next. He put me back into the oven, and I said, I can’t stand this anymore, please let me out, please let me out! But he said once again, ‘Not yet.’ Finally, he took me out of the oven and set me on a shelf where I thought he has forgotten me. Then one day, he took me off the shelf and held me up in the mirror. I couldn’t believe my eyes. I had become a beautiful teacup that everyone wants to buy.

Yes, all things are working together for your good because you are in the hands of the Potter (God). When you finally get to the place God wants you to be, you will realize that He has been making you into a vessel He can use, bless and use to bless others! So allow God to shape you. From today, when you don’t understand what you are going through, trust His Process.

entries.prayer: O Lord, shape me into a vessel of glory in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: My life is in the Hands of God!

entries.title: Never Stop Going to Church
entries.summary: This year, you must decide to always be present in Church whenever there is a meeting. You must say like David, ‘I was glad when they said unto me, let us go into the House of the Lord- Psalm 122:1.
entries.key_scripture_text: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, to an innumerable company of angels

blocks.text: This year, you must decide to always be present in Church whenever there is a meeting. You must say like David, ‘I was glad when they said unto me, let us go into the House of the Lord- Psalm 122:1. Another name for the Church is Zion, a place where God strengthens and helps His children.
What’s your reason for not going to Church? Before you answer, read 9 reasons why I never wash!
I was forced to wash as a child
People who wash are all hypocrites; they think they are cleaner
than everyone else
There are so many different kinds of soap; I just can’t decide
which one is best for me.

I only wash on special occasions like Christmas and Easter
None of my friends wash
I will start washing when I get older and dirtier
8. I don’t have time to wash.

There are truths taught in God’s House that you won’t hear anywhere else. There you will find a spiritual family to belong to, a faith to live by and a focus that gets your eyes where they should be; on Christ. From today, may you never forsake the assembling of the saints. The best place to always be is the Church!

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to always love Your House in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I love the House of God!

entries.title: How to Produce Great Results
entries.summary: The easiest way to multiply your results is to walk with God. Walking with the invisible is what produces visible results. Every Christian must work for God in his or her life- time. However, to effectively work for God, you must first walk with God.
entries.key_scripture_text: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am Almighty God; walk before Me and be blameless. 2 “And I will make My covenant between Me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.

blocks.text: The easiest way to multiply your results is to walk with God. Walking with the invisible is what produces visible results. Every Christian must work for God in his or her life- time. However, to effectively work for God, you must first walk with God. Walking with God is what makes working for God an adventure. It is frustrating working for God without walking with Him. It is the invisible that originate the visible. The early Church walked with God and they effortlessly produced great results everywhere they went to. Mark 16: 20 says, ‘And they went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word through the accompanying signs. Amen.’

Those who walk with the invisible God don’t ever get intimidated by the visible. The forces of barrenness and stagnation can’t stand a person who has developed an effective walk with God. This is because when you are walking with God, whatever cannot stand God, cannot stand you. In spite of the devil and his cohorts you will still produce results.

When God appeared to Abram, He told him to faithfully walk with Him. He added that at the end of the day, He will multiply Abram exceedingly. Beloved, you cannot produce results without God. John 15:5 says, “I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing.’
From today, WALK WITH GOD AND HE WILL WORK FOR YOU!

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to faithfully walk with You in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am walking with God, I will do exploits!

entries.title: Be Hungry for the Right Knowledge
entries.summary: Are you opened to new ideas? Are you ready to receive other people’s thoughts and ideas? Do you listen more than you talk? Are you willing to change your opinion based on new information? Do you readily admit when you are wrong?
entries.key_scripture_text: A wise man will hear and increase learning, And a man of understanding will attain wise counsel

blocks.text: Are you opened to new ideas? Are you ready to receive other people’s thoughts and ideas? Do you listen more than you talk? Are you willing to change your opinion based on new information? Do you readily admit when you are wrong? Do you read impactful books and listen to anointed tapes? Do you think and observe before acting on a situation? Do you ask questions concerning things you are ignorant of? Are you opened to doing things in a way you haven’t done them before? Do you act defensively when criticized, or do you listen openly for the truth? Are you willing to ask for directions?
The Bible says, ‘The way of a fool seems right to him, but a wise man listens to advice (Prov. 12:15).

In this second half of the year, you must be opened to new things. The definition for mediocrity is doing things in the same old way. This is because anything you are doing now can be accomplished in a better and faster way. Most of the things we know, we learned from someone else, including the stuff we claim credit for! It may be new to us but it is not new.

Thomas Edison, the renowned scientist was a life-long learner. He had over 1000 patents to his credit. He stayed open, hungry for knowledge and teachable and to succeed, you must too. Knowledge is scattered here and there. You must therefore be an avid and a life-long learner to make the most of your destiny. This year invest in good books and be hungry for knowledge. A wise man must always hear and increase in learning – Prov. 1:5.

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a teachable spirit in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am hungry for the right knowledge!

entries.title: Prayer Works Wonders — Part 1
entries.summary: There are many prayerless Christians around today. They know the power and importance of prayer but they never pray. Prayerlessness is the greatest sickness of the contemporary Church. We schedule everything except our prayer time.
entries.key_scripture_text: He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him and honor him.

blocks.text: There are many prayerless Christians around today. They know the power and importance of prayer but they never pray. Prayerlessness is the greatest sickness of the contemporary Church. We schedule everything except our prayer time. Saying we believe in prayers is not the same as praying.
James writes:, ‘You do not have because you do not ask’ –James 4:3.

A night club opened on a Main Street and a Church was only hundred yards away. The said Church organized a 24-hour prayer vigil. They asked God to burn the club down. Within a week, lightning struck and it burned to the ground. The owner sued the Church, which denied responsibility. After hearing the arguments from both sides, the judge said, ‘It seems that wherever the guilt may lie, the night club owner believes in prayer, while the Church doesn’t. What a shock!

You must believe in prayers. God is waiting for us to make requests of Him in prayer. He never gets tired of us coming to Him. He is able, willing and ready to act on our behalf, but only if we pray. We must take time to ask God for what we want and need. Sometimes, we process situations in our minds, or talk about them with our friends, or wish or hope but we don’t pray. Wishing, hoping and talking to others is not prayer. When we have a need or a situation that concerns us, we are only raying when we talk to God about it. GOD NEVER GETS TIRED OF YOU, THEREFORE NEVER STOP PRAYING! Prayer works wonders.

entries.prayer: O Lord, baptize me with a fresh spirit of prayer in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I believe in the power of prayer!

entries.title: Prayer Works Wonders — Part 2
entries.summary: No matter the challenge you face this year, take it to God in prayer. Our heavenly Father’s ears are always opened to hear the cry of His children on earth. However, nothing sustains intercession like revelation. Hos.14:2.
entries.key_scripture_text: Take words with you, And return to the LORD. Say to Him, “Take away all iniquity; Receive us graciously, For we will offer the sacrifices of our lips.

blocks.text: No matter the challenge you face this year, take it to God in prayer. Our heavenly Father’s ears are always opened to hear the cry of His children on earth. However, nothing sustains intercession like revelation. Hos.14:2. Word content is what supplies us with strength in prayer. Word content also sustains length of prayer – you never get tired praying the word. Angels come for our words not our noise or cry in prayer . Dan.10:12, ‘Then he said to me, “Do not fear, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard; and I have come because of your words.’ When you speak the Word in prayer, angels will pick for God to fix.

God’s word is wood that we cast into prayer fire so as to sustain its burning. Mic.6:9; 7:14; Hag.1:8; Lev.6:12 -13. Just as fire comes up with new wood cast into it so also is prayer with the injection of fresh revelation.
Men of the word are never prayer wearied. Efficiency in prayer is a function of effectiveness in the use of scriptures. The skilful application of scriptures is what makes prayer useful.
Our cry will at best attract attention and sympathy; it is our words that obtains result.
The word enriches our prayer time.
What God responded to was prayer of Hezekiah not His cry. Is.38:1- 5. Right now, rise up, take the Word and bombard Heaven with your prayer arrows.
Proverbs 28:9, ‘He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination’. In this second half of the year, always pray on the basis of God’s Word.

entries.prayer: O Lord, make me a Word-addict this year in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: My prayer will produce wonders!

entries.title: Prayer Works Wonders — Part 3
entries.summary: If there is a man to pray, then there is surely a God to answer! He is the prayer answering God and that’s why everyone must run to Him – Psalm 65:2.
entries.key_scripture_text: 28 ¶ Now it came to pass, about eight days after these sayings, that He took Peter, John, and James and went up on the mountain to pray. 29 As He prayed, the appearance of His face was altered, and His robe became white and glistening.

blocks.text: If there is a man to pray, then there is surely a God to answer! He is the prayer answering God and that’s why everyone must run to Him – Psalm 65:2.

Sanctification is the mother of manifestations. You can therefore only see the hand of God in your life if you are living holy. Hebrews 12:14 says, ‘Follow peace with all men and holiness without which no man can see God’
However, one of the greatest exponents in the equation of holiness is prayer. Prayer enhances sanctification. Prayer room is a “holy” room because it is the room of the “Holy” God.

So, prayer will make you resistant to sin. In prayer we meet with the holy God where defilement gives way to divinity. In prayer we are purified, refined and sanctified. One day, Jesus took three of His disciples to the mountain to pray. In the midst of prayer, the garment of Jesus became white which is symbolic of the impartation of the Spirit of holiness - Lk.9:28-30; Is.6:1-7. The Bible says in Eccl. 9:8, ‘Let thy garments always be white and let not your head lack ointment’
You can’t be truly prayerful and enjoy sin. In prayer our taste for sin is destroyed and our taste for righteousness is activated.

Get a man to pray and you will succeed at getting him out of sin. When a person gives himself continually to prayer, the negative addictions of sin fade away. In prayer we look at God and thereafter look like God. In this second half of the year, give yourself to prayer if you desire to live holy. Have a daily prayer schedule. Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. YOU CANNOT REMAIN SINFUL IF YOU ARE GENUINELY PRAYERFUL. You can be sanctified through prayer. Prayer works wonders.

entries.prayer: O Lord, uproot every trace of sin from my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am seriously addicted to prayer!

entries.title: It’s All About Jesus!
entries.summary: On the Mount of Transfiguration, Moses and Elijah appeared to Jesus. However at the end of the day only JESUS remained standing (Luke 9). Your goal in life must be to keep Jesus at the centre of all you do.
entries.key_scripture_text: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in needs, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

blocks.text: On the Mount of Transfiguration, Moses and Elijah appeared to Jesus. However at the end of the day only JESUS remained standing (Luke 9). Your goal in life must be to keep Jesus at the centre of all you do.

Do not seek fame if you don’t want to end in flames. You are not called to be famous but to be faithful. You are not called to known by the world but to show Jesus to the world to see. You are not called to project yourself but to project Christ.

Seek to be full of God at all times and you will continue to flow for God. Fame seeking is what leads people to comparison and unhealthy competition. Every man is called to pursue a purpose and to follow a path. II Cor.12:10; 1 Cor.7:14, 21. Therefore run your own race and fight your own battles.

Don’t speak for yourself. Let your work speak for you. Your work has voice that cannot be silenced, feet that cannot be stopped, face that cannot be shielded, and hand that cannot be hindered. Your work is your address; people will locate you through your works. Your work has the key to all closed doors, to high favour, to attracting all that belongs to you. Rev.3:8 says, ‘“I know your works. See, I have set before you an open door, and no one can shut it; for you have a little strength, have kept My word, and have not denied My name.’
Rather than showing your face and seeking for fame, project your work and be diligent in all you do and very soon you will stand before kings! Then the world will see Jesus in all you do!

entries.prayer: O Lord, kill any seed of pride in me in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I only project Jesus Christ and His Kingdom!

entries.title: You Must Always Be Thankful
entries.summary: Small things matter to God. We must not wait to see big things before we thank God. There is nothing too small to thank God for. There should be no difference between our thanksgiving for seemingly little things and big things.
entries.key_scripture_text: In everything give thanks; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.

blocks.text: Small things matter to God. We must not wait to see big things before we thank God. There is nothing too small to thank God for. There should be no difference between our thanksgiving for seemingly little things and big things. For instance, when God delivers you from a minor headache, your thanksgiving and appreciation must be the same if He had delivered you from a major asthma attack.

Great men don’t make assumptions; they mind details .A fool keeps waiting for ‘big bang’ to give big thanks. The difference between the one and nine lepers is that he saw what others referred to as little and insignificant, and he magnified it. It was this same leper who later on experienced wholeness in his body. All the other nine lepers experienced a fraction of the healing virtue but only the thankful leper experienced his total and permanent deliverance from leprosy. Luke 17: 17-19, ’17 And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine? 18 There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger. 19 And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.’

To qualify for big things, give thanks to God for small things. Do not slight His acts if you don’t want to be slighted by Him. Micah 2:1-2 says, ‘1 ¶ “And now, O priests, this commandment is for you. 2 If you will not hear, And if you will not take it to heart, To give glory to My name,” Says the LORD of hosts, “I will send a curse upon you, And I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have cursed them already, Because you do not take it to heart.’ Don’t ignore small things because it is small things that make a big thing to happen. God doesn’t have problem blessing you with big things if you will only acknowledge him for ‘small’ things. Those who regard God’s act as insignificant will be reduced to insignificance in his eyes. Learn to ALWAYS THANK HIM FOR EVERYTHING; THE SMALL AS WELL AS THE BIG THINGS HE DOES FOR YOU!

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a heart of gratitude in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am always thankful!

entries.title: The Cure for Depression
entries.summary: Depression is the gateway to oppression. One of the most dangerous parties to attend is a ‘pity party’. Pity parties cause you to live in a realm of anxiety and worry.
entries.key_scripture_text: says, ‘6 Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God; 7 and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

blocks.text: Depression is the gateway to oppression. One of the most dangerous parties to attend is a ‘pity party’. Pity parties cause you to live in a realm of anxiety and worry. However, what you must know is that easiest route to worry, depression and apprehension is to attempt to care for yourself and to fight your own battles.

Jesus already warned us to take no thought about what to eat or drink. Matt.6: 25 says “Therefore I say to you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink; nor about your body, what you will put on. Is not life more than food and the body more than clothing?’ The cares of this life choke destiny and destroy potentials. Live your life absolutely depending on the One who knew you before He made you (Jeremiah 1:5). Your parents knew you after you were born but God knew you even before you were born.

Roll your care upon Him (I Peter 5:7) because you can simply not handle them. Life is too heavy to carry, release it to the Owner and the Manager of it. He has provided for your total well being in it.He cannot mismanage your life for you. Leave it absolutely to Him and it will amaze you how He will turn it back to you.Be rest assured that no matter the circumstance and situation God will certainly take care of you. Do not exchange your peace for anxiety. Phil.4:6-7 says, ‘6 Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God; 7 and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus .

Take your rest in God and He will take care of the rest for you. Whenever you feel like worrying; don’t because you have a God who has your whole destiny in His hands. Stop the pity party because you are not a person to be pitied but rather a person to be envied!

entries.prayer: O Lord, I put my life into Your mighty Hands in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am far from depression!

entries.title: Connecting to Greater Glory
entries.summary: The Bible says that the glory of the latter house shall be greater than the former. God has so many wonderful plans for you but the question is, ‘Are you ready?’. Everything starts and ends with the heart.
entries.key_scripture_text: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

blocks.text: The Bible says that the glory of the latter house shall be greater than the former. God has so many wonderful plans for you but the question is, ‘Are you ready?’. Everything starts and ends with the heart. Therefore, what your heart cannot entertain, your hand can never obtain. God is a wise owner and an excellent manager. He will never commit into your hands, what your heart is not ready for.

In life, it is the size of your heart for people that define the scope of your assignment from God. God made Abraham the father of many nations because he had a heart to accommodate the families of the earth. Look at the way, he pleaded for the people of Sodom and Gomorrah in order to stop God from destroying them (Genesis 19). God gave Israel to David because he had a heart to serve them. When King Saul and the soldiers of Israel were unwilling to fight against Goliath on behalf of their nation, a 17-year-old boy in the person of David was willing to risk his fragile life for his nation (I Samuel 17).

God gave Moses three million people to lead because he had a heart for them. Acts 7:23 says of Moses, “ And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.” Jesus was given the whole world because He cares for it. When no one was unwilling to come and die for humanity to reconcile us back to God; Jesus was. He left the splendor and the grandeur of Heaven to die a painful and a shameful death on the Cross.

You can never impact a people you don’t love. People will come to you and follow you because of your heart for them. Develop a genuine love for people and you will never stop touching lives this year and beyond!

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a heart for people in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am ready for my greater glory!

entries.title: Choose Rather to Obey God!
entries.summary: In the journey of life, your only one desire must be to please God in all you do. Rather than struggling to impress people, strive to do what is right. One of the dangers of life is to try to confuse the applause of men with the affirmation of Heaven.
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ For do I now persuade men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? For if I still pleased men, I would not be a bondservant of Christ.

blocks.text: In the journey of life, your only one desire must be to please God in all you do. Rather than struggling to impress people, strive to do what is right. One of the dangers of life is to try to confuse the applause of men with the affirmation of Heaven. However what you must know is that, men may applaud you but may be God might have rejected you. What is popular with men may be unpopular with God.

Therefore, simply keep doing what is right and you will come out of the pressure of pleasing people. Those who do right things don’t ever fear been faulted by men because doing it right has already earned them God’s approval. Right doing is what gives you your right place in the school of life. Keep doing what is right and you will never fear any evil.

You must choose to rather obey God than to please men. This is what the Jewish elders wanted the disciples to do. However Peter the leader of the disciples and the others responded in Ac 5:29 this way, ‘...We ought to obey God rather than men.’ In this wicked and perverse generations where sin is on the ascendancy and morality has been jettisoned somewhere there must be anew breed of people who will always be determined to please God rather than men.

You must never follow the multitude to do evil (Exodus 23:2) because the majority is not always right. In fact, they are mostly wrong. Decide to stand up for God! Never blend with the world because whoever is a friend of the world is an automatic enemy of Gog (James 4:4)

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to always please You in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am a God pleaser!

entries.title: Supernatural Faith — Part 1
entries.summary: Beloved, the Christian walk is a walk of faith. we only believe what we see with our physical eyes, then what would a blind man believe. The Christian walk is impossible without the indispensable nugget of faith.
entries.key_scripture_text: But without faith it is impossible to please Him, for he who comes to God must believe that He is, and that He is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.

blocks.text: Beloved, the Christian walk is a walk of faith. we only believe what we see with our physical eyes, then what would a blind man believe. The Christian walk is impossible without the indispensable nugget of faith. Nothing pleases God more than your faith. Every father loves the faith of his child. When a child asks his father for big things like aero planes, cars etc and believes that the father can afford it in spite of his bank balance or cash at hand, a father becomes glad at such uncommon trust.

From the very first line of the Bible, God requires us to have faith. He doesn’t go into elaborate detail about who He is or how He created everything. God doesn’t lay out His case as a logical legal brief. He just states plainly, “In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.” (Genesis 1:1)

Once you read these words you are compelled to either walk in faith and believe the Word of God or choose to dismiss it. It’s clear that it takes faith to believe the Bible, because there are many unanswered questions. God wastes no time trying to talk us into believing His Word. The ability to believe God’s Word is a gift of faith from Him (Ephesians 2:8). If you find yourself questioning the reality of God’s Word, then you need faith. How can you get faith? “Faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word of Christ” (Romans 10:17).

Read the Word of God diligently and consistently, listen to the Word of God, repeat aloud the Word of God, meditate on the Word of God and sing God’s Word. This will allow faith to come-for without faith, it is impossible to please God (Hebrews 11:6). IF YOUR FAITH COMES ALIVE; YOUR MIRACLES WILL AUTOMATICALLY COME ALIVE! Signs flow, wherever faith goes!

entries.prayer: O Lord, energize my faith through Your Word in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I refuse to doubt God!

entries.title: Supernatural Faith — Part 2
entries.summary: possible, it means it is feasible, attainable, within reach, within bounds and can be fulfilled.
entries.key_scripture_text: 1 ¶ Then Job answered the LORD, and said, 2 I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee

blocks.text: GOD DWELLS IN A REALM WHERE IMPOSSIBILITIES
CANNOT EXIST. In fact, the word impossibility is a creation
of man and can only be found in the dictionary of man. In the
dictionary of God, there is no word like, ‘impossible.’ Therefore, when
you place a limit on God, you place a limit on your life because there
are certain things that only God can handle! When a thing is said to be
possible, it means it is feasible, attainable, within reach, within bounds and can be fulfilled.
Now let’s read I Kings 17:2-6,

I Kings 17: 2 ¶ Andword of the LORD came unto him, saying, 3 Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan. 4 And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there. 5 So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.6 And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
There are two major principles that stand out from the above passage;
EVERYTHING HAS EARS FOR GOD
God commanded the RAVENS

This means that God understands the language of birds. He had communications with the ravens and they complied. God can speak to your bank account, He can speak to your car; He can command anything under Heaven and they will obey.
GOD CAN MAKE THE UNWILLING DO HIS WILL

Ravens are birds with unquenchable appetite. It is said that a raven eats more than a vulture. It swallows up its young ones it gives birth to because of hunger. It is from raven that we get the word, ‘ravenous’ which means voracious. YET THOSE WERE THE MESSENGERS GOD SENT WITH FOOD FOR ELIJAH. The ones that do not give food to anybody, who are permanently looking for food, were the ones God sent to give food to His prophet. GOD SUSPENDED THE RAVENS APPETITE and they simply could not eat the food because they were under a command. This means that, God can use anyone to favour you and to bless you. Indeed, we serve a God of possibilities! From today, may you never doubt God in your life.

entries.prayer: O Lord, let everything become possible in my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: Nothing shall be impossible for me!

entries.title: Supernatural Faith – Faith 3
entries.summary: Faith is the engine that makes the impossible to become possible. Wherever faith goes, signs and wonders follow. It is active faith in the God of possibilities that causes you to emerge out of the adversities of life with a testimony.
entries.key_scripture_text: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

blocks.text: Faith is the engine that makes the impossible to become possible. Wherever faith goes, signs and wonders follow. It is active faith in the God of possibilities that causes you to emerge out of the adversities of life with a testimony.

Now let’s carefully read, John 4:46-53, ‘46 So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum. 47 When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death. 48 Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe. 49 The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die. 50 Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way. 51 And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth. 52 Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him. 53 So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
There are two major principles that stands out of this passage;
NOTHING DIES IN THE PRESENCE OF JESUS CHRIST

The noble man’s son was at the point of death but when he met Jesus Christ (the resurrection and the life), he was revived. Acts 3:15 also calls Jesus Christ THE PRINCE OF LIFE. This means that whatever is about to die, dying and dead be it your spiritual life, marriage, business etc, will jump back to life in the presence of Jesus Christ.
MIRACLES FLOW IN THE DIRECTION OF GOD’S WORD

God’s Word is as good as done. That is why, you must believe the Word of God more than any reality. Isaiah 55:10-11 says, ‘10 For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater: 11 So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, begin to do the impossible in my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am designed for signs and wonders!

entries.title: Your Case Is Different
entries.summary: When you encounter God, you become a candidate for good things. When other men who do not know Your God are saying there is a casting down, you will be rising continually . Your case will simply be different.
entries.key_scripture_text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

blocks.text: When you encounter God, you become a candidate for good things. When other men who do not know Your God are saying there is a casting down, you will be rising continually . Your case will simply be different.

Whenever, you meet God, your life is preserved - Ge 32:30 And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved. You are preserved from the heat of the day.
As a Christian, you must be sure of one thing that, what kills others cannot kill you;
The same fire that killed the ones who placed the three Hebrew boys into the fiery furnace could not kill Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego (Dan. 3)
The lions that ate up the enemies of Daniel could not eat him up (Dan. 6:1-19)
James died by the sword of Herod but Peter escaped the same sword (Acts 5:1-12)
Paul could not be killed by the venomous viper. Where there is fire, there is no need to fear the viper because the viper cannot survive the fire (Acts 28:1-6)

God will preserve you from premature death; nobody connected to you will die in an untimely fashion in Jesus Name! - Ps 79:11 Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
SAY BOLDLY TO YOURSELF, ‘MY CASE IS DIFFERENT”

entries.prayer: O Lord, preserve m by Your mighty power in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: My case is different!

entries.title: The Ultimate Purpose for Man’s Existence
entries.summary: What is God like? Who is God? If you were asked to describe God today, how would you respond?
entries.key_scripture_text: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the Lord which exercise loving kindness, judgment, and righteousness in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the Lord.

blocks.text: What is God like? Who is God? If you were asked to describe God today, how would you respond? Though the natural mind can never fully understand God, you and I can know Him and discover what He is like through our relationship with Him and a revelation of His Word.

The ultimate purpose for man’s existence is to know and understand God. It is the most important project one can undertake since it brings delight to God (J er. 9:24). We capture a glimpse of God’s nature and character when we examine the revelations of His names in scripture. A name is a word or term by which somebody or something is known and distinguished from other people or things. Names show the reputation, standing, style or character of a person. Our names are precious to us...they reveal who we are; they are a person connection and a unique part of us.

God always introduced Himself by different names to different people. These different names show the different attributes of God and illustrates the various ways he portrays His power to His creation.
Follow me on this journey as we examine the various names of God and their effects on our lives as children of God in the subsequent days.

entries.prayer: Father, reveal yourself to me in Jesus Name. Amen!!
entries.confession: I pursue God with all my heart!

entries.title: Do You Know God as the Creator?
entries.summary: The name “Elohim” describes God as the creator. In other words, our God is the creator of the world and everything that exist in it.
entries.key_scripture_text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

blocks.text: The name “Elohim” describes God as the creator. In other words, our God is the creator of the world and everything that exist in it. Many scientists have propounded many theories to explain how the world came into being and even the existence of human beings. In spite of theories like the “Big Bang” and the “Evolution”, it is an undisputable fact that God created the world. Atheists may claim that there is no God but the fact still holds that there is a God in Heaven that rules over the affairs of men(Psalm 8:3, Psalm 102:25, Col. 1;16-17). Daniel 4:17 says, “This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.”

Creativity is an aspect of God’s character and nature. His creative nature is portrayed in two ways. Firstly, through the spoken word (Psalm 33:6, Hebrews 11:3). Secondly, through wisdom (Jer. 10:15, 51:15). When man was created in the image of God, he was blessed with God’s creative nature. Man’s creative abilities and power of invention are from God.

Ideas rule the world and they are the most expensive commodities on the earth. One creative idea from God can turn things around for you. If you are a true Christian, your words carry creative powers. (Eccl. 8:4). You can see what you say. Again, you have the mind of Christ (creative wisdom of Gods) and you can use it at any time. From today, begin to walk in your creative abilities in Jesus Name!!

entries.prayer: O Lord, begin to do new things in my life in Jesus Name. Amen.
entries.confession: I operate with supernatural creativity!

entries.title: Do You Know God as the Almighty?
entries.summary: There are many mighty men but there is only one Almighty God. “El-Shaddai” is another name of God which means the Almighty or the all-sufficient one.
entries.key_scripture_text: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the almighty God: walk before me, and be thou perfect.

blocks.text: There are many mighty men but there is only one Almighty God. “El-Shaddai” is another name of God which means the Almighty or the all-sufficient one. It also means “the mighty one with many breasts.” As a child of God, you must know that if God can’t do it, then nobody can. This is because there is none higher than the Most high. In these hard times, only God can satisfy you!

Lets us critically examine the case of Abraham and Sarah. When Abraham was an old man and Sarah’s womb was dead (menopause, God said, “In one year when you’re a hundred years old and you’re not good for anything, I’ll perform the miracle” (Gen. 17:4-6). In the sight of men this was closed case; there was no way out. However the “El-Shaddai” God stepped into Abraham’s situation and impossibility became a possibility. There is no closed-cause with God. The harder it is for man; the better it is for God! Your case is not yet over. I don’t care your condition now; the Almighty God can change your life for the better.

He is the “mighty breasted one” and the breast meets every need of the baby. It is the baby’s milk, porridge, water, diet etc. The breast is all a baby needs to survive. In the same way, God is all you need to make it in life.
Hopeless situations do not make God helpless. I don’t care how mighty your obstacle is, the Almighty God is sending help to you today.

entries.prayer: Almighty God, change all my obstacles into miracles in Jesus Name: Amen!!
entries.confession: God is all I need to make it in life!

entries.title: Do You Know God as the Master?
entries.summary: Jesus Christ is not only your Saviour, He is also your Lord.
entries.key_scripture_text: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant

blocks.text: As a child of God, you must have a true revelation of God as your Master.

Jesus Christ is not only your Saviour, He is also your Lord. When the Apostle Peter was delivering his first sermon in Acts 3:36, he said, “Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made the same Jesus whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.”

As Abraham was sitting in the doorway of his tent at noontime with the sun beating down upon him, he saw three men approaching. Bowing himself to the ground, Abraham called out, “My Lord” (meaning Master or wholly thine) – Gen. 18:1-3. In other words, if God becomes your master, it means you are the property of God. You are always at his service. Everything that concerns God, concerns you and because of that, everything that concerns you also concerns God.

In the olden days, servants or slaves were willing to die for their masters. So if God is truly your Lord, you’ll be willing to die for Him. That was why Shadrack, Meshack and Abednago were not afraid of the death threats of King Nebuchadnezzar; God was their master. They decided to rather burn than turn from the commandments of their Master . It is the Master (Lord) who dictates everything for the servant. The word of the Master is obeyed by the servant.

Beloved, is God your Master? Do you serve Him at all times? Do you obey Him no matter the cost? Are you fulfilling the Great Commission? Are you totally surrendered to Him? If not let Him become your “Adonai” today. God only reveals His will to those who know Him as Adonai (Gen. 18:17).

entries.prayer: Father, Lord, I want you to become the Lord and Master over my life from today in Jesus Name. Amen!!
entries.confession: I have only one Master and Lord; the Almighty God!

entries.title: Do You Know God as the Provider?
entries.summary: Every true father provides for his children. Therefore God, who is our heavenly Father is always ready to provide for us His children.
entries.key_scripture_text: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

blocks.text: Every true father provides for his children. Therefore God, who is our heavenly Father is always ready to provide for us His children. Our God is Jehovah Jireh which suggests two meanings: “Jehovah shall be seen” and “Provider.” This name therefore speaks about redemption.

God gave Abraham a glorious promise that was fulfilled in the birth of Isaac. I want you to put yourself in the position of Abraham. Imagine the joy and excitement that Abraham experienced as he watched his son grow. Then one day God demanded for the only son of old man Abraham ((Gen. 22:2). Many modern day people would have disobeyed this command but without hesitation, Abraham took Isaac and they embarked on a three-day journey to Mount Mariah. It was certainly a journey of no return for Isaac. As they walked along Isaac said, “Father I see the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice?
Abraham was so confident in his God that he knew the he could provide even at the last moment and in the most difficult of times. True to his faith, God provided a ram on top of a mountain.

Listen to me today, no matter what is lacking in your life, God can provide. When man ends, God begins . When man says it is over, God takes over and when God takes over, the battle is over. If God is truly your shepherd, you will never want any good thing (Psalm 23:1). Phil. 4:19 says that your God will supply all your needs...” The economic situation notwithstanding, God will always provide for you and your family. May Heaven surprise you today in Jesus Name! God will connect you to good things and open great doors for you. From today, goodness and mercy shall follow you all the days of your life.

entries.prayer: O Lord, let me experience supernatural provision in all I do in Jesus Name! Amen.
entries.confession: I will never lack any good thing!

entries.title: Do You Know God as the Healer?
entries.summary: There are many strange sicknesses and diseases that attack mortal men in this world That’s why as a child of God, you must have a revelation of your heavenly Father as a Healer.
entries.key_scripture_text: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee.

blocks.text: There are many strange sicknesses and diseases that attack mortal men in this world That’s why as a child of God, you must have a revelation of your heavenly Father as a Healer.

Our God is Jehovah “Rophe”meaning healer, repairer and restorer, the doctor. This revelation came through Moses to the children of Israel as they were freed from the 430 years bondage of Egypt. When they came to the waters of Marah, the Israelites found that the water was bitter and unsuitable for drinking. God showed Moses a tree and when he cast it into the water, it was made sweet, (Exodus 15:25-26). It is the will of God for you to be healed (3 John 2). God has the power to heal all lands of sicknesses and infirmities. Although certain diseases can be cured medically, others go beyond physical cure. May be your sickness is emotional physical or spiritual. God is still able to heal or cure you. No matter how long you have been carrying that sickness, God can heal you today. Christ bore your pains and took your sicknesses on the cross and by His stripes you were healed. (Matt. 8:17, Isaiah 53:3-5). The enemy can no longer oppress you; from today, you will see God as “Jehovah Rophe” in your life!!
