If any part of your body is damaged, God will repair it. However, if it is beyond repairs, Jehovah the Healer will replace it with a new part in Jesus Name! May you live a sickness-free life as you encounter the Doctor of Doctors.

entries.prayer: O Lord, heal me and I shall be healed in Jesus Name. !
entries.confession: I walk in divine health all the days of my life!

entries.title: Do You Know God as the Conqueror?
entries.summary: Battles are satan’s reaction to the advancement and progress of men. In fact, the brighter your destiny, the harsher your attackers.
entries.key_scripture_text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah Nissi

blocks.text: Battles are satan’s reaction to the advancement and progress of men. In fact, the brighter your destiny, the harsher your attackers.

That is why you must know God as Jehovah Nissi which means the “Lord our Banner” or THE LORD OUR CONQUEROR signifying our victory. We serve a victorious God. Defeat and failure can never be associated with God and it should also not be associated with us. No one in life wants to be defeated in any venture. However, you cannot have true victory without the help of God. Divine assistance is the greatest catalyst of human advancement. It was said of King Uzziah in 2 Chronicles 26:15, ”... And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.”

According to Exodus 17, there was a conflict between the Israelites and the Amalekites who were the descendants of Esau at Rephidim. Moses instructed Joshua to organize the Israelites for battle on the following day, promising to stand on the mountain top and petition God for the victory while Israel faced Amalek in battle. Joshua did exactly as he was told and Moses stood upon the mountain with the rod of God extended as he prayed for victory. So long as Moses lifted up his hands in prayer, Israel prevailed in the battle. When we grew tired and let down his hands however, Amalek begun to triumph. It took the help of Aaron and Hur to keep His hands up to ensure Israel’s victory in that battle.

God has promised His children victory in all the conflicts of life. The Bible says that whatsoever is born of God overcomes the world and this is the victory that overcomes the world, even our faith (1 John 5:4). The Bible also says that God will always give us victory through our Lord Jesus Christ (1 Cor. 15:57). You must however lift up your hands in prayer to God every time you get into trouble. So long as your hands are up in prayer, you will never be defeated no matter what the enemy brings your way.

entries.prayer: Dear Lord, make me victorious in every conflict I face in life in Jesus Name!!
entries.confession: All-round victory is my portion!

entries.title: Do You Know God as the Peace Giver?
entries.summary: Our God is Jehovah Shalom meaning “Our Peace.” One of the greatest assets in life is peace. You may have money, a good shelter, assorted food, academic degrees etc. but if you lack peace, life will be unbearable.
entries.key_scripture_text: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the Lord, and called it Jehovah-Shalom

blocks.text: Our God is Jehovah Shalom meaning “Our Peace.” One of the greatest assets in life is peace. You may have money, a good shelter, assorted food, academic degrees etc. but if you lack peace, life will be unbearable. That is why I love this scripture in Psalm 29:11, “ The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.” Peace is one blessing you should always pray for as a Christian.

How did God get this name? After Israel’s miraculous liberation from Egypt, they soon forgot the Lord. When you forget God, you will also be under oppression. God allowed the Midianites to oppress the Israelites. In the midst of this excruciating torment, the Israelites prayed unto the Lord. God in His own mercy appeared unto Gideon and commanded him to lead the Israelites into battle against the Midianites. Unaware of whom he was in God, the words Gideon spoke revealed the unbelief in his heart when he said, “If I have found grace in thy sight, then show me a sign” (Judges 6:17). When God revealed himself as “Jehovah Shalom” to Gideon, fear and unbelief vanished. Shortly after this experience, Gideon led 300 men to a supernatural victory over the Midianites.

You can also enjoy the peace of God; for He will keep you in perfect peace if your mind is stayed on Him (Isaiah. 26:3). I speak peace into your life and family; I declare peace into your marriage and in your business in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, let your peace which surpasses all understanding overshadow my life in Jesus Name. Amen!!
entries.confession: I walk under the canopy of God’s peace!

entries.title: Do You Know God as the Sanctifier?
entries.summary: The greatest limitation to God’s manifestation is a lack of sanctification (Joshua 3:5). God wants pure and holy vessels in order to manifest His power in our world today.
entries.key_scripture_text: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the Lord your God. And ye shall keep me statutes, and do them: I am the Lord which sanctify you.

blocks.text: The greatest limitation to God’s manifestation is a lack of sanctification (Joshua 3:5). God wants pure and holy vessels in order to manifest His power in our world today. You automatically become a stranger to God’s power when you are familiar with sin. We live in a sin-soaked and an evil contaminated world that is why God must become our “Jehovah M’kaddesh” (the Lord our sanctifier).

When God becomes our sanctifier, He takes us out of sin into holiness, out of bondage into liberty, out of filth into righteousness. Some Christians think that after their salvation, what they do with their lives do not matter. Such people will be surprised when they hear the Master on the Judgment Day saying , “He does not know them”. God is a thrice holy God; for the angels carry out “holy, holy, holy.” Therefore without holiness no man (including Pastors, Bishops, Elders, Deacons, General Overseers etc) cannot see God. You will be judged according to your works (Rev. 20:12-13). That is why you and I must choose to follow God’s example of holiness so that we become more like Him.

If you are truly sanctified by God, the old sins that you once indulged in will no longer appeal to you. You will hate fornication, pornography, lies, masturbation, anger, theft, adultery, homosexuality or lesbianism, pride etc. all the days of your life. You will not tolerate for even a second any unforgiveness, bitterness and hatred. From today, allow “Jehovah M’kaddesh” to do a complete work in your life. May you truly know God as your sanctifier in Jesus Name.

entries.prayer: O Lord, deliver me from any sin that easily entices me in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am a vessel of holiness

entries.title: Do You Know God as the Shepherd?
entries.summary: As our Father God feeds us and as a Shepherd, He leads us. “Jehovah Rohi” simply means “ the Lord my shepherd.” As a shepherd, the Lord feeds, directs, leads and cares for us. The Christian is compared to the sheep.
entries.key_scripture_text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

blocks.text: As our Father God feeds us and as a Shepherd, He leads us. “Jehovah Rohi” simply means “ the Lord my shepherd.” As a shepherd, the Lord feeds, directs, leads and cares for us. The Christian is compared to the sheep. Naturally, sheep are weak, defenceless and foolish. Without a good shepherd therefore, sheep are vulnerable to all sorts of dangers. They can get lost easily. While they are grazing in the pasture, some can wander away from the flock. That is why the Bible says that “All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned everyone to his own way;” (Isaiah 53:6).

When sheep go astray, it takes a loving and a caring shepherd to go after the one that was lost and bring it back into the fold. In the same way, we were once lost and it took the loving and caring shepherd of our souls (Jesus Christ to bring us back to the fold of God. Again, sheep can experience severe hunger especially when there is no pasture. Such severe hunger can cause death among them. A good shepherd therefore will always lead the sheep to a green pasture so that they don’t starve to death.

In our Christian walk too, spiritual hunger occurs when the Word of God is lacking and we are finding it very difficult to participate in other godly activities. The Bible makes this statement about the Good Shepherd, ‘He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: He leads me beside the still waters” (Psalm 23:2). Finally, Jesus Christ, our Good Shepherd also protects us from all evil and delivers our souls from the hands of the enemy.
It is my prayer for you today, that God will always be your Shepherd. May all-round protection be your portion in Jesus Name as you know God as a Shepherd.

entries.prayer: O Lord, lead me in this journey of life in Jesus Name!!
entries.confession: My steps are ordered by the Lord!

entries.title: The More You Know Him, the More You Become Like Him
entries.summary: Beloved, the only way to know God is by having a revelation in your spirit. This is because, God is a spirit and we can really contact Him with our spirits (John 4:24).
entries.key_scripture_text: That I may know Him, and the power of His resurrection, and the fellowship of His sufferings, being made conformable unto His death;

blocks.text: Beloved, the only way to know God is by having a revelation in your spirit. This is because, God is a spirit and we can really contact Him with our spirits (John 4:24). The level of your intimacy with Him will determine the extent of His presence and power in your life . You must not be at the same level of Christianity each and everyday of your life. You must be growing from one level of spirituality to another. You must have diverse spiritual experiences throughout your Christian life. Every passing day must move you closer to God.

When Jesus came to the world, various people had varying levels of relationship with Him. There was the crowd or the multitude who also knew Jesus for His ability to give them bread and other miracles. There was also the seventy disciples who also knew Jesus to some extent. Again, there was “the twelve” disciples who also had a higher level of intimacy with Jesus than the “seventy”. Even among the 12 disciples, Jesus had inner circles of three disciples (Peter, James and John) who were always with Him during his prayer times. Finally among the three, John the beloved was also the closest disciple to Jesus signifying yet another higher level of intimacy. John was also learning on the bosom (heart region) of Jesus and therefore knew what was on the heart of his master.

You must also make a decision to draw closer to God from today. Your daily prayer and desire must be to know Him more and more. The more you know Him, the more you become like Him.(Phil. 3:10). To be far from God is to be far from good.

entries.prayer: Father, I refuse to be at the same level in my Christian life. Take me higher and deeper with You in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am going deeper with God!

entries.title: The Covering of His Glory — Part 1
entries.summary: Every Christian has a glorious destiny. Your faith in God guarantees a life of unending glory.
entries.key_scripture_text: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

blocks.text: Every Christian has a glorious destiny. Your faith in God guarantees a life of unending glory.
There are two kinds of glory
The Glory of God
Ps 19:1, ” ¶ The heavens declare the glory of God; and the
firmament sheweth his handywork.”
2. The Glory of man (the overflow of God’s Presence in the life of a
person)

When the glory of God came upon Moses, the children of Israel could not look at the face of Moses and could not come near him (Exodus 34:29-30) . In the same way, as you begin to walk in the visible glory of God, no devil can stand before you; you become a terror and a threat to the kingdom of darkness. Again, when the glory of God (the Ark of the Covenant) came into the House of Obededom, God changed the story of his life within 90 days (II Sam. 6:11). You are next in life for a miracle! It was the visible glory of God upon David that caused Saul to envy him in spite of the fact that he was the one on the throne . How can a President envy a poor citizen of the land, how can a Master envy a servant; how can a manager envy a messenger? Saul sought him every day but God did not deliver David into his hands. 1 Samuel 23:14 says,” and David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.”
May the Glory of God act as a shield of defence around you in Jesus Name! There is something about you and that is the visible Glory of God!

entries.prayer: O Lord, charge me with Your Glory in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am operating with God’s glory!

entries.title: The Covering of His Glory — Part 2
entries.summary: Beloved, there is something about you as a Christian. Human mind can’t comprehend it; human words can’t explain it. It is God’s glory.
entries.key_scripture_text: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

blocks.text: Beloved, there is something about you as a Christian. Human mind can’t comprehend it; human words can’t explain it. It is God’s glory. It turns a person of pity into an individual to be envied; it makes doors that have been closed for others to be opened for you. It causes you to be accepted where others are rejected and celebrated where others are tolerated.

It was the visible glory of God on Mordecai that caused Haman to envy him to the point where he wanted him dead. Haman was the next in command after king Ahasereus but envied a poor gate man like Mordecai. What a paradox!

Esther 5:9 says ¶ Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king›s gate, that he stood not u p, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai. 10 Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife. 11 And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king. 12 Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king. 13 Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.

Haman wanted to destroy Mordecai but what he didn’t know was that a man of glory is indestructible. At the end of the day, Haman was hanged on the gallows that he made for Mordecai. FAITH is the master key to a world of Glory . John 11:40, “ Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?”

entries.prayer: O Lord, overshadow me with Your glory in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am a carrier of the visible glory of God!

entries.title: Miracle-Producing Faith — Part I
entries.summary: Faith is the catapult that launches the stone of God’s Word into the destination of fulfilment.
entries.key_scripture_text: For I am the LORD. I speak, and the word which I speak will come to pass; it will no more be postponed; for in your days, O rebellious house, I will say the word and perform it,” says the Lord GOD.

blocks.text: Faith is the catapult that launches the stone of God’s Word into the destination of fulfilment.

Yes, it is true that God has said many wonderful things about you but Prophecies are impotent without faith. Prophecies are spoken by the mouth of God, believed in the heart of man and then finally fulfilled by the hand of God.
There were two people in the Bible who received a similar message from the Lord by the same messenger (Angel Gabriel) but their responses were different.
A Response of Unbelief – Zechariah
Luke 1: 18 And Zacharias said to the angel, “How shall I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
19 And the angel answered and said to him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God, and was sent to speak to you and bring you these glad tidings.
20 “But behold, you will be mute and not able to speak until the day these things take place, because you did not believe my words which will be fulfilled in their own time.”
A Response of Faith – Mary

Luke 1:38,45 “38 Then Mary said, “Behold the maidservant of the Lord! Let it be to me according to your word.” And the angel departed from her. 45 “Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of those things which were told her from the Lord.”

Your response to the Word of God must be that of faith and not of doubt in order to experience the miraculous in your life. Hebrews 4: 2 says, “For indeed the gospel was preached to us as well as to them; but the word which they heard did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in those who heard it.” ONLY BELIEVE!!

entries.prayer: O Lord, baptize me with a fresh spirit of faith in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always believe God!

entries.title: Miracle-Producing Faith — Part II
entries.summary: Every word of Scripture is a more sure Word of Prophecy. This means, it can’t change, it is established, it is bound to come to pass. However, what delays or eventually stops the manifestation of God’s Word in our lives is unbelief.
entries.key_scripture_text: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

blocks.text: Every word of Scripture is a more sure Word of Prophecy. This means, it can’t change, it is established, it is bound to come to pass. However, what delays or eventually stops the manifestation of God’s Word in our lives is unbelief. If you can believe, you will see the speedy fulfilments of God’s Word in your life.
To exercise your faith, you must do the following;
Believe everything that is declared from God’s Word
I Timothy 4:13,15, “13 Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine. 15 Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
Hebrews 4: 3 says For we which have believed do enter into rest,...”
2. Make specific confessions from the Word.

Faith must be vocalized if the required results are to be actualized. II Corinthians 4:13, “We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;”
Don’t let your mouth make your life crooked, wretched and miserable
3. Take steps of faith. James 2:19-20

In the school of faith, there is what to say and what to do; there is what to confess and what to profess; there is what to declare and what to act upon. Faith results are waiting for faith action. Faith does not fold his hands, cross his legs and open his mouth. It moves.
a) Act on the demands of the Scriptures
b) Act on the instruction of God’s Servants. II Chron. 20:20 c) Take practical steps

entries.prayer: O Lord, energize my faith in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: My faith always produce great Miracles!

entries.title: The Greatest Preparation for Your Manifestation
entries.summary: If you don’t want God to stay off you, stay off sin. If you must keep God with you, then keep off sin. It is true that, in our modern world today, most people are living in sin and are living any how.
entries.key_scripture_text: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord, MEN DEPART FROM EVIL “.

blocks.text: If you don’t want God to stay off you, stay off sin. If you must keep God with you, then keep off sin. It is true that, in our modern world today, most people are living in sin and are living any how. However, if you don’t withdraw your hand from sin, God will withdraw His hand from your life. Don’t touch sin if you don’t want to be out of touch with God.

You either love sin and hate God or love God and hate sin. James 4:4 says, “... know ye not that friendship of the world enmity with God? Whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God “. When Samson did not withdraw from sin, God withdrew from Him.

Samson was anointed and a great instrument in the hands of God. An instrument of glory however became a tool of mockery in the hands of the devil, because of the sin of sexual immorality. Never toy with sin if you don’t want to end as a toy in Satan’s hand.

Sanctification is the process of preparation for manifestation. The greater your desire for holiness, the higher you fly. You begin to see God’s hand launching you into higher realms of favour and glory, if you decide to live a holy life through the empowerment of the Spirit. ( Ezek. 36:27)
The Bible says in Rom. 6:14: “And sin shall have no dominion over you......”
Remember, holiness is beautiful and it pleases God for God is holy. He dwells in holiness and in light unapproachable - Ps. 2:9

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to keep away from sin in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: My life will always please God!

entries.title: The Mystery of the Cross
entries.summary: Welcome to another devotional encounter with the loving God who gave His own Son for the salvation of mankind. In recent times, the message of the cross has been relegated to the background in many churches.
entries.key_scripture_text: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness, but unto us which are saved it is the POWER OF GOD.

blocks.text: Welcome to another devotional encounter with the loving God who gave His own Son for the salvation of mankind. In recent times, the message of the cross has been relegated to the background in many churches. This accounts for the lack of power in the power of Christ today.

For Christians, the most beloved memorial is the cross. The cross of Christ reaches into the heaven and spans the distance from the beginning of the time to eternity. It’s foundation is sunk into the bed rock of God’s uncommon love and mercy (Romans 5:8). It can withstand the fiercest demonic attacks and sway the most hard hearted sinners.
There is room for an infinite number of people to visit the cross and come away changed forever. Simply put, the cross is the greatest instrument of power for sanctified believers.
Sometimes the cross is used as a cultural icon or a fashion accessory and even warns those who oppose what it stands for.
Christ’s agonizing death, which opened up the way for us to be accepted by God.
We need to visit there daily and preach about it consistently. The best view is not found at the top of some earthy monument but at the foot of the cross.

entries.prayer: O Lord, bring me to an understanding of the mystery of the cross in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am grateful for the Cross!

entries.title: The Realm of God!
entries.summary: In the realm of God, there is nothing which is impossible. Men can fail, but God will always prevail. True faith does not look at the intensity/gravity of a problem, but the immensity of God’s power.
entries.key_scripture_text: Vrs.26 “But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, with men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible”.

blocks.text: In the realm of God, there is nothing which is impossible. Men can fail, but God will always prevail. True faith does not look at the intensity/gravity of a problem, but the immensity of God’s power. Let’s look at some scriptures that changed my view about God’s dealings with men:
Matt. 28:18, “And Jesus came and spoke unto them, saying, ALL POWER is given unto me in heaven and in earth”.
Psalm 62:11, “God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this, that Power belonged unto God”.
Mark 10:27, “And Jesus looking upon them saith, with men
it is impossible, but not with God, for with God, all things are
POSSIBLE”.
Luke 1:37, “For with God nothing shall be IMPOSSIBLE”.
Luke 18:27, “And he said, the things which are impossible with
men are POSSIBLE with God”
Jer. 32:17, “Ah Lord God I behold, Thou has made the heavens
and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm. And there is NOTHING TOO HARD FOR THEE?
Jer. 32:27, “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there ANYTHING TOO HARD for me?
Gen. 18:14, “Is there ANYTHING TOO HARD for the LORD?
Job 42:1-2, “Then Job answered the Lord and said, I know that
thou CANST DO EVERYTHING...”

It can be clearly seen that your situation is not above God. I want you to meditate on and memorize these scriptures for 2021. Pray it out and confess it in the face of opposition and you rise above the storms of your life. If God can’t, then nobody can.

entries.prayer: Father, forgive me for ever doubting You. God of impossibilities, turn my life around in JESUS NAME!
entries.confession: I believe that my God can do all things!

entries.title: The Greatest Treasure in Life
entries.summary: The greatest treasure in life is a GOOD NAME . When money is put on the right and a good name is placed on the left, which one would you choose? Obviously, most people will opt for the money.
entries.key_scripture_text: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches and loving favour rather than silver and gold

blocks.text: The greatest treasure in life is a GOOD NAME . When money is put on the right and a good name is placed on the left, which one would you choose? Obviously, most people will opt for the money. However, although money is good, it is never the best inheritance to leave behind for your children. Money or great riches may bring you fame but can as well lead into flame. It is not so with name; a good name will bring you grace that will take away your shame. A good name will attract to you great favour.

You may loose money and recover the same and even more but if you lose your name, you may never recover it. That is why you must do everything to protect your name. Even Jesus Christ understood and endorsed this assertion in his own ife. After staying with the disciples for three and a half years, He did not leave them money or other material possessions. Jesus left them a NAME. He told them that if they acted in His Name, they will see wonders and miracles (Mark 16:15-20). God the Father also rewarded Jesus Christ with a NAME that is ABOVE EVERY NAME (Phil. 2:9-10)..

Always strive to get a good name. I Chronicles 11: 20 says, “And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a NAME among the three.” Like Abishai, begin to slay (do away with) any negative character in order for you to have a good name in your generation. Protect your name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to deal with any behavior that is destroying my name in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I have a good name!

entries.title: Developing Spiritual Toughness
entries.summary: Body fasting is the platform for spiritual fattening. Physical leanness is what births spiritual toughness. If you must get fatter spiritually then you must engage more in fasting. The body must “perish” for the inner man to be renewed. II Cor.
entries.key_scripture_text: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

blocks.text: Body fasting is the platform for spiritual fattening. Physical leanness is what births spiritual toughness. If you must get fatter spiritually then you must engage more in fasting. The body must “perish” for the inner man to be renewed. II Cor. 4:16, ” Therefore we do not lose heart. Even though our outward man is perishing, yet the inward man is being renewed day by day.” He must increase, but I (the body) must decrease- John 3:30. You must be dead to self to be alive unto God; you must be away from the body to be present with God - 1 Cor.5:8. At fasting time you desire the things of the Spirit more than things of the flesh. Fasting creates for you the platform to develop closeness to God. Denying your body of food is enhancing your spirit. Without a break from the body, you cannot assume strong spirituality. Feeding the body beyond necessary is killing the spirit man without knowing. How long you wait on God determines how much you weigh before men. Therefore wait on the Lord in a fast to enhance your spiritual weight before men. When you fast, you are empowered to prevail over the negative circumstances of life. After Jesus Christ had fasted for 40 days and nights it was said of Him in Luke 4:14 that “He returned in the POWER OF THE SPIRIT”.

Are you getting weak spiritually? Are you finding it difficult to pray? Do you feel some spiritual dryness in your life? Are you experiencing a draught of revelations, visions and dreams? Then enter into fast. You can fast your way into power. Yes you can!

entries.prayer: O Lord, increase my desire for spiritual things in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am a spiritual heavyweight!

entries.title: Add Commitment to Your Intelligence
entries.summary: The best of life always demands the best of you. Commitment! It is what separates doers from dreamers; successful people from failures and great men from the mediocre. In all probabilities, commitment is superior to intelligence.
entries.key_scripture_text: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.

blocks.text: The best of life always demands the best of you. Commitment! It is what separates doers from dreamers; successful people from failures and great men from the mediocre. In all probabilities, commitment is superior to intelligence. This is because, not all who are intelligent excel in life but all who are committed live above average.

Whereas intelligence is a plus, commitment is the foundation of a glorious destiny. Commitment first lays the foundation while intelligence builds as a pillar upon it. Intelligence alone will never be equal to success any day. Intelligence can be deceptive in the sense that it creates a sense of achievement in the mind of individuals who are in possession of it. It can actually create a sense of arrival and kill the desire for more.

On the contrary, commitment compels continuous crave for something new. It drives towards excellence at all times. No matter what you know, without commitment it will end in failure. That is why even the wisest man who has ever lived (Solomon) said in Ecclesiastes 9:10, “Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.”
May God fortify your life with the virtue of commitment in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to be committed in all I do in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I give my best at all times!

entries.title: The Heavenly Air-Force
entries.summary: You are born as a high flier, you cannot remain as a low crawler. You are part of a “heavenly air force”. You can’t enroll in an “earthly ground troop”. Every Christian is a candidate for progress.
entries.key_scripture_text: Vrs.13 “And the Lord shall make thee the head, and not the tail, and thou shall be above only, and thou shall not be beneath, if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the Lord thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them”.

blocks.text: You are born as a high flier, you cannot remain as a low crawler. You are part of a “heavenly air force”. You can’t enroll in an “earthly ground troop”. Every Christian is a candidate for progress.
Whatever you are doing now should not make you get satisfied with yourself.

Candidates for the top do not stop climbing. They keep going ahead in spite of the challenges of life. Those who want to live at the top use stopping stones as stepping stones, and see obstacles as miracles. When they see an end, they turn it into a bend, They don’t compare themselves with others and think the have arrived. They keep moving. What are your limitations? In spite of such limitations, you can still stand out in life this year. It is very crowded at the bottom, it is very crowded at the valley; go to the mountain top of life. The bible says that if you are obedient to God, then you will be the head and not the tail, and you shall be ABOVE ONLY AND NOT BENEATH...(Deut. 28:13) You can’t be stranded in life this year. To rule and to reign in life, you must get out of the common to become outstanding. It takes the daring to become the darling of all and sundry. From today, you must be determined to STEP OUT in order for you to STAND-OUT. You are part of the Heavenly Air force; you shall surely go up and stay up in Jesus Name!
Be a blessing to someone today by giving them a copy of fresh fire.

entries.prayer: Oh Lord, give me the strength to live life at the top in JESUS NAME! Amen.
entries.confession: I will go up and stay up!

entries.title: How to Experience Kingdom Prosperity
entries.summary: Fresh Fire for today is the best gift you can give to someone. Most Christians are struggling financially nowadays because they have refused to use simple Bible-keys.
entries.key_scripture_text: Vrs. 27 “... go thou to the sea, and cast on hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou has opened his mouth, thou shall find a piece of MONEY...

blocks.text: Fresh Fire for today is the best gift you can give to someone. Most Christians are struggling financially nowadays because they have refused to use simple Bible-keys. They have not discovered that there is prosperity in evangelism, but we must know that it is also a by-product.

From the above Scripture, ( Matthew 17:27), “the sea” stands for multitudes of people, and the “hook” stands for the boldness and zeal for evangelism. The “fish” stands for souls (fishers of men). And the “money” stands for prosperity. The fish they caught had money in its mouth. Some soul you will win carries your prosperity (money in the mouth).

Many Christians have however neglected this Great Commission. The Greatest Commission has now become the greatest omission. Each day, know the joy of sharing Christ wherever you go. There is no richer joy on earth, nor is there any higher joy in heaven, than that of winning souls to Christ. Luke 15:7-10.

Go out boldly and preach the gospel. Go from house to house in your neighbourhood and move from street to Street in your community. Plunder hell to populate Heaven; make Heaven glad and hell sad by embarking on an aggressive Evangelism campaign. There is joy and blessing in evangelism. May God bless and prosper you as you obey the Great Commission.

entries.prayer: I pray for more zeal to work for you O God in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I prosper because I win souls!

entries.title: How to Get Your Prayers Answered!
entries.summary: Soul wining is the heart beat of God. Do you want 100% answered prayer? Do you know why some of the things you have asked God have not come or have delayed? That’s the reason for the morning’s devotion.
entries.key_scripture_text: Vrs.16 “Ye have not chosen me; but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain that whatsoever ye shall ask of the father in My name, He may give it to you

blocks.text: Soul wining is the heart beat of God. Do you want 100% answered prayer? Do you know why some of the things you have asked God have not come or have delayed? That’s the reason for the morning’s devotion.

The Great Commission has now become the Great Omission. God has chosen us to win souls and make disciples of them, thus our first fruit must remain. When our first fruit remains, we have an open cheque; whatsoever we ask of the Father shall be given to us. God loves man that why He sent His only beloved Son to die to set man free.
So, the reason why some of our prayers have not been answered is because we haven’t won souls that are still in Church.

If you can get a soul won and a disciple made, you will get a prayer answered. Therefore, make soul winning your daily activity and you will not lack anything. As you make heaven happy, you will be happy. God bless you for your obedience .

entries.prayer: Lord, make me love and win souls every day in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I bear fruit and my fruit remains!

entries.title: How to Achieve Extrda-Ordinary Results
entries.summary: When confronted with challenges, ask less questions and engage more action. Your action terrorizes opposition and attracts divine helps.
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ The former account I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach

blocks.text: When confronted with challenges, ask less questions and engage more action. Your action terrorizes opposition and attracts divine helps. Those who ask too much questions may end as question marks and those who make too much analysis may suffer paralysis. All great achievements are born out of action. You don’t know what you can do until you begin to act.

Real leaders act more than they speak. While people may be inspired by your speech they will only follow you for your acts. Act what you say then say what you acted thereafter. You may have more admirers for what you say but you will only command followership only by what you act. Begin with action then end with speech. That was the way of Jesus – Act.1:1. People believed and followed Him because of His great acts of sacrifice and compassion.

People followed Him for His acts. To grow into this realm of leadership, be full of acts and less of words as people will understand you better and follow you for your action. May you receive the Grace to take the relevant steps that will cause a dramatic turnaround in your destiny in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to take the right steps in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am action-oriented!

entries.title: Why Most People Are Not Happy
entries.summary: Nobody can be truly happy when he is outside the will of God . One of the most horrible things that could happen to a person is when the person is outside where God wants him to be and he does not realize it until he gets to the grave.
entries.key_scripture_text: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

blocks.text: Nobody can be truly happy when he is outside the will of God . One of the most horrible things that could happen to a person is when the person is outside where God wants him to be and he does not realize it until he gets to the grave. Such a person would end up living a wasted life. You can never please God anywhere else but where He wants you to be . You may be popular amongst people and anytime you are around, they praise you, but if you were not where He wanted you to be, you would have chosen the second best for your life. Whatever our achievements, we must not miss God’s purpose for our lives. If you feel too big to be where God wants you to be, you would be cheating yourself. But when you are in a place of divine appointment, then you are in the flow of divine miracle. If somebody had told the little boy whose fish and bread the Lord used to feed the multitude when he was living home his provision would feed 5,000 people that day, he would have said, “No. This one is just for me. How can 5,000 feed on this?” When you are in a place of God’s purpose for your life, you are in a place of power. A person may be working very hard on a very good thing but if he is in the wrong place, he would be wasting his time; and it could be said that he is rebellious. So, the question is: Are you in the right place and in the right condition? Is your present spiritual level where God wants it to be? Namaan wanted to go to Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, but God had no appointment with Abana and Pharpar. Although they were nice rivers, the divine appointment was with the dirty river Jordan. It was in the River Jordan that he received His healing. Many of us are heading for Abana and Pharpar when we should go to Jordan.
May God help you to always be in the right place in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, always direct my steps in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will enjoy life to the fullest!

entries.title: Why Most Destinies Are Wasted
entries.summary: The devil is already wasting people. In fact, the greatest demon harassing many people today is the demon of wastage. Human beings are wasted. Many things are wasted. A person could decide to waste his own life.
entries.key_scripture_text: 2 And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, 3 Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan. 4 And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

blocks.text: The devil is already wasting people. In fact, the greatest demon harassing many people today is the demon of wastage. Human beings are wasted. Many things are wasted. A person could decide to waste his own life. A person could inherit wastage and a person could be wasted by powers of darkness. You must refuse to submit yourself to be wasted. It is a disaster to look at one’s life and discover that one has wasted it.

Let us consider the case of Elijah. The raven could not have fed Elijah anywhere else except where the Lord said he should go. Likewise, the widow would not have appeared anywhere else, except at Zarephath where the Lord commanded him to go. The Lord did not tell Elijah to just be moving about aimlessly like a vagabond. He directed him to the places He wanted him to be. Those were the places of God’s will for him. They were the places of God’s power and provision for him. A person can actually dance away from the place of God’s will or God’s provisions. God has a place for everyone. He has somewhere He wants you to be and He has something He wants you to do. It is a tragedy for a person to decide to go out of where God wants him to be.

Sometimes what God wants you to do may be completely inconvenient or may not make sense, but you have to do it. This is why the Bible says: “There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.” (Proverbs 14: 12). I want you to be sincere with yourself. If you know that the Holy Spirit has been telling you that your present position is not where He wants you to be spiritually and physically, then you have to reposition yourself.

entries.prayer: O Lord, if I am out of the place You want me to be, restore me now, in Jesus’ Name.
entries.confession: I am where God wants me to be!

entries.title: The Ultimate Purpose of Study
entries.summary: The primary purpose of study is to get information but the ultimate is to press for transformation. The whole essence of knowledge is transformation. If it is not applicable, then it is not profitable.
entries.key_scripture_text: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine. Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

blocks.text: The primary purpose of study is to get information but the ultimate is to press for transformation. The whole essence of knowledge is transformation. If it is not applicable, then it is not profitable. Information that does not culminate in transformation is wasted. Information is peripheral; it is transformation that takes you into depth. Renewal of mind must result in the transformation of life. Rom.12:2 says, “And be ye TRANSFORMED by the renewing of your minds...”

Don’t look for what to say but more importantly for what to show – 1 Tim.4:13,15. In your personal study, always seek for what to encounter and experience. That is the ultimate purpose of study – to experience change. If it doesn’t change you, it’s not worth it. II Cor.3:18. Therefore, whenever you are studying or gathering information analyze every information critically and see how you can apply it to specific situations or scenarios in your life. You must always draw vital conclusions from your observations. Then begin to apply all those conclusions to specific areas of your life where changes are needed. Then little by little, you will begin to see the needed changes you desire and make progress at the end of the day.
For instance, as a Christian, you must not just study the Bible; you must seek how God’s Word will bring transformation to the areas of deficiencies in your life. Seek transformation!!

entries.prayer: O Lord, open the eyes of my understanding in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am transformed into the image of Christ!

entries.title: Speak Right to Live Right!
entries.summary: When the 10 spies were saying it was not possible for the children of Israel to possess the promised land, Caleb said, ‘ let us go up at once and possess the land, for we are well able to overcome it (Numbers 13:30)
entries.key_scripture_text: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

blocks.text: In life, you must speak right to live right; you must speak life to go up.

When the 10 spies were saying it was not possible for the children of Israel to possess the promised land, Caleb said, ‘ let us go up at once and possess the land, for we are well able to overcome it (Numbers 13:30)
In life, never declare your condition but rather speak out your expectation
You were designed to have what you say and not to say what you have

Mr 11:23 For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
Your declarations are your prescriptions for God’s manifestations in your life.
Numbers 14: 28 Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
Your life turns in the direction of your tongue because your words are prophetic arrows into your future
I Peter 3:10 For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

A person’s biggest problem is not the problem itself but rather what they say about the problem. Therefore, speak the right words to create the right world around you; change your language to change your luggage in life!

entries.prayer: O Lord, touch my lips with your coals of fire in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I only say the right things!

entries.title: Following for Success — Part 1
entries.summary: Man is never created to be self-dependent; he is created to be a follower. When he ceases to follow he will certainly head for doom. A Disciple is a follower i.e. one called to follow.
entries.key_scripture_text: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

blocks.text: Man is never created to be self-dependent; he is created to be a follower. When he ceases to follow he will certainly head for doom. A Disciple is a follower i.e. one called to follow. He is one who has resigned from his personal interest with an absolute sense of abandonment. If you really want to make impact in life, you must be a life-long follower.
Stages of his following includes
1. God - for direction, divine guidance and fulfillment. It is in

following God that he derives his satisfaction. Outside of God, he remains empty, Eph 5:1. God is the porter; man is the clay. As you follow Him, He will bring out the best in you. Matthew 4:19 says, “And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.”
2. Good leaders - for inspiration, reference, examples & models,

human guidance and mentorship. You must however follow a leader who is following Christ,.Heb 6:12 says, “ That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
Himself - for inner witness and personal conviction, conscience
& personal principles.
Who you follow determines what follows you – Ps 23:1-6. Who you follow gives you access into the spirit of the one you follow, Num 27:15-20.

When Joshua followed Moses, he ended up operating like Moses. No man is an island. Everyone learns from someone. Anyone who is being referred to today had a reference point. Follow seriously to end gloriously.

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to follow You unto the end.
entries.confession: I am a good follower!

entries.title: Following for Success — Part 2
entries.summary: He must always strive to catch up with the spirit of his leader. Joshua and Caleb followed Moses until they imbibe the spirit of Moses in them. Num.27:18 – Joshua/Num.14:24 – Caleb.
entries.key_scripture_text: 35 Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers, 36 Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.

blocks.text: The success of a follower is measured by His alignment with the spirit of his leader.

He must always strive to catch up with the spirit of his leader. Joshua and Caleb followed Moses until they imbibe the spirit of Moses in them. Num.27:18 – Joshua/Num.14:24 – Caleb. Their testimony was that they followed wholly – Deuteronomy 1:35-36, ‘35 Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers, 36 Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.’

Elisha literally carried the spirit of Elijah on him because he was closely linked to him. In fact, they were so close that it took fire from Heaven to separate them. Elisha followed well and received a double portion of Grace.

Elisha - 11 Ki.2:15, 15 And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
Peter’s tie to Jesus spirit is a clear evidence of his undaunted followership. Matt.16:15-17

entries.prayer: O Lord, make me a good follower of that which is good in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am a follower of that which is good!

entries.title: How to Increase Your Performance
entries.summary: Performance in any duty or assignment is enhanced when you consider the task as a privilege. When you take any assignment for granted, you start failing at it. Every man is at his peak performance whenever it is seen as a privilege to serve.
entries.key_scripture_text: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?

blocks.text: Performance in any duty or assignment is enhanced when you consider the task as a privilege. When you take any assignment for granted, you start failing at it. Every man is at his peak performance whenever it is seen as a privilege to serve. God always resist the proud but gives more grace to the humble. When King Saul was little in his own sight, God anointed him and made him king over all the tribes over Israel (I Sam. 15:17). However, when he became proud and disobedient, God dethroned him and he died like a man who was never anointed. II Sam. 1:21 says, “ Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.”

Don’t ever turn into a “big man” because “big men” cannot do small things and if you fail at doing small things you will never be assigned to anything bigger. You must remain small in your eyes to become qualified before God for greater task.

Moses assumed greatness before Pharaoh and in the land of Egypt because he resumed his task excitedly. The cup of greatness only fits well on the heads of servants. Remain a servant at heart to maintain your position on the throne. God does not anoint masters; He only anoints servants. Psalm 89:20 says, “I have found my servant David and with my holy oil have I anointed him”

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a heart of a servant in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I give my best to every task!

entries.title: Supernatural Makeover!
entries.summary: One of these days, you will wake up in the robes of a king in Jesus Name! My dear brother/sister, in every pain, there is a hidden gain. The challenges of life must never cause you to give up.
entries.key_scripture_text: Vrs. 41 “ And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, see, I have set thee over all the Lord of Egypt”.

blocks.text: One of these days, you will wake up in the robes of a king in Jesus Name! My dear brother/sister, in every pain, there is a hidden gain. The challenges of life must never cause you to give up. Whenever you are down to nothing, God is surely up to something. In world today, most Christians are looking for slight things to backslide.

Look at the story of Joseph critically. Many Christians of today would easily backslide if they are to experience what this young man went through. Joseph was a dreamer. In fact, all the dreams pointed to one fact “that one day he will be a ruler and a great man”. However, what he went through did not look at it all. His own brothers conspired and sold him as a slave to the Israelites and he finally landed in Egypt. In Egypt, Potiphar’s wife again put him into trouble which landed him into prison. My God, how can a “future ruler” become a “present prisoner?”

You must know this in life, “your prison can be a blessing in disguise”. Do you know that testimonies are borne out of tests and without a battle there is no victory? One day in Gen.41, Pharaoh dreamt and no one could explain the dream. Only one man could give the interpretation and that man was a prisoner called Joseph. After Joseph interpreted the dream, Pharaoh was too enthused with his wisdom that he made him the next in command. Today, notwithstanding what you are going through, I see God taking you out of your prison into your palace. Maybe your story is bitter but your glory will be better!!!

entries.prayer: O Lord, do in my life and career, whatever good you did for Joseph, in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I shall surely experience my Greater glory!

entries.title: Take Advantage of Your Adversities
entries.summary: There is one major truth you must embrace in the journey of life; you can put a good man down but you can never keep him down. That is why our Lord and Master Jesus Christ could not be detained by the powers of the grave.
entries.key_scripture_text: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

blocks.text: There is one major truth you must embrace in the journey of life; you can put a good man down but you can never keep him down. That is why our Lord and Master Jesus Christ could not be detained by the powers of the grave. After His crucifixion, He resurrected on the third day. Acts 2:24 says, ‘Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.’

Never allow problems to remain with you. Through the empowerment of the Holy Spirit, quickly convert them into programmes that will result into progress. Challenges and problems are catalysts for progress; they are scaffolds you can step on to move to your next level.

Always learn to take advantage of adversities to make advancements. When the devil declares that it is the end for you; declare back to him that it can’t be the end; it is rather a bend. Look beyond your problems to go beyond. Think ahead of the challenges if you really want to emerge as the head in life.

You must be like Isaac, don’t let strife and contentions hold you down - Gen. 26:1-14. In spite of the contentions, he persevered until he got to his Rehoboth, a place where God made room for him to be fruitful. Wherever there is a strife, you drive on to thrive forward.
From today; nothing you face in the journey of your life will hold you down in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to persevere and win in spite of my challenges in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: Nothing will ever hold me down again!

entries.title: Don’t Barter Away Your Destiny
entries.summary: In our world today, most people major in the minors and minor in the majors. This generation usually values the trivial and treats the important with contempt. As Isaac’s firstborn son, Esau was entitled to the birthright and inheritance.
entries.key_scripture_text: Then Jacob said, “Swear to me this day.” So he swore to him, and he sold his birthright to Jacob. Then Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. Then he ate and drank, arose, and went his way. Thus Esau despised his birthright.

blocks.text: In our world today, most people major in the minors and minor in the majors. This generation usually values the trivial and treats the important with contempt. As Isaac’s firstborn son, Esau was entitled to the birthright and inheritance. The birth right, which was a preserve of the firstborn simply meant that the owner of it was to experience a double-portion of his father’s inheritance. However, we do not speak of “Abraham, Isaac, and Esau.” Esau sold his birthright for just one meal. When Jacob offered food and asked for his birthright, Esau could have said, “No! It is not for sale, I will never sell my birthright” but he did not. He sold out the eternal for a moment’s temporal satisfaction.
Beloved, you were bought with a price--the precious Blood of Christ. Nothing in you or what you have is for sale. You and everything about you belongs to Jesus.

The devil will offer you monetary satisfaction as he reaches for your birthright. He will tell you it is all right to lie, steal, fornicate, have a side-chick apart from your wife, keep your tithe, all right to keep your offering and satisfy the lusts of the flesh and of this world. He will tempt you to sell your Kingdom commitment for monetary pleasure. He’ll encourage you to barter away your salvation and your godly inheritance. Resist the devil’s counsel. Like Daniel and his friends purposed in their hearts not to defile themselves with the king’s meat; NEVER SELL YOUR BIRTHRIGHT as a child of God.

entries.prayer: O Lord, always keep me from falling in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never sacrifice the ultimate for the immediate!

entries.title: You Need Good and Proper Feeding
entries.summary: In life, what you eat will determine whether you grow well or not. That is why when you take in a lot of protein-based foods and you begin to put on some weight people will begin to ask you the common rhetorical question, ‘What have you been eating’?
entries.key_scripture_text: Your words were found, and I ate them, And Your word was to me the joy and rejoicing of my heart; For I am called by Your name, O LORD God of hosts.

blocks.text: In life, what you eat will determine whether you grow well or not. That is why when you take in a lot of protein-based foods and you begin to put on some weight people will begin to ask you the common rhetorical question, ‘What have you been eating’? Such people obviously know that, you are growing well because you are feeding well!
Good and proper feeding is essential for your survival. In as much as our bodies need to feed well in order to grow, our spirits also need the Word of God in order to live and function well.

The goodness, fatness and strength of a soul are knowledge determined. That is why III John 2 says ‘Beloved, I wish above all things that you may prosper and be in health even as your soul prospers’. Your physical prosperity is therefore dependent on how well you feed your spirit.

If the spirit is not fed well it will be lean and famish in the end. Prov.19:2 says, ‘Also it is not good for a soul to be without knowledge...’ Life is enriched by feeding it. Feeding determines weight and weight is what measures the impact one will make.

Feeding is a personal responsibility we must accept. When Jeremiah located the Word, he had to take the responsibility of eating it. Jeremiah 15: 16 says ‘Your words were found, and I ate them, And Your word was to me the joy and rejoicing of my heart; For I am called by Your name, O LORD God of hosts.’

No one can develop your spirit for you. You have decide to daily fill yourself with the Word of God through the process of quality meditation. The Words you hide in your heart are what you will give out in times of crisis. Therefore, feed well to live well!

entries.prayer: O Lord, increase my appetite for Your Word in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I love feeding on the Word!

entries.title: The Power to Start
entries.summary: Most people think that their greatest challenge is the oppositions and confrontations they are facing in their destiny. Others also think it their background that is their impediment.
entries.key_scripture_text: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

blocks.text: Most people think that their greatest challenge is the oppositions and confrontations they are facing in their destiny. Others also think it their background that is their impediment. There is also another group of people who think that they are not advancing in life because of their colour, race or ethnic group.

However, what you must understand is that, none of the afore- mentioned factors is potent enough to stop your advancement. It is not oppositions or confrontation but the STRENGTH TO START that is the greatest challenge to the advancement of a person.

There is no stopping to a starter. Once you can start you find yourself just going on into victory from victory. Anyone who can overcome starting will in all probability overcome oppositions on the way.

Whenever, you receive a vision or a dream from God, you must start running with it as soon as possible. Habakkuk 2:2 says, ‘And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.’

An average plan that is acted upon is better than an excellent plan on which nothing is done. Always take steps no matter how small towards the realization of every vision that God has given you. Small steps is better than no steps. Start that business, start that building, start writing that book etc.
If you can make the first move, your miracle will draw closer to you. Receive the power to start in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me the grace to always take the right steps in life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always make the right moves!

entries.title: How to Change Your Life for the Better
entries.summary: The imagination of man is the limit of man. This is because you are a direct product of your thoughts; YOU EITHER RISE OR FALL BASED ON THE CONDITION OF YOUR MIND.
entries.key_scripture_text: And the LORD said, “Indeed the people are one and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do; now nothing that they propose to do will be withheld from them.

blocks.text: The imagination of man is the limit of man. This is because you are a direct product of your thoughts; YOU EITHER RISE OR FALL BASED ON THE CONDITION OF YOUR MIND.

Things come to us only as we imagine them hence they can never be restrained from us. Genesis 11:6 says , ’And the LORD said, “Indeed the people are one and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do; now nothing that they propose to do will be withheld from them.’ God said He can do nothing to man’s imagination. He reckons, respects and honors your imagination.

So, imagine broadly. Nurture great thoughts; NOBODY WILL CHARGE YOU FOR THINKING BIG! Let your imagination soar beyond your self- imposed limitations. Envision unrestrictedly. Think as if nothing can stop it from coming to pass and indeed with God on your side He will do exceedingly and abundantly above all that you ask or think (Ephesians 3:20)

Your thoughts have power – Proverbs 23:7. They have power over your body. They have power over your abilities. They have power over your life. If you want to make small incremental improvements in your life, change your behaviour. But if you want to make dramatic, quantum leaps in your life, change your beliefs. Your money problems for instance are mind problems and the first mind problem is your core beliefs about yourself. The poor have a mind-set of smallness. God wants to give them more but their minds can’t handle the blessings.

“People do not attract that which they want, but that which they think they are.” Your picture of yourself isn’t just a picture. It’s a photograph of the future. Get a new picture of who you are by actually changing your thought life. John Johnson said, ‘Men and women are not limited by the place of their birth, nor by the colour of their skin, but by the size of their hope.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, fill my mind with great and positive thoughts in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I have a mind-set of greatness!

entries.title: The Faith That Wins — Part 1
entries.summary: Faith is the principal instrument of breakthrough in every endeavour of life. It is what beautifies destinies and adds colour to the dignity of believers. It is the critical factor that influences every man’s status.
entries.key_scripture_text: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

blocks.text: Faith is the principal instrument of breakthrough in every endeavour of life. It is what beautifies destinies and adds colour to the dignity of believers. It is the critical factor that influences every man’s status. Faith is not just a mere confession; it is a great profession. It is the wisdom of God you need to get to your place of glory and honour in Christ. Everything about God and your destiny begins with faith. Furthermore, the foundation of every vision and its fulfilment anchor on faith.

Without faith it is impossible to move God, and when you cannot move Him, it becomes absolutely impossible to receive anything from Him. Heb. 11:6. So, without faith there is no future in your future.

Moreover, victory becomes a way of life when faith is actively at work in you . Contrary to the world’s belief system which places emphasis on dreams, goals and self which in turn subjected man to various destructive tendencies; absolute faith in God is what makes the journey of life great. The Bible makes this clear in Jeremiah 17:5- 8, “... Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the Lord. For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh... Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is...” Beloved, without faith you are bound to fail. Jesus said to Peter, “I’ve prayed for you that thy faith faileth not.” Lk. 22:32. That means you and I don’t have any future without faith. There is a kind of faith that gives you an upper hand in the battles of life and ensures all-round victory no matter what we face in life. Faith is the key that opens the door of victory. Victory becomes a way of life when faith is actively at work in you.
Ephesians 6:16 says, ‘16 Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, baptize me with a fresh Spirit of faith in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am winning by faith!

entries.title: The Faith That Wins — Part 2
entries.summary: Faith is a winning force; it is the highest exponent in the equation of victory. The following are the attributes of the winning faith;
entries.key_scripture_text: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation

blocks.text: Faith is a winning force; it is the highest exponent in the equation of victory. The following are the attributes of the winning faith;
Winning faith is a holding faith

Sometimes, the arrows of the enemy may move towards your direction in quick succession and you may feel like giving up but what gives us victory at the end of the day is our ability to hold on to the Word. Hebrews 10:35 says, ‘ Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.’
David said in Psalm 119:49, ‘Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope’

You can simply not separate mighty men of faith from their Bibles. It doesn’t matter what they face, they use the Word to achieve the needed victory. They hold on to the Word even when everything and everyone is against them.

One of the mighty men of David was called Eleazar. One day in the midst of a battle against the Philistines he grew weary but he held on to the sword until he achieved a great victory for Israel - II Samuel 23:8-10, ‘8 ¶ These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-Basshebeth the Tachmonite, chief among the captains. He was called Adino the Eznite, because he had killed eight hundred men at one time. 9 And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there for battle, and the men of Israel had retreated.10 He arose and attacked the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand stuck to the sword. The LORD brought about a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to plunder.’

Like Eleazer, Christians who want to win by faith must learn to hold on to their swords (the Word of God) until the needed victory is achieved. There is a great victory awaiting you if you can hold on to God’s Word to the end!

entries.prayer: O Lord, uproot every seed of discouragement from my heart in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am enjoying great victories!

entries.title: The Faith That Wins — Part 3
entries.summary: Prayer is to men of faith as oxygen is to their bodies. They know that they cannot survive in this journey of life without the strength and help of God and they secure these through the medium of prayer.

blocks.text: Faith is the password to the world of unending triumph. When faith becomes your habit, victory will definitely become your lifestyle . Another attribute of the winning faith is prayer.
Winning faith is a praying faith

Prayer is to men of faith as oxygen is to their bodies. They know that they cannot survive in this journey of life without the strength and help of God and they secure these through the medium of prayer. They change the negative events of their home, family, communities and nations through the prayer of faith. Luke 18:1 says, ‘...Men always ought to pray and not to faint.
Elijah and Elisha were always standing before God in prayer. No wonder they were great men of faith.

I Kings 17:1, ‘1 ¶ And Elijah the Tishbite, of the inhabitants of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD God of Israel lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, except at my word.”
II Kings 3:14 And Elisha said, “As the LORD of hosts lives, before whom I stand, surely were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you, nor see you.

II Kings 5: 16 But he said, “As the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will receive nothing.” And he urged him to take it, but he refused. Prayerful men are faith-filled men. Whenever you read the Word of God and you receive a revelation, turn it into a prayer point. When you are sick, the Bible says that the PRAYER OF FAITH can bring you healing. Jas 5:15 And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
In every area of life, the prayer of faith can bring you the needed victory.

entries.prayer: O Lord, repair my prayer altar in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always pray through for my breakthroughs!

entries.title: The Faith That Wins — Part 4
entries.summary: When faith stands up, every negative storm in your life goes down. The other attributes of the winning faith are;
entries.key_scripture_text: 11 ¶ Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree. 12 Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.

blocks.text: When faith stands up, every negative storm in your life goes down. The other attributes of the winning faith are;
Winning faith is a seeing faith

When it comes to the school of faith, what you must understand is that your sight will determine your size. IF YOU CAN SEE WELL, YOU WILL END WELL. That is why when God wanted to strengthen the faith of Abraham, he re-ordered his focus by giving him new pictures. He wanted him to see the future in the present. Abraham was given the vision of his children as numerous as the dust and the stars of Heaven. God made him meditate on the vision that He was implanting into his spirit day and night. In the daytime he meditated on the dust. In the night- time he meditated on the stars. Day and night God caused him to meditate and visualize on what He wanted to do in his life. No wonder in the long run what was a mere promise became a fulfilment - Gen. 13:16 “I will make your descendants as the dust of the earth; so that if one can count the dust of the earth, your descendants also can be counted. In Gen. 15:5 Look toward heaven, and number the stars, if you are able to number them.” Then He said to him, “So shall your descendants be.” 4. Winning faith is speaking faith

Heb. 3:1 Therefore, holy brethren, who share in a heavenly call, consider Jesus, the apostle and high priest of our confession. Heb. 4:14 Since then we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, he lets us hold fast our confession. See every time Jesus is mentioned as a high priest, our confession is mentioned. Jesus takes what you confess and say it out to the Father. Your words can truly change your world. Three times in Mark 11: 23, when Jesus was teaching on faith, He emphasized on what you say. Verse 23 Truly, I say to you, whoever says (that is the first time the word say comes) to this mountain, “Be taken up and cast into the sea,” and does not doubt in his heart, but believe that that what he says (second time) will come to pass, it will be done for him (he will have whatever he says {the third time} in place of it will be done for him.)

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to see and speak only the right things in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will surely end well!

entries.title: The Faith That Wins — Part 5
entries.summary: Faith is an overcoming force; it subdues the enemies of our destinies. Today, we want to learn the last attribute of the winning faith.
entries.key_scripture_text: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

blocks.text: Faith is an overcoming force; it subdues the enemies of our destinies. Today, we want to learn the last attribute of the winning faith.
Winning faith is an acting faith

Faith without action is fake. Faith is not just a fact but more importantly an act. Positive action is a clear evidence of faith at work. The Bible tells us that “Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet ... prepared an ark to the saving of his house...” Heb. 11:7. Also, when Abraham was called of God, by faith he obeyed and departed. Gen. 12:1-4. Furthermore, the Bible says, “Above all, taking the shield of faith, where with ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.” Eph. 6:16. So, faith is a weapon of war. In order to obtain the breakthrough you desire, you have to put the weapon to good use. Until you fight, you can’t win! The kingdom of God suffereth violence, and the violent takes it by force. That force is the force of faith. When you engage in a faith battle, it is a good fight, because the end will be favourable to you. 1 Jn. 5:4.
James 2:20 also says But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
Faith must not just be spoken but also acted. Jesus Christ did not just hear about the faith of the friends of the paralytic but He also SAW THEIR FAITH THROUGH THEIR ACTION.

Mark 1:1-5, ‘1 ¶ And again He entered Capernaum after some days, and it was heard that He was in the house. 2 Immediately many gathered together, so that there was no longer room to receive them, not even near the door. And He preached the word to them. 3 Then they came to Him, bringing a paralytic who was carried by four men.4 And when they could not come near Him because of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where He was. So when they had broken through, they let down the bed on which the paralytic was lying. 5 When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.” For instance, if you want a car, go to the driving school and acquire a drivers’ licence and very soon your car will come; when you need a baby, get a baby court and very soon you will hear the cry of a baby in your house. THE MORE FAITH STEPS YOU TAKE, THE CLOSER YOU WILL BE TO YOUR DESIRED MIRACLE.

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me never to give-up in life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always take giant steps of faith!

entries.title: How to Remain at the Top
entries.summary: Never care for accolades; for entitlements are not in titles. Never seek for rewards. Never be bothered about who appreciates or do not appreciate you or your works.
entries.key_scripture_text: 1 ¶ Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee: 2 And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

blocks.text: Never care for accolades; for entitlements are not in titles. Never seek for rewards. Never be bothered about who appreciates or do not appreciate you or your works.
Just keep reaching out and touching lives. Your reward is sure to come. The lives you touch are the ones that will keep spreading the values of your life, career and ministry
Leadership is about people and not position. A leader’s heartbeat is how to bless people.

You lose nothing blessing people especially the upcoming ones or the next generation. You will never go down raising others. You don’t get erased raising others. You rather get elevated doing so. Blessing others is sowing seeds into your future. In life what you do for others today is a seed; what is done to you by others tomorrow is your harvest.

You will find it there waiting for you as you gravitate towards the future. Serve as a leader who keeps elevating others and you will never find yourself going down. Be a person who keeps blessing and helping others and God will never stop blessing and helping you.

Be a linkage to the lifting of others and you will become an unforgettable reference point to them. God doesn’t just want to bless you; He wants you more importantly to become a blessing to your generation.

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a generous heart in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am a blessing to my generation!
