entries.title: How to Experience the Glory of Tomorrow
entries.summary: Beloved, the past has a great influence on the outcome of your future. Your past can affect your present destiny and imprison your future. YOUR PAST CAN BE LIKE GOALIATH AND STAND IN THE WAY OF YOUR FUTURE.
entries.key_scripture_text: Brethren, I do not count myself to have apprehended; but one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind and reaching forward to those things which are ahead

blocks.text: Beloved, the past has a great influence on the outcome of your future. Your past can affect your present destiny and imprison your future. YOUR PAST CAN BE LIKE GOALIATH AND STAND IN THE WAY OF YOUR FUTURE. If care is not taken the arrows received from the past can render your tomorrow impotent. That is why, you must seriously deal with your past if you want to move forward and succeed in life. Paul said in Philippians 3:13, ‘ Brethren, I do not count myself to have apprehended; but one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind and reaching forward to those things which are ahead,’
The life of a man is divided into three stages
Your yesterday/ Your Past
Your today/ Your Present
Your tomorrow/ Your Future

Yesterday is a total embodiment of your past. Today is a description of what is happening in your life at the moment. The future is a promissory note. There is no human being who has power over the past, present and future. There is no great man anywhere who can control the past, the present and the future. There is not much anyone can do about the past. The realities of today are difficult to handle. The future is so unpredictable that no one can have a firm grip of it.

But beloved, I have good news for you. There is Someone who can take absolute control of your past, your present and your future. The Bible declares; Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever (Hebrews 13:8). Learn to forge ahead and never allow your past to imprison you.

entries.prayer: By the Blood of Jesus and by the fire of God, I shall not carry over any evil thing from my past in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I see a great future ahead of me!

entries.title: How to Magnetize Good Things
entries.summary: The excited in life is always an attraction to many. It is only cheerful people who are able to build fruitful relationships in the journey of life. The more excited you are the more an attraction you become.
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

blocks.text: The excited in life is always an attraction to many. It is only cheerful people who are able to build fruitful relationships in the journey of life. The more excited you are the more an attraction you become.

No one ever wants to be with an unexcited person. There is never a meeting point between the excited and the dullard. No man will like to marry a lady who looks always depressed. As a married man or woman, you must always look cheerful if you really want to experience a fruitful marriage. Excitement is magnet to good things.

Joseph went through a lot of negative experiences. He could have allowed all those bad experiences to make him sad and unexcited about life. However, he decided to always remain cheerful. In the house of Potiphar, he was the most cheerful servant. No wonder Potiphar made him the chief servant. Again, in the prison, he was the most cheerful prisoner. No wonder the prison warder made him the head of the prisoner. Finally, his cheerful outlook caused him to become the Prime Minister of Egypt.

Is your marriage dying? Then try the medicine of cheerfulness (Proverbs 17:22). Are you failing in all your relationships? Then try the virtue of cheerfulness (Prov. 18:24). THE CHEERFUL PERSON WILL EVENTUALLY BECOME THE MOST FRUITFUL PERSON. From today, ALWAYS TAKE THE MEDICINE OF JOY DAILY AND YOU WILL BE GOOD TO GO!

entries.prayer: O Lord, baptize me with the oil of joy in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: The joy of the Lord is my strength!

entries.title: How to Move from Strength to Strength
entries.summary: You must develop an unquenchable love for the House of God if your desire is to grow in the spirit. In life, it is your company that determines your accomplishments and your companions direct your opinions.
entries.key_scripture_text: Vr.7 “They go from strength to strength ;everyone of them in zion appeareth before God

blocks.text: You must develop an unquenchable love for the House of God if your desire is to grow in the spirit. In life, it is your company that determines your accomplishments and your companions direct your opinions.

It is therefore important to be in the right company in order to make the right progress in the area of spiritual growth. Therefore, going to church always is vital for your spiritual survival and growth.

The Church is a community of fellow sinners saved by the Grace of God and called to walk alongside and help each other. Just as a student has no hope of getting to the university, If he or she doesn’t join a school, so does a baby Christian has no hope of growing in the Lord and getting to Heaven if he or she doesn’t go to church (Heb. 10:25)

Beloved, there is joy in the House of the Lord (Psalm 122:1). In the right church; You will have fellowship with God (1 Cor 1:9) and you will have fellowship with other believers and grow together with them (Acts 2:42).

Again, it is in the church that God’s leaders, prepare you for the work of service until we grow into the full stature of God (Eph. 4:12). The worship, the encouragement, the prayer and other ministration all help you to move from one level of spiritual strength to another (Psalm 84:7).

Psalm 92:13 says, “Those that be planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of God.” You must never be forced to go to Church. You must gladly find a Bible-believing church and attend regularly. As you get planted in such a church, you will surely begin to grow in the spirit on a consistent basis.

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me never to forsake the assembly og the saints in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am moving from strength to strength!

entries.title: The True Value of a Man
entries.summary: Work moves people forward. Those who work don’t see other peoples’ back because their work makes them second to none. The ant has no guide yet it advances. No one supervises the tiny ant yet he is able to advance its destiny into the land of plenty.
entries.key_scripture_text: 6 ¶ Go to the ant, you sluggard! Consider her ways and be wise, 7 Which, having no captain, Overseer or ruler, 8 Provides her supplies in the summer, And gathers her food in the harvest

blocks.text: Work moves people forward. Those who work don’t see other peoples’ back because their work makes them second to none. The ant has no guide yet it advances. No one supervises the tiny ant yet he is able to advance its destiny into the land of plenty. Your work is your guide. Instead of looking for a guide, work your way to become one. If you are a worker, people will locate you via your work. Without work you are not traceable. Your work is your address. Work is your true and authentic identity. Idle people always line up behind workers, awaiting orders. Workers are leaders! Stop giving excuses and find something to do.

The true value of a man’s life is defined by the work of his hand . Your life is in your hand. Don’t blame anyone for your outcome, blame your hand. Speak to your hand to work hard. You are worthless without your work. If you don’t want to lose your worth, love your work. The worth of Joseph in Potiphar’s house was preceded by his work; his work gave him worth. It is your contribution that determines your relevance.

Real workers don’t think of what to take but what to contribute. A man’s real worth is not his salary but his contribution. Your contribution will earn you far more than your salary. Do not seek recognition because it is a natural sequence to contribution. Mordecai was a contributive gateman whose work spoke for him in the end. He became recognized as a result of his contribution. ( Est.2:21-23; 6:1-14; 10:1). Contribution is the passage to recognition. Proverbs 22:29 says, ‘Do you see a man who excels in his work? He will stand before kings; He will not stand before unknown men.’ Work your way forward!

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to become a diligent worker in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I diligently do my work!

entries.title: God-Addiction
entries.summary: Today, as we end our journey of developing a closer walk with God, we want to learn how to develop a closer walk with God.
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

blocks.text: Today, as we end our journey of developing a closer walk with God, we want to learn how to develop a closer walk with God.
SEPARATION IS THE KEY TO A DEDICATED AND A CLOSER WALK WITH GOD. In other words, you must move away from certain things if your desire is to have a closer walk with God.
Jacob was left alone and had a close encounter with God - Ge 32:24 ¶ And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

Daniel was left alone and God gave him great visions - Da 10:8 Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
Moses was left alone on Mount Horeb and had deep encounters with God – Mount Horeb –
Exodus 3:1, Exodus 34:1-3

Those who are always busy talking with people, watching tv, abusing social media cannot have a closer walk with God. You must separate yourself from these things to read the Bible, pray, fast and read anointed books if you want to have a closer walk with God.
Prayer and the Study of the Word increases your spiritual authority and power.

entries.prayer: O Lord, may nothing separate me from You in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always long for more of God!

entries.title: Experiencing the Abundant Life
entries.summary: The abundant life is the heritage and the redemptive right of every child of God (John 10:10). God wants to bless us to a level that we will not have enough room to contain it.
entries.key_scripture_text: 5 You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over. 6 Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the LORD Forever.

blocks.text: The abundant life is the heritage and the redemptive right of every child of God (John 10:10). God wants to bless us to a level that we will not have enough room to contain it. Instead of material shortages, God wants you enjoy financial packages; instead of poverty, He wants to give you prosperity; instead of scarcity, He wants to give you plenty; instead of begging and borrowing, God wants you to be lending out to the nations of the world. However, to terminate the roots of material shortage, you must deal with its roots. At the root of material shortage is spiritual dryness; when your spirit is dry, your pocket will automatically be dry.

Running over blessing is an outcome of anointing.“...thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over” – Psalm 23:4 Your problem is not an enemy but the absence of oil. Ps.23:5. This is because in spite of the devil, you can live in abundance. Those who seek the outpouring of the spirit are never in short of blessing. Is.44:3 says, ‘For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, And floods on the dry ground; I will pour My Spirit on your descendants, And My blessing on your offspring;’
Freshness of the oil attracts favour for continuous supplies. In 1 Sam.10:1, 3-4, after Saul was anointed, he met people who liberally provided for his needs.

Spirituality was platform for material abundance in the first church - Act.4:29-34. This year, don’t joke with your spiritual life; pray more, feed on the word, fast regularly, attend every Church service, win souls and see how you will swim in the ocean of God’s blessings.

entries.prayer: O Lord, let me be rooted and grounded in you in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am rooted in God, I cannot lack!

entries.title: The Greatest Threat to Christianity
entries.summary: The greatest threat to Christianity is Christians trying to make it to Heaven without doing anything for God. In life, we are owners of nothing but stewards of everything. Stewardship a call to labour.
entries.key_scripture_text: 1 ¶ After these things the Lord appointed seventy others also, and sent them two by two before His face into every city and place where He Himself was about to go. 2 Then He said to them, “The harvest truly is great, but the laborers are few; therefore pray the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest.

blocks.text: The greatest threat to Christianity is Christians trying to make it to Heaven without doing anything for God. In life, we are owners of nothing but stewards of everything. Stewardship a call to labour. We are not just workers but labourers in the kingdom.
Jesus called labourers (fishers of men) - Matt.4:19

Jesus prayed for labourers because without an abundant supply of labourers the Kingdom of God cannot spread - Matt.9:37-38. The harvest demands labourers. If you are not prepared to labour, you are not fit to be a steward in this kingdom.
Only labours have reward. Lk.10:7
Only labourers are paid. Heb.6:10
Only labourers can be steadfast – 1 Cor.15:58
It is labourers that are favoured. Ps.102:13,14
What is Labour?
It is exerting force on your duty.
It is investing time into a project
It is expending energy on your assignment.
It is sweating to see your job done.
A labourer is one who does the least of work (dust) in this kingdom. You must do something for God this year. The most authentic route to greatness is servant hood.

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to work hard for the advancement of Your Kingdom in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never stop doing God’s work!

entries.title: Don’t Withdraw When the Battle-Line Is Drawn
entries.summary: Most people fail in life not because they lack knowledge or talent but because they quit. When problems seem insurmountable, quitting may look like the easiest way out. It is true for every marriage, ministry, job and relationship.
entries.key_scripture_text: 1 ¶ Therefore we also, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which so easily ensnares us, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, 2 looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

blocks.text: Most people fail in life not because they lack knowledge or talent but because they quit. When problems seem insurmountable, quitting may look like the easiest way out. It is true for every marriage, ministry, job and relationship. The lack of persistence is the trait of losers. Life is a race and in the race of life we run with endurance. Even Jesus Christ had to endure the pains of the cross in order that He might obtain the joy that was set before Him (Hebrews 12:1-2).

The Apostle Paul was a man who run with endurance. In spite of all the challenges He faced in life, he still did not give up. In II Corinthians 4:8-9, he wrote, ‘8 ¶ We are hard pressed on every side, yet not crushed; we are perplexed, but not in despair; 9 persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed’. At the end of the journey of his life; the Apostle Paul emerged victorious in spite of all the odds he faced - In II Timothy 4:7-8, he said triumphantly ‘ I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.8 Finally, there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give to me on that Day, and not to me only but also to all who have loved His appearing.’
In life, never withdraw even when the battle line is drawn. Like David, muster courage and face off the giants of your life.
Ralph Waldo Emerson said, ‘A man is a hero not because he is braver than anyone else, but because he is brave for ten minutes longer’.

The Holy Spirit wants me to tell a Fresh Fire user today to hold on a little longer; never give up because you are at the edge of your miracle. Your night will be over soon; there is light waiting for you at the end of the tunnel. Run with endurance!

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me the spirit of persistence in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never withdraw even when the battle-line is drawn!

entries.title: See the Future!
entries.summary: It takes a cause not to faint – II Cor.4:16-17.If you don’t have a cause you are pursuing you will be wearied and faint in no time. If you are in pursuit of inner renewal, will be least bordered that the outward man is perishing.
entries.key_scripture_text: 16 For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.17 For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

blocks.text: It takes a cause not to faint – II Cor.4:16-17.If you don’t have a cause you are pursuing you will be wearied and faint in no time. If you are in pursuit of inner renewal, will be least bordered that the outward man is perishing.
When you know what awaits you in the future, you are
never wearied of doing what is right in the present. Future
consciousness is motivation to present action.

Keeping in view what awaits you is the strength of your waiting. Understanding what awaits you will naturally motivate you to keep waiting. Consciousness of gains awaiting you is what keeps your eyes off pending pains. If you see the gain you don’t feel the pains. This is because, you are sure the pains will soon culminate in gain. Pain doesn’t last; it is gain that endures.

Pain soon fades but gain will make you shine. Your renewal stops when you get wearied. If you faint, your harvest will certainly fail. The Bible says of Jesus in Hebrews 12:2, ‘Who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross despising the shame.’
In this year, keep your focus on the prize; don’t be distracted by trivialities. There is no price too high to pay for your vision and mission. Refuse to give up; never faint!

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a fighting spirit in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never lose heart; I see a bright future ahead of me!

entries.title: How to Sweat Less in Life
entries.summary: Acombination of Holy Spirit and human Spirit is what makes an excellent destiny. What man can do for himself; God will never do for him. Planning is as potent as prayer.
entries.key_scripture_text: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.

blocks.text: Acombination of Holy Spirit and human Spirit is what makes an excellent destiny. What man can do for himself; God will never do for him. Planning is as potent as prayer. This is because God does not only act according to your prayers but He equally acts according to your thinking. Ephesians 3:20 says “Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ASK OR THINK, according to the power that worketh in us,” ‘Asking’ is praying but ‘thinking’ is planning and God answers them both.

Failure to plan is planning to fail. Every successful venture in life must be preceded by proper planning otherwise it will end as a bitter adventure. It is success in planning that leads to success in life. Listen to Jesus Christ Himself in Luke 14:28-30, “For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it? Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him, Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.”

You will sweat less when you plan well. Every great builder is first and foremost a great planner .Every vision works (unfolds) by planning .The secret trade mark of an enterprise is strategy, planning. Effect is not in noise but planning. There is no accident success; you plan for it.
Planning comes via thinking and writing and the major raw material for planning is the right knowledge. Begin to plan well if you really want to end well in life.

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to plan my life very well in Jesus name!
entries.confession: I am a serious planner; my destiny shall be a glorious one!

entries.title: How Things Grow Worse
entries.summary: Laziness is a common trait among many people especially the youth. You must however be a hardworker if you want to be a highflier in life. It is better to wear out working than to rust off idling.
entries.key_scripture_text: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.

blocks.text: Laziness is a common trait among many people especially the youth. You must however be a hardworker if you want to be a highflier in life. It is better to wear out working than to rust off idling. Idleness leads to rust, doing nothing is the easiest way to decay. In fact, everything grows worse without work
God commands us to work with our hands and to be diligent workers.
1Th 4:11 And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
Eph 4:28 Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth
Proverbs 22:29 ¶ Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

Working simply means releasing energy to produce a desired change. Time will remain effectively useful only as long as it is in motion. So don’t stop working if you don’t want to waste off. Abraham was a giver, a tither and a worker and at the end of the day God blessed him in all things (Gen. 24:1). The prosperity covenant contains details; if you don’t mind the details you will be detained on the same spot and you will move in circles in life. Stop idling and start working because God has promised to bless all the work of your hands. From today, WHATSOEVER YOU DO SHALL PROSPER IN JESUS NAME!

entries.prayer: O Lord, deliver me from the spiri of laziness in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I hate idleness!

entries.title: Fruitfulness Is Your Destiny
entries.summary: Fruitfulness is God’s original design for every person. Genesis 1:27-28 says, “So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
entries.key_scripture_text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.

blocks.text: Fruitfulness is God’s original design for every person. Genesis 1:27-28 says, “So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.”

You are a product of God and he has His signature on you (which is fruitfulness). Therefore by God’s design, your fruitfulness is non- negotiable, it is necessity - It is in your DNA.The ability to be fruitful has been placed inside you but the actualization of your fruitfulness is based on your knowledge - Hos.4:6. Your ability to believe in the manufacturer is based on the capacity of knowledge you have acquired from your “product manual” = The Bible.

Knowledge gives birth to faith. Romans 10:17 says, “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.” Faith gives birth to results. That is why I John 5:4 also says, “For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.”

Ignorance is an unaffordable luxury. One great man said, “There is no mountain anywhere; every man’s mountain is his own ignorance. Do you desire victory in any area of your life? Do you want to be fruitful? Do you want your reproach to come to an end? If your answers to the above questions is Yes; then begin to seek knowledge from God’s Word and other anointed and impactful books from today. You will be fruitful in Jesus name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, increase my appetite for the right knowledge in Jesus name!
entries.confession: I am fruitful in all I do!

entries.title: Be God-Focused! — Part 1
entries.summary: To grow in success in life, you must be God focused and not work or career focused. You must do everything to develop an unbreakable relationship with God if you really desire to have a lasting success.
entries.key_scripture_text: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect. And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

blocks.text: To grow in success in life, you must be God focused and not work or career focused. You must do everything to develop an unbreakable relationship with God if you really desire to have a lasting success.

Focus on the Caller more than the calling; the Giver of the gifts more than the gifts; the Benefactor more than the benefits; the Worker more than the work; on your walk with Him more than your work for Him. Activity for Him must never replace intimacy with Him.

Knowing God is crucial to developing greater impact in life. Dan.11:32 says, “...but the people that do KNOW THEIR GOD shall be strong and do exploits.” In everything you are doing as a citizen of God’s Kingdom, you are representing God. However, you cannot represent well a God you don’t know well. Therefore rather than seeking success in life, we should endeavor to seek deeper relationship with God.
All who made impact in ministry sought first a deeper relationship with Him.
- Abraham – Genesis 17:1-2
- Moses - Exodus: 33:13-18
- David - Ps.63:1-3
- Paul - Phil.3:10

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to know You better in Jesus name!
entries.confession: I am a God-chaser!

entries.title: Be God-Focused — Part 2
entries.summary: In the journey of Christianity, many start but few are able to finish. Like any other race, if you lose focus, you will not emerge victorious at the end of the day. In the race of Christianity, our FOCUS IS JESUS CHRIST.
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ Therefore we also, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which so easily ensnares us, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, 2 looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

blocks.text: In the journey of Christianity, many start but few are able to finish. Like any other race, if you lose focus, you will not emerge victorious at the end of the day. In the race of Christianity, our FOCUS IS JESUS CHRIST. If we fail to look unto Him we will not be able to finish the race at the end of the day.

In our generation, many people are seeking the peripherals and have neglected the main thing. Instead of the Blesser, we just seek the blessing; instead of the Giver of the gifts, we just seek after the gifts; instead of the Benefactor, we just seek the benefits; instead of the Manufacturer, we just seek the products; instead of the Director, we just seek direction; instead of the Presence of God, we just settle for the promises of God; and instead of the FACE OF GOD, we just seek the Hand of God.

But there was something about Moses, he was not satisfied with anything but the FACE OF GOD. Moses knew that God’s favour flows where His face shows. Exodus 33:18-19, ‘18 And he said, “Please, show me Your glory.” 19 Then He said, “I will make all My goodness pass before you, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.”
From today, let the Presence of God be your daily delight.

entries.prayer: O Lord, show me Your face in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I desire only God!

entries.title: Be God-Focused! — Part 3
entries.summary: Beloved, you can seek after things and miss God at the end of the day but when you seek after God, the things will follow. You must only be satisfied when you wake up in the likeness of God; all of God must be on you.
entries.key_scripture_text: As for me, I will see Your face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied when I awake in Your likeness.

blocks.text: Beloved, you can seek after things and miss God at the end of the day but when you seek after God, the things will follow. You must only be satisfied when you wake up in the likeness of God; all of God must be on you.

However, for you to be a carrier of the tangible and the visible Presence of God; you must first die to self. The flesh and all its desires must be crucified. The lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes and the pride of life must die for Christ to live fully in you. When Moses asked God to show him His face; God made a simple but a profound statement in Exodus 33:20, ’ But He said, “You cannot see My face; for no man shall see Me, and live.”

God was simply telling Moses, ‘Before you can see Me, every flesh in you must die because only dead men can see God. The flesh must be crucified. That is why Moses only saw God after death on the Mount of Transfiguration when He saw Jesus face to face (Matthew 17).

Again, the Apostle Paul who had many dumbfounding revelations of God said in Galatians2:20, ‘I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.’ Beloved, stop flirting with the world if you really want to see Jesus! Surrender your body, soul and spirit to the Almighty God. When you see His face you will always shine in the journey of life and shame will never knock on your door. Psalm 34: 5 says, ‘They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces were not ashamed.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, kill my love for the things of the world in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: God is my obsession!

entries.title: The Best Helping Hand
entries.summary: Winston Churchill said, “Responsibility is the price for greatness”. Therefore unless you begin to take responsibility for the affairs of your life, you will die as a liability.
entries.key_scripture_text: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

blocks.text: Winston Churchill said, “Responsibility is the price for greatness”. Therefore unless you begin to take responsibility for the affairs of your life, you will die as a liability.

Don’t expect anybody to live your life for you; that is irresponsibility. Somebody may start you up but no one can keep you on. For instance; there are some children who always want to depend on their parents even during their adulthood.

You may be sent forth but you have to go forth. You may be imparted with grace but no one can do the going for you .Accept responsibility and begin to stir up the gift deposited into you. Although the Apostle Paul imparted a lot of gifts into Timothy through the laying on of his hands on him, he encouraged him to make good use of what he had received. That’s responsibility. II Timothy 1:6 says, ‘Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.’

Someone may hold your hands when you are taking the first step but you have to take the subsequent steps on your own. Elisha got the prophetic power mantle from Elijah but he had to strike the water by himself. The arm is only support to the hand. It cannot and never take the place of the hand. Your hand remains the best helping hand.

Accept responsibility to advance your destiny. Stop blaming others for your failures and inadequacies. In spite of your family background, other family members are making it. In spite of the poor government policies in your country; other citizens are making it. The question is “Why are you not the one making it?” The answer is simple; you are simply refusing to take responsibility for the happenings of your life.

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to live a responsible life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am living a responsible life!

entries.title: You Need Mercy!
entries.summary: The altar of prayer is the altar of Grace but the gate to the altar is MERCY. You must pass through mercy to access Grace.
entries.key_scripture_text: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

blocks.text: The altar of prayer is the altar of Grace but the gate to the altar is MERCY. You must pass through mercy to access Grace. Until you understand mercy, you cannot experience grace - Heb 4:16 says, ‘ Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.’

Beloved, until God looks at you with the eyes of mercy, you can never obtain His favour. It is an attitude of humility in prayer that guarantees answers to prayer. How you prepare before God determines what you will get from Him. Luke 18:9-14 says, ‘9 ¶ And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others: 10 Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.11 The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican. 12 I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess. 13 And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner. 14 I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.’

Don’t appear as self-righteous, proud and arrogant, holier than thou and superior to others. Always appear in humility as a beneficiary of mercy in God’s righteousness. It is an attitude of humility in prayer that guarantees answers to prayers. This is because a humble person will obtain mercy from God which will in turn cause God to favour him or her.
As we the year 2021 is getting to an end, may the Mercies of God speak for you wherever you turn in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord bombard me with Your manifold mercies in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am under the canopy of the mercies of God!

entries.title: Let Jesus Be Your Focus!
entries.summary: In the journey of Christianity, many start but few are able to finish. Like any other race, if you lose focus, you will not emerge victorious at the end of the day. In the race of Christianity, our FOCUS IS JESUS CHRIST.
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ Therefore we also, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which so easily ensnares us, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, 2 looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

blocks.text: In the journey of Christianity, many start but few are able to finish. Like any other race, if you lose focus, you will not emerge victorious at the end of the day. In the race of Christianity, our FOCUS IS JESUS CHRIST. If we fail to look unto Him we will not be able to finish the race at the end of the day. In our generation, many people are seeking the peripherals and have neglected the main thing. Instead of the Blesser, we just seek the blessing; instead of the Giver of the gifts, we just seek after the gifts; instead of the Benefactor, we just seek the benefits; instead of the Manufacturer, we just seek the products; instead of the Director, we just seek direction; instead of the Presence of God, we just settle for the promises of God; and instead of the FACE OF GOD, we just seek the Hand of God.

But there was something about Moses, he was not satisfied with anything but the FACE OF GOD. Moses knew that God’s favour flows where His face shows. Exodus 33:18-19, ‘18 And he said, “Please, show me Your glory.” 19 Then He said, “I will make all My goodness pass before you, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.”
From today, let the Presence of God be your daily delight; may Jesus Christ be your focus!

entries.prayer: O Lord, show me Your face in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: At the centre of it all, it’s Jesus Christ I see!

entries.title: The Glory of His Presence
entries.summary: Beloved, you can seek after things and miss God at the end of the day but when you seek after God, the things will follow. You must only be satisfied when you wake up in the likeness of God; all of God must be on you.
entries.key_scripture_text: As for me, I will see Your face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied when I awake in Your likeness.

blocks.text: Beloved, you can seek after things and miss God at the end of the day but when you seek after God, the things will follow. You must only be satisfied when you wake up in the likeness of God; all of God must be on you.

However, for you to be a carrier of the tangible and the visible Presence of God; you must first die to self. The flesh and all its desires must be crucified. The lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes and the pride of life must die for Christ to live fully in you. When Moses asked God to show him His face; God made a simple but a profound statement in Exodus 33:20, ’ But He said, “You cannot see My face; for no man shall see Me, and live.”

God was simply telling Moses, ‘Before you can see Me, every flesh in you must die because only dead men can see God. The flesh must be crucified. That is why Moses only saw God after death on the Mount of Transfiguration when He saw Jesus face to face (Matthew 17).

Again, the Apostle Paul who had many dumbfounding revelations of God said in Galatians2:20, ‘I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.’ Beloved, stop flirting with the world if you really want to see Jesus! Surrender your body, soul and spirit to the Almighty God. When you see His face you will always shine in the journey of life and shame will never knock on your door. Psalm 34: 5 says, ‘They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces were not ashamed.’ This is the glory of His Presence. From today, may the Presence of God be your obsession in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, kill my love for the things of the world in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I live in the glory of His Presence!

entries.title: The Sleeping Giant
entries.summary: Some people are concerned about the current darkness the world finds itself in-and I am concerned too.
entries.key_scripture_text: Wake up, O sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you’.

blocks.text: Some people are concerned about the current darkness the world finds itself in-and I am concerned too. I also know that times of trial and struggle historically bring great seasons of revival, as men and women go to their knees and cry out to God for divine wisdom and help.

Scripture says, “If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven and will forgive their sin and heal their land” (2 Chronicles 7:14).

I’ve often referred to the modern Church as a sleeping giant. This is because; many contemporary Christians don’t utilize the weapon of prayer to win the spiritual battle that is going on today. We have become like the children of Ephraim. The Bible says of them in Psalm 78:9 ,’ The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle ’ ‘ It’s time for the Church to arise! When we arise in fervent prayer, the light of God will overshadow the prevailing darkness around us.

Isaiah 60:1-2 says, “Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord rises upon you. See, darkness covers the earth and thick darkness is over the peoples, but the Lord rises upon you and his glory appears over you.” We have been called to be light to this world. “Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn” (Isaiah 60:3). Hang on! I believe we are on the verge of one of the greatest revivals the world has ever known! However, the cost-price of this revival is intense and consistent prayer. The Kingdoms of this world must become the kingdoms of our God and of His Christ; the glory of the knowledge of the Lord must cover the earth as the waters cover the sea. Let the sleeping giants awake. We will win more battles as a Church praying than complaining about the darkness around us.

entries.prayer: O Lord, stir up the spirit of prayer among Christians in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am touching the world with my prayers!

entries.title: Watch with Me!
entries.summary: Jesus asked His disciples to keep watch with Him, for His soul was crushed with grief. He was in deep agony and pain, yet His faithful few (Peter, James and John who were part of His inner circle) could not stay awake.
entries.key_scripture_text: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. ‘Could you men not keep watch with me for one hour?’ he asked Peter.

blocks.text: Jesus asked His disciples to keep watch with Him, for His soul was crushed with grief. He was in deep agony and pain, yet His faithful few (Peter, James and John who were part of His inner circle) could not stay awake. They were tired and fell asleep, leaving Christ to watch and pray alone.

Today, many believers are slumbering and sleeping when they should be watching and praying. There is a lack of spiritual heat and fire. Cold embers now reside where fiery souls once burned. Yet Christ is still asking us to “stay here and keep watch” with Him, because we do not know the day or the hour he will return (Matthew 26:38).

Everything going on around us points to one fact, ‘WE ARE IN TURBULENT TIMES’. Turbulent times calls for turbulent and violent prayers from the saints. That is why we cannot turn deaf ears to the clarion call for us to watch and pray. Many Christians are like Jonah who slept soundly and refused to watch when the ship he was traveling in was going through a storm. The other mariners were hopelessly calling on strange gods who couldn’t save them but Jonah was sleeping although he knew the true God who could calm the storm. Jonah 1:4-6 says, ‘4 ¶ But the LORD sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty tempest on the sea, so that the ship was about to be broken up. 5 Then the mariners were afraid; and every man cried out to his god, and threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea, to lighten the load. But Jonah had gone down into the lowest parts of the ship, had lain down, and was fast asleep. 6 So the captain came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God; perhaps your God will consider us, so that we may not perish.”

Are you willing to watch? Are you willing to pray? Are your prayers in line with the express will of God, or are they in accordance to your own will and desires? Are you willing to set aside time to press on in prayer? Or are other things more important? Christ expects that His Church will be one that watches and prays. It is time to re-dig the well of prayer and re-ignite the fire of intercession. Will you watch and pray?

entries.prayer: O Lord, revive my prayer life from today in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I have a strong prayer altar!

entries.title: Are You in the Right Place?
entries.summary: Nobody can be truly happy outside the will of God . One of the most horrible things that could happen to a person is when the person is outside where God wants him to be and he does not realize it until he gets to the grave.
entries.key_scripture_text: Then said I, Lo, I come in the volume of the Book it is written of me,) to do Your will, O God.

blocks.text: Nobody can be truly happy outside the will of God . One of the most horrible things that could happen to a person is when the person is outside where God wants him to be and he does not realize it until he gets to the grave. Such a person would end up living a wasted life.

You can never please God anywhere else but where He wants you to be . You may be popular amongst people and anytime you are around, they praise you, but if you were not where He wanted you to be, you would have chosen the second best for your life. Whatever our achievements, we must not miss God’s purpose for our lives. If you feel too big to be where God wants you to be, you would be cheating yourself. But when you are in a place of divine appointment, then you are in the flow of divine miracle. If somebody had told the little boy whose fish and bread the Lord used to feed the multitude when he was living home his provision would feed 5,000 people that day, he would have said, “No. This one is just for me. How can 5,000 feed on this?”

When you are in a place of God’s WILL for your life, you are in a place of power. A person may be working very hard on a very good thing but if he is in the wrong place, he would be wasting his time; and it could be said that he is rebellious. So, the question is: Are you in the right place and in the right condition? Is your present spiritual level where God wants it to be? Namaan wanted to go to Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, but God had no appointment with Abana and Pharpar. Although they were nice rivers, the divine appointment was with the dirty river Jordan. It was in the River Jordan that he received His healing. Many of us are heading for Abana and Pharpar when we should go to Jordan.
May God help you to always be in line with His will in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, always direct my steps in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am in line with God’s will!

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to live a responsible life in Jesus Name!

entries.title: You Carry Something Precious!
entries.summary: You are not good for nothing; you are too precious to be wasted. You may not be like somebody but that doesn’t mean you are a nobody. You carry something precious.
entries.key_scripture_text: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

blocks.text: You are not good for nothing; you are too precious to be wasted. You may not be like somebody but that doesn’t mean you are a nobody. You carry something precious.
God’s gift is the instrument for man’s lift. In order words, your lifting is at the mercy of your gifting. You cannot be gifted and not be lifted. If you want a lift secure a gift.

Gifted people will always end as the elevated ones. Your greatest elevator in life is inside you. It is the gift that God has given you. If you are down trodden never look for who to blame. Rather examine your gift for it is the lifting power of your life.

The gifting of Joseph was responsible for His lifting (Gen.41:1- 46). Joseph would have died as a prisoner had it not been for the gift of interpretation of dreams that God gave him. After years of suffering and affliction a prisoner and a foreigner became the next in command after Pharaoh because of his gift.
All lifted men were gifted men. David was lifted from shepherding the few sheep of his father Jesse to shepherding and ruling the whole nation of Israel -1 Sam.16:13-
22. Daniel enjoyed uncommon promotions in the land of Babylon because of his unusual gifting – Dan.2:19-48

Truly, the gift of a man makes room for Him. There is something within you that the world cannot do without. There is a divine treasure in you, yearning for expression. Discover that gift in you by making a prayer of enquiry to God. After the discovery, let it remain dormant; always use for the benefit of others and for the Kingdom and you will enjoy continuous lifting. Indeed, your lifting will not come from without but from within.

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to discover and utilize my gift in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I shall enjoy continuous elevation!

entries.title: What Are You Living For?
entries.summary: Life without a cause will end under a cloud. In other words, when you don’t live according to a specific purpose, you will die in obscurity. Living without a cause is like living under a curse. Cause is the cure to fainting.
entries.key_scripture_text: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

blocks.text: Life without a cause will end under a cloud. In other words, when you don’t live according to a specific purpose, you will die in obscurity. Living without a cause is like living under a curse. Cause is the cure to fainting. With a cause you cannot faint. Strong people are those motivated by their cause. It is the greatest motivation to life. It makes one tireless and ever energized. A man with a cause is usually self-encouraging.

I want to ask you an important question today, ‘What are you living for?” Are you just moving through life marking time and whiling the time away?” When Jesus Christ was brought before Pilate, He emphatically answered this question by saying, ‘ To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.’ – John 18:37. When death was close and the agony was lurking around, Jesus would have given up, if He had no cause. He however persisted because He had a cause. John 12:27 says, ‘¶ Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.’

David had a cause to live for. When he got to the battlefield and heard the threatening of Goliath, he knew that he had been born for this. He therefore said to his brother Eliab, ‘Is there not a cause?’ That was how David graduated from an unknown shepherd boy to become a renowned king.
Beloved, you must stand for something. If you don’t stand for something; you will fall for anything . Live for a cause!

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to fulfill my mission on earth in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am living a life of purpose!

entries.title: Hear from God!
entries.summary: Many people make a mistake of running ahead of God. They take hasty steps and at the end of the day life frustrated lives. It is those who hear from Heaven who eventually impact their world.
entries.key_scripture_text: 21 “I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran. I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied. 22 But if they had stood in My counsel, And had caused My people to hear My words, Then they would have turned them from their evil way And from the evil of their doings.

blocks.text: Many people make a mistake of running ahead of God. They take hasty steps and at the end of the day life frustrated lives. It is those who hear from Heaven who eventually impact their world. Every glorious destiny thrives on account of “Thus saith the Lord.”

All successful people as well as great men always make reference to a clear word they received from the Lord. No great venture is established by goodwill and support of men but by a word from God. Therefore, listen to men with your ears but hear God with your heart, lend your ears to men but give your heart to God. Watch men but focus on God.

It is only what God says and shows to you that is error- free. Never mistake the words of men for the voice of God. Jeremiah 10:23 says categorically that ‘It is not in man to direct his steps’. To direct your own life is like personally directing a movie in which you are the main actor. Let God direct the affairs of your life. The voice you hear will determine the choice you make. Therefore, decide to spend time in the presence of God to access His voice. Only decide on matters after prayerful consideration. Never make a choice without the consent and assent of God. Simply, HEAR FROM GOD ON EVERY ISSUE OF YOUR LIFE!

entries.prayer: O Lord, direct the affairs of my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am attentive to God’s glorious voice!

entries.title: You Shall Finish What You Have Started!
entries.summary: In the journey of life, many people start a lot of great things but few are able to finish what they started. It is not enough to start well, you must also receive Grace to finish strong.
entries.key_scripture_text: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God

blocks.text: In the journey of life, many people start a lot of great things but few are able to finish what they started. It is not enough to start well, you must also receive Grace to finish strong.
You must finish the race of Christianity.

There are many people who start the race of Christianity and they never complete their course. They start very spiritual but they end carnal. That is why the Bible says that many are called but few are chosen. The giant of incompletion will cause you to be distracted by the circumstances around you and like Peter instead of rising you will begin to sink in your walk with God.
Ga 3:3, “Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?’
2Ti 4:7 I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
You must fulfil your ministry

Many begin doing something for God but they stop mid-stream. They are not able to make full proof of their ministries - 2Ti 4:5 But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry. Jesus started working for God and He successfully finished it. Paul also accomplished same with his life - Joh 4:34 Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work. You must experience your complete healing

God wants to perfect everything that concerns you (Psalm 138:8). It is like that blind man who Jesus prayed for so that his sight could be restored. After the prayers, the blind man said, ‘ I see men like trees’ (Mark 8:22-25) You must start and finish the marital journey
You will marry right and your marriage will never end divorce! Songs of Sol. 8: 6, “Place me like a seal over your heart, like a seal on your arm. For love is as strong as death.”
You must complete all your projects

Whether it is building, vision, education, etc., you simply don’t finish it. 1Ki 9:1 ¶ And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,’

entries.prayer: O Lord, help to finish all my good projects before this year ends in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: Nothing can stop me!

entries.title: My God, the Creator!
entries.summary: The name “Elohim” describes God as the Creator. In other words, our God is the creator of the world and everything that exist in it.
entries.key_scripture_text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

blocks.text: The name “Elohim” describes God as the Creator. In other words, our God is the creator of the world and everything that exist in it. Many scientists have propounded theories to explain how the world came into being and even the existence of human beings. In spite of theories like the “Big Bang” and the “Evolution”, it is an undisputable fact that God created the world. Atheists may claim that there is no God but the fact still holds that there is a God in Heaven that rules over the affairs of men (Psalm 8:3, Psalm 102:25, Col. 1;16-17). Daniel 4:17 says, “This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the Most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.”

Creativity is an aspect of God’s character and nature. His creative nature is portrayed in two ways. Firstly, through the spoken word (Psalm 33:6, Hebrews 11:3). Secondly, through wisdom (Jer. 10:15, 51:15). When man was created in the image of God, he was blessed with God’s creative nature. Man’s creative abilities and power of invention are from God.

Ideas rule the world and they are the most expensive commodities on the earth. One creative idea from God can turn things around for you. If you are a true Christian, your words carry creative powers. (Eccl. 8:4). You can see what you say. Again, you have the mind of Christ (creative wisdom of Gods) and you can use it at any time. From today, begin to walk in your creative abilities in Jesus Name!!

entries.prayer: O Lord, begin to do new things in my life in Jesus Name. Amen.
entries.confession: I operate with supernatural creativity!

entries.title: My God, the All-Sufficient One!
entries.summary: There are many mighty men but there is only one Almighty God. “El-Shaddai” is another name of God which means the Almighty or the all-sufficient one.
entries.key_scripture_text: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the almighty God: walk before me, and be thou perfect.

blocks.text: There are many mighty men but there is only one Almighty God. “El-Shaddai” is another name of God which means the Almighty or the all-sufficient one. It also means “the mighty one with many breasts.” As a child of God, you must know that if God can’t do it, then nobody can. This is because there is none higher than the Most high. In these hard times, only God can satisfy you!

Let’s us critically examine the case of Abraham and Sarah. When Abraham was an old man and Sarah’s womb was dead (menopause), God said, “In one year when you’re a hundred years old and you’re not good for anything, I’ll perform the miracle” (Gen. 17:4-6). In the sight of men this was closed case; there was no way out. However, the “El-Shaddai” God stepped into Abraham’s situation and impossibility became a possibility. There is no closed-cause with God. The harder it is for man; the better it is for God! Your case is not yet over. I don’t care your condition now; the Almighty God can change your life for the better.

He is the “mighty breasted one” and the breast meets every need of the baby. It is the baby’s milk, porridge, water, diet etc. The breast is all a baby needs to survive. In the same way, God is all you need to make it in life.
Hopeless situations do not make God helpless. I don’t care how mighty your obstacle is, the Almighty God is sending help to you today.

entries.prayer: Almighty God, change all my obstacles into miracles in Jesus Name: Amen!!
entries.confession: God is all I need to make it in life!

entries.title: My God, the Master
entries.summary: Jesus Christ is not only your Saviour, He is also your Lord.
entries.key_scripture_text: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant

blocks.text: As a child of God, you must have a true revelation of God as your Master.

Jesus Christ is not only your Saviour, He is also your Lord. When the Apostle Peter was delivering his first sermon in Acts 3:36, he said, “Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made the same Jesus whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.”

As Abraham was sitting in the doorway of his tent at noontime with the sun beating down upon him, he saw three men approaching. Bowing himself to the ground, Abraham called out, “My Lord” (meaning Master or wholly thine) – Gen. 18:1-3. In other words, if God becomes your master, it means you are the property of God. You are always at his service. Everything that concerns God, concerns you and because of that, everything that concerns you also concerns God.

In the olden days, servants or slaves were willing to die for their masters. So if God is truly your Lord, you’ll be willing to die for Him. That was why Shadrack, Meshack and Abednago were not afraid of the death threats of King Nebuchadnezzar; God was their Master. They decided to rather burn than turn from the commandments of their Master. It is the Master (Lord) who dictates everything for the servant. The word of the Master is obeyed by the servant.

Beloved, is God your Master? Do you serve Him at all times? Do you obey Him no matter the cost? Are you fulfilling the Great Commission? Are you totally surrendered to Him? If not let Him become your “Adonai” today. God only reveals His will to those who know Him as Adonai (Gen. 18:17).

entries.prayer: Father, Lord, I want you to become the Lord and Master over my life from today in Jesus Name. Amen!!
entries.confession: I have only one Master and Lord; the Almighty God!

entries.title: My God, the Provider!
entries.summary: Every true father provides for his children. Therefore God, who is our heavenly Father is always ready to provide for us His children.
entries.key_scripture_text: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

blocks.text: Every true father provides for his children. Therefore God, who is our heavenly Father is always ready to provide for us His children. Our God is Jehovah Jireh which suggests two meanings: “Jehovah shall be seen” and “Provider.” This name therefore speaks about redemption.

Ωbirth of Isaac. I want you to put yourself in the position of Abraham. Imagine the joy and excitement that Abraham experienced as he watched his son grow. Then one day God demanded for the only son of old man Abraham ((Gen. 22:2). Many modern-day people would have disobeyed this command but without hesitation, Abraham took Isaac and they embarked on a three-day journey to Mount Mariah. It was certainly a journey of no return for Isaac. As they walked along Isaac said, “Father I see the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice? Abraham was so confident in his God that he knew the he could provide even at the last moment and in the most difficult of times. True to his faith, God provided a ram on top of a mountain.

Listen to me today, no matter what is lacking in your life, God can provide. When man ends, God begins . When man says it is over, God takes over and when God takes over, the battle is over. If God is truly your shepherd, you will never want any good thing (Psalm 23:1). Phil. 4:19 says that your God will supply all your needs...” The economic situation notwithstanding, God will always provide for you and your family. May Heaven surprise you today in Jesus Name! God will connect you to good things and open great doors for you. From today, goodness and mercy shall follow you all the days of your life.

entries.prayer: O Lord, let me experience supernatural provision in all I do in Jesus Name! Amen.
entries.confession: I will never lack any good thing!

entries.title: My God, the Healer?
entries.summary: There are many strange sicknesses and diseases that attack mortal men in this world That’s why as a child of God, you must have a revelation of your heavenly Father as a Healer.
entries.key_scripture_text: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee.

blocks.text: There are many strange sicknesses and diseases that attack mortal men in this world That’s why as a child of God, you must have a revelation of your heavenly Father as a Healer. Our God is Jehovah “Rophe”meaning healer, repairer and restorer, the doctor. This revelation came through Moses to the children of Israel as they were freed from the 430 years bondage of Egypt. When they came to the waters of Marah, the Israelites found that the water was bitter and unsuitable for drinking. God showed Moses a tree and when he cast it into the water, it was made sweet, (Exodus 15:25-26).

It is the will of God for you to be healed (3 John 2). God has the power to heal all lands of sicknesses and infirmities. Although certain diseases can be cured medically, others go beyond physical cure. May be your sickness is emotional physical or spiritual. God is still able to heal or cure you. No matter how long you have been carrying that sickness, God can heal you today. Christ bore your pains and took your sicknesses on the cross and by His stripes you were healed. (Matt. 8:17, Isaiah 53:3-5). The enemy can no longer oppress you; from today, you will see God as “Jehovah Rophe” in your life!!

If any part of your body is damaged, God will repair it. However, if it is beyond repairs, Jehovah the Healer will replace it with a new part in Jesus Name! May you live a sickness-free life as you encounter the Doctor of Doctors.

entries.prayer: O Lord, heal me and I shall be healed in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I walk in divine health all the days of my life!

entries.title: My God, the Conqueror?
entries.summary: That is why you must know God as Jehovah Nissi which means the “Lord our Banner” or THE LORD OUR CONQUEROR signifying our victory. We serve a victorious God.
entries.key_scripture_text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah Nissi” Battles are satan’s reaction to the advancement and progress of men. In fact, the brighter your destiny, the harsher your attackers.

blocks.text: That is why you must know God as Jehovah Nissi which means the “Lord our Banner” or THE LORD OUR CONQUEROR signifying our victory. We serve a victorious God. Defeat and failure can never be associated with God and it should also not be associated with us.

No one in life wants to be defeated in any venture. However, you cannot have true victory without the help of God. Divine assistance is the greatest catalyst of human advancement. It was said of King Uzziah in 2 Chronicles 26:15, ” ... And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.”

According to Exodus 17, there was a conflict between the Israelites and the Amalekites who were the descendants of Esau at Rephidim. Moses instructed Joshua to organize the Israelites for battle on the following day, promising to stand on the mountain top and petition God for the victory while Israel faced Amalek in battle. Joshua did exactly as he was told and Moses stood upon the mountain with the rod of God extended as he prayed for victory. So long as Moses lifted up his hands in prayer, Israel prevailed in the battle. When we grew tired and let down his hands however, Amalek begun to triumph. It took the help of Aaron and Hur to keep His hands up to ensure Israel’s victory in that battle.

God has promised His children victory in all the conflicts of life. The Bible says that whatsoever is born of God overcomes the world and this is the victory that overcomes the world, even our faith (1 John 5:4). The Bible also says that God will always give us victory through our Lord Jesus Christ (1 Cor. 15:57). You must however lift up your hands in prayer to God every time you get into trouble. So long as your hands are up in prayer, you will never be defeated no matter what the enemy brings your way.

entries.prayer: O Lord, make me victorious in every conflict I face in life in Jesus Name!!
entries.confession: All-round victory is my portion!

entries.title: The Road to Total Peace!
entries.summary: We live in a world full of turmoil and chaos. Anxiety and worry are common occurrences in the lives of most people. In spite of all these, God can give us total peace. The currency of the Blood of Jesus purchased for us among other things our peace.
entries.key_scripture_text: Verse 20, “And having made peace through the BLOOD OF HIS CROSS, by Him to reconcile all things unto Himself; by Him, I say, whether they be things in earth or things in heaven”.

blocks.text: We live in a world full of turmoil and chaos. Anxiety and worry are common occurrences in the lives of most people. In spite of all these, God can give us total peace. The currency of the Blood of Jesus purchased for us among other things our peace.

Peace simply means freedom from war; a state of mental calm and serenity, with no anxiety. The covenant of peace between man and God has its roots in the Blood of Jesus. This means that without the Cross, there could be no access by a sinful man to a holy God. Through the fall of Adam, man was constantly at war with God. There was a gap between man and God. Sin created a partition between divinity and humanity but the cross became that bridge that reconnected man to God.

Ephesians 2:14 says of Jesus Christ, “For He is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the MIDDLE WALL OF PARTITION between us”, that is why you can now have true fellowship with your Father in heaven. Hebrews 10:19 also says, “Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the BLOOD of Jesus............”

Friend, do you really know Jesus? Are you a partaker of the peace in His Blood? Are you enjoying that peace that the Cross has given you? It is yours. Begin to enjoy absolute peace from today on the basis of the Blood of Jesus. The Blood of Christ is your only true source of peace in this chaotic world. Isaiah 57:21 says, ‘There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.’

entries.prayer: Father, on the basis of the pure Blood of Jesus, I claim total peace in every department of my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: Total peace is my portion!

entries.title: The Road to Long Life!
entries.summary: All over the world most people wish others long life and prosperity and not short life and poverty. As a child of God, you must believe God for long life. The life of everything is extended when the Blood of Jesus is invoked.
entries.key_scripture_text: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life therefore: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eateth blood of no manner of flesh; for the life of all flesh is the blood therefore: Whosoever eateth it shall be cut off”.

blocks.text: All over the world most people wish others long life and prosperity and not short life and poverty. As a child of God, you must believe God for long life. The life of everything is extended when the Blood of Jesus is invoked. God commanded the Israelites not to eat the blood of any animal. The reason being that the life of animals was in their blood. By this statement, God was establishing an eternal truth that the “blood is the custodian of life.” When you lose your blood, you will surely lose your life. Therefore, to be far away from the Blood of Jesus is to be far away from the abundant life that is in Christ Jesus.

That is why Jesus said in John 6:53, “Most assuredly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the son of Man and drink his blood, you have NO LIFE in you. ” The Blood of Jesus Christ has power to give life. Every time you say, “The Blood of Jesus”, you are bringing God’s very life on the scene. Therefore, the Blood can bring life to any dead situation and extend the life of everything and everyone.

Are you going through a life-threatening sickness? Is your marriage at the point of death? Is your spiritual life dying? Is your ministry or business dying? Don’t give up!! The Bible says of Jesus Christ in Acts 2:24, “Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.” There is still hope for you because of the Resurrection power of Jesus. Just plead the Blood in faith over every area of your life or any situation that is dying and it shall surely jump back to life.

entries.prayer: Father, let the Blood of Jesus inject life into anything dying situation in my life now, in Jesus Name. Amen!
entries.confession: My life is extended through the Blood of Jesus!

entries.title: The Road to Victory Over Sin!
entries.summary: Sin is a destroyer and sin is a sinker! Sin gives the devil an upper hand in your life. You must know that due to the Adamic nature, all human beings possess, it is easier for people to sin than to do what is right.
entries.key_scripture_text: And almost all things are by the law purged with the BLOOD; and without the shedding of blood is no remission”.

blocks.text: Sin is a destroyer and sin is a sinker! Sin gives the devil an upper hand in your life. You must know that due to the Adamic nature, all human beings possess, it is easier for people to sin than to do what is right. David said in Psalm 51:5, “Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.” Paul the Apostle also said in Roman 7:19, “For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.”

Without the Blood, man’s struggle against sin will not yield any results. Charles Spurgeon once said, “Trust Christ and you shall live. The bloody sacrifice of Calvary is the only hope of sinners”. The Blood of Jesus is a “Master Eraser”. It can erase your sinful past and give you a glorious future today. This Blood will not only deliver you from sin but also empower you to live above sin. Sin chased man out of Eden’s perfection and fruitfulness, and only righteousness can bring him back. God desires to bring us back to Eden if we will let Him cleanse us from all iniquities.

Every sin that is not dealt with has power to deal with the sinner. Stop toying with sin otherwise, you will become a toy in the hands of the devil. There are things you must stop today or you will never have another opportunity to stop them. Stop that sin before it stops you from enjoying the best that God has for you. Is it fornication, masturbation, alcoholism, pornography, pride, anger, theft, unforgiveness, abortion etc? The Blood is powerful enough to cleanse you from every sin. (1 John 1:7). You can win the battle against sin through the Blood of Jesus.

entries.prayer: O Lord, let the Blood of Jesus cleanse me from all my sins in Jesus Name.
entries.confession: My Jesus is Lord over death, sin and the grave!

entries.title: The Answer to Death
entries.summary: Death is the ultimate that the devil can do and resurrection is the answer to death. The devil thought that the demise of Jesus Christ was permanent and that He will be in the grave forever.
entries.key_scripture_text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

blocks.text: Death is the ultimate that the devil can do and resurrection is the answer to death. The devil thought that the demise of Jesus Christ was permanent and that He will be in the grave forever. What they did not know was that the grave was too small and too weak to contain Jesus – 1 Corinthians 2:8 says, ‘Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.’

After the resurrection, Jesus declared that all power on earth and in Heaven has been given unto Him. This means that when you are connected to Jesus Christ, you are connected to immeasurable POWER! Your days of powerlessness are over in Jesus Name!
The resurrection power expresses itself in the following ways;
The power of life – Because Jesus lives, you will also
live; nothing is permitted to die in your life – John 14:9, Rom. 8:11
2. The power of Hope – Eccl. 4:9 says that, ‘For to him that
is joined to all the living there is HOPE...’
The power over sin – We are not just saved from sin, we
are also given power over sin – II Cor. 5:15, Acts 4:26
4. The Power over the devil and all his works – Col. 2:15,
By the resurrection power, sickness, poverty, sorrow, affliction are destroyed in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, envelope me with Your resurrection power in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am walking in the resurrection power!

entries.title: Supernatural Proofs!
entries.summary: On the Cross Jesus Christ made a public show of the devil in a triumphant procession - Col 2:15 And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
entries.key_scripture_text: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

blocks.text: On the Cross Jesus Christ made a public show of the devil in a triumphant procession - Col 2:15 And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

After that, Jesus Christ celebrated His resurrection among His disciples for 40 days - Acts 1: 3 To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

And because we believe that Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever (Heb. 13:8), we believe that after Easter, we must expect diverse encounters with the resurrected Christ and undeniable proofs in miracles, signs and wonders that will change our destiny forever.
In this season therefore, we must endeavour to be spiritually awake, remain on our watch and set ourselves upon our towers so as to maximize this season of divine visitation- Hab. 2:1-3
You must engage the following mysteries if you want to experience undeniable proofs;
The Altar of Prayer and Fasting – Acts 10:9-24, 29
Praises & Worship – Luke 24:36-40, 53 & Psalm 22:3
A deep study of the Word – I Samuel 3:21
Serving in the House of God – Mark 16:14-20/ John 14:21
5. Constant Church attendance – Psalm 132:13-15, Zeph. 3:17
May God reveal Himself to you in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, reveal Yourself to me in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I have a deep revelation of Jesus!

entries.title: An Encounter with the Living Christ
entries.summary: The Apostle Paul declared out of holy hunger and desperation in Philippians 3: 10 That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
entries.key_scripture_text: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

blocks.text: The Apostle Paul declared out of holy hunger and desperation in Philippians 3: 10 That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
