Like Paul, we must have an insatiable desire to know Jesus more and more. This is because, when you encounter the resurrected Christ, you will experience the following;
Your eyes will be opened to understand the Scriptures –
You will discover God’s plan and purpose for your life –
John 21:5-6
You will experience notable miracles and breakthroughs –
John 21:5-6
You will discover the deeper things of the Kingdom – Acts
The storm in your life will be calmed – John 20:21
Sigs and wonders will be unleashed – Acts 1:3
7. Jesus Christ will breathe on you, the breath of life that
quickens our mortal bodies –John 20:22, Rom. 8:11
You must begin to seek the face of God in this season for a genuine encounter with the resurrected Christ!

entries.prayer: O Lord, release Your Power into my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am experiencing undeniable proofs and notable miracles!

entries.title: The Road to Total Protection!
entries.summary: The arrows of the enemy and his cohorts are flying all around. Fear and panic are the order of the day now. With all the technological advancement in our world today, human lives still remain the most vulnerable.
entries.key_scripture_text: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where you are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plaque shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt”.

blocks.text: The arrows of the enemy and his cohorts are flying all around. Fear and panic are the order of the day now. With all the technological advancement in our world today, human lives still remain the most vulnerable. There is a multiplication of violence and evil in our world today. Armed robbery activities, murder, car – accidents, plane crashes are not uncommon in our world. People are living in fear of the unexpected. However, Proverbs 3:25 says, “Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.”

The All-powerful Blood of Jesus, can give you sound sleep in the midst of a turbulent world. An obstinate and stubborn Pharaoh still refused to give up after nine deadly plaques from the All – powerful God. God had to stop Pharaoh once and for – all and therefore He sent an angel of death into the land of Egypt to slay all the firstborns in the lands. God however gave the Israelites a specific instruction. He told them to kill a lamb and apply the blood upon their door posts. The children of Israel obeyed this instruction and when the angel of death saw the Blood, he passed over them and they were exempted from danger.

As the Israelites were in Egypt, so are Christians in the world. As the angel of death passed through the land of Egypt, so the enemy sends trouble and arrows in our world. However, as the blood of the lamb protected the firstborns of the Israelites from the angle of death, so will the Blood of Jesus protect you from the troubles and dangers of the world. From today, make it a point to always plead tot Blood upon your life, your wife / husband, children, household, business, possessions and all that concerns you. You will escape every satanic arrow by the Blood of Jesus!

entries.prayer: O Lord, let the Blood of Jesus protect me from every satanic arrow, in Jesus Name. Amen!
entries.confession: No satanic arrow will locate my life!

entries.title: The Road to Total Freedom!
entries.summary: Most people in our world today are bound in one area of their lives or the other. However, Every bondage terminates at the Blood of Jesus!
entries.key_scripture_text: As for thee also, BY THE BLOOD of thy covenant I have sent forth by prisoners all of the pit wherein there is no water”.

blocks.text: Most people in our world today are bound in one area of their lives or the other. However, Every bondage terminates at the Blood of Jesus! As we see in Exodus, every miracle and sign was performed, every effort was made by God through Moses, to free Israel from Egyptian bondage, but until the blood was introduced (Exodus 12), there was no freedom for them. The Blood is God’s last resort, God’s last card for man’s total freedom.

The revelation here is that, after the introduction of the blood, Moses never said again, “Let my people go!” Rather it was Pharaoh who now frantically and desperately wanted them gone. Psalm 105:38 says “Egypt (Pharaoh and his people) was glad when they (the Israelites) departed: for the fear of them fell upon them”. The Blood can so much instill fear in satan and his cohorts to the extent that they will beg you to have your freedom. From today, the forces that have held you now will beg you to go in Jesus Name!

No force or power in hell can resist the Blood of Jesus! You’ll never be free from your oppressions without the application of the Blood of Jesus. Come on now! Rise and begin to claim your freedom from the enemies of sickness, poverty, sin, disappointment, and unending struggles on the basis of the Blood of Jesus.
It always works; it will work for you today. You can no longer remain a prisoner of Satan. Your total freedom is sure because of the superior Blood of Jesus.

entries.prayer: O Lord, let the Blood launch me into the realm of uncommon freedom in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am totally free from every satanic oppression!

entries.title: The Winning Frequency!
entries.summary: In our world today, there are fears within and battles without. Invisible battles are on the ascendancy in order to stop God’s children from maximizing their destinies.
entries.key_scripture_text: And they overcame him by the BLOOD OF THE LAMB, and by the word of their testimony..........

blocks.text: In our world today, there are fears within and battles without. Invisible battles are on the ascendancy in order to stop God’s children from maximizing their destinies. The devil has a short time here on earth, (Revelation 12:12) and therefore he is out to demonstrate the greatest wickedness ever. So expect the most wicked manifestation from him in these last days, and at the same time, the brightest triumph for you, if you know the weapons against his strategies.

Beloved, the Blood of Jesus is the secret of all-round victory in every conflict of life. The Cross is what disarmed and devil and his host. Colossians 2:15 says, “And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.” Every time you turn to the blood, you become invincible; too defended to be defeated and too surrounded to surrender. The Bible says in Rev. 12 that there was a fierce battle in Heaven. Nothing worked until the Blood of the Lamb started working and gave Heaven victory against Satan. If they overcame by the Blood, then we shall and will always overcome by the Blood. If the Blood was relevant for victory in Heaven, then it must be super relevant on the earth.

In order for you to silence the devil in your affairs, lift up the banner of the Blood. The Blood of Jesus can break the chains of fear, the yoke of poverty, the burden of sickness and any curse in your life. THE WINNING FREQUENCY OF LIFE IS THE BLOOD OF JESUS. All-round victory is yours through the Blood!

entries.prayer: O Lord, I claim victory over the challenges of my life on the basis of the Blood of Jesus!
entries.confession: I am WINNING on every side!

entries.title: The Curse Is Broken!
entries.summary: Praise the Lord! We are so excited that when Jesus Christ died on the Cross and was buried, He didn’t remain in the grave but rose up triumphantly on the third day.
entries.key_scripture_text: 13 Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us (for it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree”), 14 that the blessing of Abraham might come upon the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith

blocks.text: Praise the Lord! We are so excited that when Jesus Christ died on the Cross and was buried, He didn’t remain in the grave but rose up triumphantly on the third day. The death and the resurrection of Jesus Christ broke the curse that was hanging over the human race and set in motion a string of unending blessings. That is why Jesus wore the Crown of thorns...By that act, He was saying, I have carried your curses - Mt 27:29 And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

When Jesus resurrected, He placed us under the canopy of God’s blessings - Acts 3:26 Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities. Galatians 3: 13-14, ‘ 13 Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us (for it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree”), 14 that the blessing of Abraham might come upon the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith’

A curse is a declaration that empowers a man to fail by all means. A person operating under a curse is easy to recognize, because he will be struggling against something, and will never be able to master the thing or overcome it. At the point of success, frustration comes in because the curse is limiting that person. They don’t succeed in education, marriage, career and other areas of their lives. Therefore, from today receive Jesus Christ into your heart and walk in the consciousness of the fact that every curse in your life and family is broken. Yes! You are blessed beyond a curse! Where others fail, you will prevail and where other fall, you will rise in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, break every curse by Your Resurrection power in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am under the canopy of God’s blessings!

entries.title: My God, the Peace Giver!
entries.summary: Our God is Jehovah Shalom meaning “Our Peace.” One of the greatest assets in life is peace. You may have money, a good shelter, assorted food, academic degrees etc. but if you lack peace, life will be unbearable.
entries.key_scripture_text: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the Lord, and called it Jehovah-Shalom

blocks.text: Our God is Jehovah Shalom meaning “Our Peace.” One of the greatest assets in life is peace. You may have money, a good shelter, assorted food, academic degrees etc. but if you lack peace, life will be unbearable. That is why I love this scripture in Psalm 29:11, “ The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.” Peace is one blessing you should always pray for as a Christian.

How did God get this name? After Israel’s miraculous liberation from Egypt, they soon forgot the Lord. When you forget God, you will also be under oppression. God allowed the Midianites to oppress the Israelites. In the midst of this excruciating torment, the Israelites prayed unto the Lord. God in His own mercy appeared unto Gideon and commanded him to lead the Israelites into battle against the Midianites. Unaware of whom he was in God, the words Gideon spoke revealed the unbelief in his heart when he said, “If I have found grace in thy sight, then show me a sign” (Judges 6:17). When God revealed himself as “Jehovah Shalom” to Gideon, fear and unbelief vanished. Shortly after this experience, Gideon led 300 men to a supernatural victory over the Midianites.

You can also enjoy the peace of God; for He will keep you in perfect peace if your mind is stayed on Him (Isaiah. 26:3). I speak peace into your life and family; I declare peace into your marriage and in your business in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, let your peace which surpasses all understanding overshadow my life in Jesus Name. Amen!!
entries.confession: I have my peace of mind!

entries.title: My God, the Sanctifier!
entries.summary: The greatest limitation to God’s manifestation is a lack of sanctification (Joshua 3:5). God wants pure and holy vessels in order to manifest His power in our world today.
entries.key_scripture_text: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the Lord your God. And ye shall keep me statutes, and do them: I am the Lord which sanctify you.

blocks.text: The greatest limitation to God’s manifestation is a lack of sanctification (Joshua 3:5). God wants pure and holy vessels in order to manifest His power in our world today. You automatically become a stranger to God’s power when you are familiar with sin. We live in a sin-soaked and an evil contaminated world that is why God must become our “Jehovah M’kaddesh” (the Lord our sanctifier).

When God becomes our sanctifier, He takes us out of sin into holiness, out of bondage into liberty, out of filth into righteousness. Some Christians think that after their salvation, what they do with their lives do not matter. Such people will be surprised when they hear the Master on the Judgment Day saying, “He does not know them”. God is a thrice holy God; for the angels carry out “holy, holy, holy.” Therefore, without holiness no man (including Pastors, Bishops, Elders, Deacons, General Overseers etc) cannot see God. You will be judged according to your works (Rev. 20:12-13). That is why you and I must choose to follow God’s example of holiness so that we become more like Him.

If you are truly sanctified by God, the old sins that you once indulged in will no longer appeal to you. You will hate fornication, pornography, lies, masturbation, anger, theft, adultery, homosexuality or lesbianism, pride etc. all the days of your life. You will not tolerate for even a second any unforgiveness, bitterness and hatred. From today, allow “Jehovah M’kaddesh” to do a complete work in your life. May you truly know God as your sanctifier in Jesus Name.

entries.prayer: O Lord, deliver me from any sin that easily entices me in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am a vessel of holiness!

entries.title: My God, the Shepherd!
entries.summary: As our Father God feeds us and as a Shepherd, He leads us. “Jehovah Rohi” simply means “ the Lord my shepherd.” As a shepherd, the Lord feeds, directs, leads and cares for us. The Christian is compared to the sheep.
entries.key_scripture_text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

blocks.text: As our Father God feeds us and as a Shepherd, He leads us. “Jehovah Rohi” simply means “ the Lord my shepherd.” As a shepherd, the Lord feeds, directs, leads and cares for us. The Christian is compared to the sheep. Naturally, sheep are weak, defenceless and foolish. Without a good shepherd therefore, sheep are vulnerable to all sorts of dangers. They can get lost easily. While they are grazing in the pasture, some can wander away from the flock. That is why the Bible says that “All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned everyone to his own way;” (Isaiah 53:6).

When sheep go astray, it takes a loving and a caring shepherd to go after the one that was lost and bring it back into the fold. In the same way, we were once lost and it took the loving and caring shepherd of our souls (Jesus Christ to bring us back to the fold of God. Again, sheep can experience severe hunger especially when there is no pasture. Such severe hunger can cause death among them. A good shepherd therefore will always lead the sheep to a green pasture so that they don’t starve to death.

In our Christian walk too, spiritual hunger occurs when the Word of God is lacking and we are finding it very difficult to participate in other godly activities. The Bible makes this statement about the Good Shepherd, ‘He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: He leads me beside the still waters” (Psalm 23:2). Finally, Jesus Christ, our Good Shepherd also protects us from all evil and delivers our souls from the hands of the enemy.
It is my prayer for you today, that God will always be your Shepherd. May all-round protection be your portion in Jesus Name as you know God as a Shepherd.

entries.prayer: O Lord, lead me in this journey of life in Jesus Name!!
entries.confession: My steps are ordered by the Lord!

entries.title: It’s Time to Make a Turn!
entries.summary: There comes a time in our lives we find it very necessary to make a TURN. This is because in life, until you make a turn, it is never your turn.
entries.key_scripture_text: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith which is in me.

blocks.text: There comes a time in our lives we find it very necessary to make a TURN. This is because in life, until you make a turn, it is never your turn. We must make definite and desperate decisions to turn from many things; from darkness to light and from the power of satan unto God. Turn to God and He will turn your darkness to light. Turn away from some things, some habits, sins, and hindrances, to receive God’s richest blessing. Turn to God in prayer and you will receive beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning; the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness.

When you make this turn, you will receive forgiveness of sins, and an inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in Christ Jesus our Lord. When you turn God is also ready to turn some things for your good. Psalm 30:11 says: “Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; Thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness. “ He will turn your mourning into dancing; He will put off your sackcloth and gird you with gladness. Turn to faith in God. Turn to holiness without which no man shall see God.

Your walk with God should be continuous. Turn to God in weariness. When you turn to Him you will see His glory. God will surely show up. He will bring you answers to your problems. Turn and experience peace and joy in the Holy Ghost. Turn towards the light. He will overturn, overrule, and accelerate your spiritual and life’s progress. He will bring order to your life. Turn from following vanities to serve the Living God, which made Heaven and earth, the sea and all things therein - Acts 14:15

entries.prayer: Lord, help me to turn from every sin and weight that easily beset me, and turn to You always, in Jesus Name, Amen.
entries.confession: I will follow Jesus all the days of my life!

entries.title: A Life Without God
entries.summary: As a plant must be rooted in a soil for it to flourish, so a man can only succeed when he is rooted and grounded in God.
entries.key_scripture_text: And he said, let me go , for the day breaketh, And he said , I will not let you go, except you bless me

blocks.text: As a plant must be rooted in a soil for it to flourish, so a man can only succeed when he is rooted and grounded in God. It was said of Abraham Lincoln that one of the most his important prayers he prayed as the President of the United States of America was ‘Lord, without You I MUST FAIL.’ Yes! Without God, you are programmed to fail and condemned to lose! Man was created as a vessel to contain God and without God, you are empty.

One day, Jacob was left alone and he wrestled with an angel. During the wrestling, his thigh joint was dislocated. Immediately Jacob’s thigh was dislocated, he knew he had lost the strength to run after blessings, business enterprises and all other activities. He had come to the place where he had no option but to lean on God.

His only means of ever getting blessings was for that ‘Personality’ to bless him. That is exactly what God wants. God wants to bring you to a point and time where you cannot achieve anything apart from Him. Jacob lost his strength; he needed another to enrich and bless him. His life was useless to him if the man didn’t bless him.

When God overcomes you completely, you will naturally lean on Him. You will hang on to Him as the one and only source of your life and blessings. Those who can still do a lot of things for themselves whether God helps them or not are very far from God’s demand. God intentionally reduced Gideon’s army from 32,000 to 300 soldiers so that he will know that the battle was the Lord’s.

You must be weak to become strong. You must be helpless to receive help. You must be broken if you want to breakthrough. For His strength can be perfected in weakness. You must totally lean on God because you will be a colossal failure without Him.

entries.prayer: O Lord, let every unbroken area in my life be broken in Jesus Name.
entries.confession: I am nothing without God!

entries.title: The Necessity of Spiritual Growth
entries.summary: Beloved, spiritual stagnation is the greatest killer of physical advancement. God does not manifest children; He only show forth His matured sons (Rom. 8:19). Growth in Christianity is not an option but a necessity.
entries.key_scripture_text: Now I say, that the heir; as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he lord of all.

blocks.text: Beloved, spiritual stagnation is the greatest killer of physical advancement. God does not manifest children; He only show forth His matured sons (Rom. 8:19). Growth in Christianity is not an option but a necessity. There are so many baby Christians around today that is why God cannot trust the body of Christ with certain blessings and greater levels of the anointing.

In 1 Corinthians 13:11, Paul said “When I was a child, I spoke like a child, i thought as a child, but when i became a man, I put away childish things.” No wise man will give a gun fully load with bullets to his 4-year-old boy because it can kill him. The only-wise God will never entrust you with certain blessings until you grow in the spirit.
You must grow in the Spirit because of the following reasons;
1. In order to fulfill your purpose in life. Luke 1:80 says “And

the child (John the Baptist) grew and waxed strong in spirit....” Again Luke 2:40 says of Jesus, “And the child grew and waxed strong in the spirit....” No wonder both John and Jesus were able to fulfill their assignments in life.
2. Your spirit is a channel of God’s direction (Prov. 20:27).
Therefore, without a developed spirit, you cannot receive divine direction.
3. Your spirit sustains you in time of pains /sickness. Prov. 18:14 4. Your spirit empowers you to overcome the adversities of life.
That is why you must carefully develop your spirit from today. In the subsequent days, you will learn exactly how to do that.

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to grow strong in the spirit in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am growing strong in the Lord!

entries.title: The Magnet of Attraction
entries.summary: The excited in life is always an attraction to many. It is only cheerful people who are able to build fruitful relationships in the journey of life. The more excited you are the more an attraction you become.
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

blocks.text: The excited in life is always an attraction to many. It is only cheerful people who are able to build fruitful relationships in the journey of life. The more excited you are the more an attraction you become.
No one ever wants to be with an unexcited person. Proverbs 18:24 says, ‘ ¶ A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.’

There is never a meeting point between the excited and the dullard. No man will like to marry who looks always depressed. As a married man or woman, you must always look cheerful if you really want to experience a fruitful marriage. Excitement is magnet to good things.

Joseph went through a lot of negative experiences. He could have allowed all those bad experiences to make him sad and unexcited about life. However, he decided to always remain cheerful. In the house of Potiphar, he was the most cheerful servant. No wonder Potiphar made him the chief servant. Again, in the prison, he was the most cheerful prisoner. No wonder the prison warder made him the head of the prisoner. Finally, his cheerful outlook caused him to become the Prime Minister of Egypt.

Is your marriage dying? Then try the medicine of cheerfulness (Proverbs 17:22). Are you failing in all your relationships? Then try the virtue of cheerfulness (Prov. 18:24). The cheerful person will always be the most fruitful person.

entries.prayer: O Lord, baptize me with the oil of joy in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am always cheerful and excited!

entries.title: How to Live Well
entries.summary: Good and proper feeding is essential for your survival. In as much as our bodies need to feed well in order to grow, our spirits also need the Word of God in order to live and function well.
entries.key_scripture_text: Your words were found, and I ate them, And Your word was to me the joy and rejoicing of my heart; For I am called by Your name, O LORD God of hosts.

blocks.text: Good and proper feeding is essential for your survival. In as much as our bodies need to feed well in order to grow, our spirits also need the Word of God in order to live and function well.

The goodness, fatness and strength of a soul are knowledge determined. That is why III John 2 says ‘Beloved, I wish above all things that you may prosper and be in health even as your soul prospers’. Your physical prosperity is therefore dependent on how well you feed your spirit.

If the spirit is not fed well, it will be lean and famish in the end. Prov.19:2 says, ‘Also it is not good for a soul to be without knowledge...’ Life is enriched by feeding it. Feeding determines weight and weight is what measures the impact one will make.

Feeding is a personal responsibility we must accept. When Jeremiah located the Word, he had to take the responsibility of eating it. Jeremiah 15: 16 says ‘Your words were found, and I ate them, And Your word was to me the joy and rejoicing of my heart; For I am called by Your name, O LORD God of hosts.’

No one can develop your spirit for you . You must make a decision to daily fill yourself with the Word of God through the process of quality meditation. The Words you hide in your heart are what you will give out in times of crisis. Therefore, feed well to live well!

entries.prayer: O Lord, increase my appetite for Your Word in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: The Word of God is my favourite food!

entries.title: The Best Way to Deal with Challenges
entries.summary: Challenges come the way of all men and women, young and old, learned and unlearned, rich and poor – just to all kinds of people.
entries.key_scripture_text: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world--our faith.

blocks.text: Challenges come the way of all men and women, young and old, learned and unlearned, rich and poor – just to all kinds of people.

However, when challenges come knocking at your door, answer with faith. Faith is the anchor of your life; it causes you to emerge as an over comer in every challenge you face. Usually when we encounter challenges, we are left with two options; to meet the challenge with faith or with fear. When faith appears, challenges take you up but where you respond with fear challenge takes you down it with it.

When the King Saul and the Israelites met a challenge in the person of Goliath; they responded with fear and run helter skelter seeking shelter. Men of war became very timid and virtually immobilized in the face of danger. However, when David met the same challenge, he reacted differently. He met the threatening and intimidations of Goliath with faith. Listen to young David in I Samuel 17:37, ‘...The LORD, who delivered me from the paw of the lion and from the paw of the bear, He will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine.” David’s unwavering faith in God caused him to conquer Goliath.
Challenges will never leave you the way they met you. When faith is in place challenges turn into positive effect. On the other hand, when fear is in place, challenges turn into negative effect.

Take advantage of challenges by injecting faith into it whenever any comes your way. I John 5:4 says, ‘For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world--our faith.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, release the spirit of unwavering faith upon me in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am full of faith!

entries.title: How to Multiply Your Impact
entries.summary: To multiply your impact however, you must grow in your leadership. Leadership is to be developed no matter the vocation in which you find yourself. In life everybody leads someone at one point in time or the other.
entries.key_scripture_text: Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.

blocks.text: When you contact the Almighty, you must make impact. Impact is living for others to live.

To multiply your impact however, you must grow in your leadership. Leadership is to be developed no matter the vocation in which you find yourself. In life everybody leads someone at one point in time or the other. Whether you are a parent leading your children, an employer leading your employees or a pastor leading a congregation, you must decide to become an effective leader.

A leader offers direction, sensitizes people and mobilizes them to follow. Every effective leader must lead by example. This simply means they don’t simply show the way; they rather walk alongside the followers in the way. 1 Peter 5:3 says, ‘Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.’

A leader teaches and raises others to take his place. He or she is a duplicator and multiplier of grace. Paul entreated Timothy the young leader in II Timothy 2: 2, ‘And the things that you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit these to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.’ For instance, King David the giant killer raised other giant killers who were known as the mighty men of David.

A leader is one who deliberately teaches others all he knows. He does not hide or hoard knowledge. He distributes freely from his bank of knowledge. He understands that the more he shares, the more it multiples. Sharing is developing capacity to accommodate more. Paul said in Acts 20: 27, “for I didn’t shrink from declaring all that God wants you to know.”- NLT

Keep developing yourself to become a leader of worth. Learn from the virtues as well as the mistakes of the leaders in the Bible and from other anointed books. Make a firm decision today to become an effective leader if you desire to multiply your effect and influence.

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to become an effective leader in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: My life will affect others positively!

entries.title: A Day Without Prayer
entries.summary: Prayer is not what we choose to do but what we must do; it is not what we like to do but what we are mandated to do.
entries.key_scripture_text: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint

blocks.text: Prayer is not what we choose to do but what we must do; it is not what we like to do but what we are mandated to do. If you are not praying you will be fainting and loosing breath in the journey of life because by strength (physical abilities) shall no man prevail (I Samuel 2:9)

All great men in Scripture were prayerful. Prayer is cure to faint heartedness. Prayerful people are therefore bold people. In prayer, you stand before God and if you can stand before God then you can stand before any man.

There is no alternative to prayer no matter how colourful such appears to be. Jesus prayed always and never fainted once. The difficulties of life did not stop Jesus from praying. It was during such times that He even prayed more seriously. Luke 22:44 says, ‘ And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.’
Peter and others escaped fainting because they prayed always. Acts.6:4. Paul advocated that the believer must pray always and without ceasing. 1 Thes.5:17; Eph.6:16
Prayer is the believer’s spiritual respiratory organ. A day without prayer is a risky day.

If you are not praying, you will be choking, panting, fainting and failing – a church that prays always enjoy ventilation. Nothing dissolves crisis in a church like prayer. Satan attempted to stop the growth of the first church in Acts chapter 5 but the church stopped him by renewing their commitment to prayer in Act 6:4. Because we are tempted and attacked always, we must pray always.
That is the only guarantee for our victory always!

entries.prayer: O Lord, pour upon me the spirit of prayer in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I pray without ceasing!

entries.title: How to Shine in Life
entries.summary: The Word of God is a lamp unto our feet and a LIGHT UNTO OUR PATHS (Psalm 119:105). Whenever light appears, shining follows.
entries.key_scripture_text: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.

blocks.text: The Word of God is a lamp unto our feet and a LIGHT UNTO OUR PATHS (Psalm 119:105). Whenever light appears, shining follows. It doesn’t matter the darkness around you, when you begin to catch light (revelation) from God’s Word, you will automatically begin to shine in the affairs of our lives.

We shine by what we see. You cannot see and not shine. It is what we see that determines how we shine. Is.60:1-2 says, ‘1 ¶ Arise, shine; For your light has come! And the glory of the LORD is risen upon you. 2 For behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, And deep darkness the people; But the LORD will arise over you, And His glory will be seen upon you.’

But you have to position yourself well to see well. Rev.4:1 says, ‘1 ¶ After these things I looked, and behold, a door standing open in heaven. And the first voice which I heard was like a trumpet speaking with me, saying, “Come up here, and I will show you things which must take place after this.”

The platform to see well is spirituality. Spirituality sharpens your sight and enhances the effect of your spiritual antenna. Live holy, pray in the spirit, sing in the spirit and walk in the spirit in order to enhance your spirituality. One word from Heaven can cause your destiny to move out of obscurity into the limelight. Psalm 119:30 says, “The entrance of Your Word gives light and gives understanding unto the simple’. When God sends a Word to you (light), it doesn’t just affect you but also it causes all those connected to your destiny to shine. Isaiah 9:8 says, ‘The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, open my eyes to see the mysteries of the Scriptures in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I enjoy divine revelations!

entries.title: How to Manage the Demands of Life
entries.summary: Destiny places a lot of demands on mortals. The best of life will always demand the best of you.
entries.key_scripture_text: Casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.

blocks.text: Destiny places a lot of demands on mortals. The best of life will always demand the best of you.

Jesus already warned us to take no thought about what to eat or drink. Matt.6: 25 says “Therefore I say to you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink; nor about your body, what you will put on. Is not life more than food and the body more than clothing?’ The cares of this life chokes destiny and destroys potentials.
Live your life absolutely depending on the One who knew you before He made you (Jeremiah 1:5). Your parents knew you after you were born but God knew you even before you were born.

Roll your care upon Him (I Peter 5:7) because you can simply not handle them. Life is too heavy to carry, release it to the Owner and the Manager of it. He has provided for your total well-being in it. He cannot mismanage your life for you. Leave it absolutely to Him and it will amaze you how He will turn it back to you. Be rest assured that no matter the circumstance and situation God will certainly take care of you. Do not exchange your peace for anxiety. Phil.4:6-7 says, ‘6 Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God; 7 and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus .

One of the most dangerous parties to attend is a ‘pity party’. Pity parties cause you to live in a realm of anxiety and worry. However, what you must know is that easiest route to worry and apprehension is to attempt to care for yourself.

Take your rest in God and He will take care of the rest for you. Whenever you feel like worrying; don’t because you have a God who has your whole destiny in His hands. Stop the pity party because you are not a person to be pitied but rather a person to be envied!

entries.prayer: O Lord, from today I cast all my cares upon you in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: God is in charge of my life!

entries.title: Be Determined to Please God!
entries.summary: In the journey of life, your only one desire must be to please God in all you do. Rather than struggling to impress people, strive to do what is right. One of the dangers of life is to try to confuse the applause of men with the affirmation of Heaven.
entries.key_scripture_text: For do I now persuade men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? For if I still pleased men, I would not be a bondservant of Christ.

blocks.text: In the journey of life, your only one desire must be to please God in all you do. Rather than struggling to impress people, strive to do what is right. One of the dangers of life is to try to confuse the applause of men with the affirmation of Heaven. However, what you must know is that, men may applaud you but may be God might have rejected you. What is popular with men may be unpopular with God. Daniel and his friends purposed in their hearts not to defile themselves...Daniel 1:8

Therefore, simply keep doing what is right and you will come out of the pressure of pleasing people. Those who do right things don’t ever fear been faulted by men because doing it right has already earned them God’s approval. Right doing is what gives you your right place in the school of life. Keep doing what is right and you will never fear any evil.

You must choose to rather obey God than to please men. This is what the Jewish elders wanted the disciples to do. However, Peter the leader of the disciples and the others responded in Ac 5:29 this way, ‘...We ought to obey God rather than men.’ In this wicked and perverse generations where sin is on the ascendancy and morality has been jettisoned somewhere there must be a new breed of people who will always be determined to please God rather than men.

You must never follow the multitude to do evil (Exodus 23:2) because the majority is not always right. In fact, they are mostly wrong. Decide to stand up for God! Never blend with the world because whoever is a friend of the world is an automatic enemy of God (James 4:4)

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to always please You in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always please God!

entries.title: How to Position Yourself for Big Things
entries.summary: Small things matter to God, we must not wait to see big things before we thank God. There is nothing too small to thank God for. There should be no difference between our thanksgiving for seemingly little things and big things.
entries.key_scripture_text: In everything give thanks; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.

blocks.text: Small things matter to God, we must not wait to see big things before we thank God. There is nothing too small to thank God for. There should be no difference between our thanksgiving for seemingly little things and big things. For instance, when God delivers you from a minor headache, your thanksgiving and appreciation must be the same if He had delivered you from a major asthma attack.

Great men don’t make assumptions; they mind details. A fool keeps waiting for ‘big bang’ to give big thanks. The difference between the one and nine lepers is that he saw what others referred to as little and insignificant, and he magnified it. It was this same leper who later on experienced wholeness in his body. All the other nine lepers experienced a fraction of the healing virtue but only the thankful leper experienced his total and permanent deliverance from leprosy. Luke 17: 17-19, ’17 And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine? 18 There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger. 19 And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.’

To qualify for big things, give thanks to God for small things. Do not slight His acts if you don’t want to be slighted by Him. Micah 2:1-2 says, ‘1 ¶ “And now, O priests, this commandment is for you. 2 If you will not hear, And if you will not take it to heart, To give glory to My name,” Says the LORD of hosts, “I will send a curse upon you, And I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have cursed them already, Because you do not take it to heart.’ Don’t ignore small things because it is small things that make a big thing to happen. God doesn’t have problem blessing you with big things if you will only acknowledge him for ‘small’ things. Those who regard God’s act as insignificant will be reduced to insignificance in his eyes. Learn to ALWAYS THANK HIM FOR EVERYTHING; THE SMALL AS WELL AS THE BIG THINGS HE DOES FOR YOU!

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a heart of gratitude in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am ready for God’s best!

entries.title: Growing in God
entries.summary: You cannot help studying God’s Word without concluding that Relationships are a high priority with God. He cares about His creatures! Love permeates His very Nature and every aspect of His Person.
entries.key_scripture_text: And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.

blocks.text: You cannot help studying God’s Word without concluding that Relationships are a high priority with God. He cares about His creatures! Love permeates His very Nature and every aspect of His Person. The Christian is one in whom God abides and is manifested. A major part of manifesting God in our lives is the expression of God’s Love in our relationships with others. John 13:35, “By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another.”
Every man must develop a relationship with God. To build this kind of strong relationship with God, you must do the following;
Know God
John 17:3, “And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.’ Love God
Matthew 22:37-38, “ 37 Jesus said to him,” ‘You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ 38 “This is the first and great commandment.” Serve God
Luke 4: 8, ‘ And Jesus answered and said to him, “Get behind Me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the LORD your God, and Him only you shall serve.’

“When you come to KNOW God, you will LOVE Him. And when you come to Love Him, you will want to SERVE Him. If you don’t want to Serve God, maybe it is because you don’t really Love Him. And if you don’t Love God, maybe it is because you don’t really Know Him”

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to know you more and more in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I have a strong relationship with God!

entries.title: Practicing God’s Presence
entries.summary: Godly living is living with God in our lives. In other words, recognizing and practicing God’s presence, His life in us. God also wants us to follow His instructions and celebrate His blessings.
entries.key_scripture_text: Vr. 10 & 11 “For he who has entered His rest has himself also ceased from his works as God did from His; Let us therefore be diligent to enter that rest, lest anyone fall according to the same example of disobedience.

blocks.text: Godly living is living with God in our lives. In other words, recognizing and practicing God’s presence, His life in us. God also wants us to follow His instructions and celebrate His blessings. He desires that we dwell in and esteem His presence, because doing so distinguishes us from everyone else. His presence in us and with us makes the difference.

In Exodus 3:3, God appeared to Moses in a burning bush, which was a dramatic way to get someone’s attention in this instance. But now it should not take anything dramatic for us to be aware of God’s presence in our lives because of the presence of the Holy Spirit. Jesus said He will be in us and abide with us as He goes to the Father - John 14: 26. He is the abiding presence. At the same time, we have to be alert to seek out God’s presence and working in everyday circumstances, because it often comes in ways we don’t expect.
To abide in His presence daily we have to do the following: Continually praise, pray, study the Word, obey God and live in holiness.

entries.prayer: Oh Lord, help me to practice and be in your presence. In Jesus Name. Amen.
entries.confession: I practice God’s Presence daily!

entries.title: Remain Faithful to the Vision
entries.summary: At times, you may be tempted by the devil, to believe that the fulfillment of your God-given vision is an impossibility. It is an illusion.
entries.key_scripture_text: Vr.28 “And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are called according to His purpose.

blocks.text: At times, you may be tempted by the devil, to believe that the fulfillment of your God-given vision is an impossibility. It is an illusion. But remember, the same God who gave you the vision is more than capable and sufficient to give you whatever gifts and abilities you need to realize His purpose for your life. The fact is, you have to be aware of the vision first, write it down, run with it (ie. Do something about it), and never lose focus, stay with it. Hab. 2:2-3.

Remaining faithful to God’s vision for your life assures you of finding favour with God and with others. Joseph never gave up on his vision but waited patiently on God to see all his dreams come true, no matter what he went through he still believed his dreams. (Read Genesis 39:2-9). At the right time God took him from the prison to the palace.
David was also was promised the kingship of Israel but he had to wait patiently for God’s divine timing. (2 Samuel 2:1-11)
God has a perfect vision for your life, so do not lose hope. Stay faithful to Him and you will never be disappointed.

entries.prayer: Oh Lord help me to stay faithful to the vision you have for me.
entries.confession: I stay faithful to my vision!

entries.title: The Purpose of the Anointing
entries.summary: Jesus the “Anointed one” (the Messiah) in Isaiah 61:1, spoke of His Messianic task in Luke 4:18-19.
entries.key_scripture_text: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me, Because He has anointed Me; to preach the gospel to the poor: He has sent Me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and recovery of sight to the blind; To set at liberty those who are oppressed. To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.

blocks.text: Jesus the “Anointed one” (the Messiah) in Isaiah 61:1, spoke of His Messianic task in Luke 4:18-19. This was not just a proper name, but a title which identified Jesus of Nazareth as the Messiah (the anointed one of God), which is interpreted in Greek as the “Christ.”
The Spirit of God upon Jesus Christ (the Anointed One) was to;
* Preach the Gospel to the poor (the Great Commission)
* Proclaim liberty to captives (deliverance Ministry)
* Heal the sick and the broken hearted (Healing Ministry)
* Tell of the acceptable year of the Lord (Prophesying)
And as children of God, He wants us to imitate Him and His works. Jesus said John 14:12 that, “if we believe in Him, the works that He did, we will also do and even do greater.”
May you do greater works for God in Jesus Name. Amen.

entries.prayer: Oh Lord, empower me to do mighty and greater works according to Your Word, in Jesus Name. Amen.
entries.confession: I do greater works!

entries.title: Moving Higher on the Ladder of Life
entries.summary: In life, some crawl, others walk, some run and others fly. As a child of God, you must decide to be a highflier in life.
entries.key_scripture_text: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

blocks.text: In life, some crawl, others walk, some run and others fly. As a child of God, you must decide to be a highflier in life. One man said, “ Destiny is not a matter of chance, it is a matter of choice; it is not a thing to be waited for, it is a thing to be achieved.”

Of all the creatures in the world, human beings are physically the most ill-equipped. A human cannot fly like a bird, outrun a leopard, swim like an alligator nor climb like a monkey. A human does not have the eye of an eagle nor the claws and teeth of a wild cat. Physically humans are helpless and defenceless. However, God is reasonable and kind. God’s greatest gift to humankind is the ability to think and make the right choices in life. Humans can therefore create their own environment, whereas animals adapt to their own environment. Sadly, very few people use the greatest gift- the ability to think – to its full potential. Failures are of two kinds: those who did and never thought and those who thought and never did.

Life is full of choices and choices have consequences. Today, you are a result of the choices you made yesterday; tomorrow, you will be a picture of the choices you are making today. That is why you must think through your decisions and make the right choices if you really desire to gain new heights this New Year. When you eat too much, you make a choice to be overweight; when you decide to take alcohol, you make a choice to destroy your liver and break your home; when you don’t care for other people, you choose not to be cared for by other people. Always be guided in your thinking and choices by the Word of God. By so doing, you will know how to refuse the evil, and choose the good as Jesus did (Isaiah 7:14-15).

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to make the right choices in life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am flying higher and higher!

entries.title: Pay the Price for the Prize!
entries.summary: You are born-again to be a high-flier – Prov. 4:18. Life is like a cafeteria. You take your tray, select your food and pay at the other end. You can get anything you want as long as you are willing to pay for the price.
entries.key_scripture_text: looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

blocks.text: You are born-again to be a high-flier – Prov. 4:18. Life is like a cafeteria. You take your tray, select your food and pay at the other end. You can get anything you want as long as you are willing to pay for the price. In a cafeteria, if you wait for people to serve you, you will wait forever. Life is like that too; you make choices and pay the price to succeed!

Without pain there can never be gain. For every new height to scale; there is a new price to pay. Therefore, those who dodge pain will miss gain. Without pain there cannot be access to gain. While many see pain as intimidating obstacle only very few see it as platform for gaining access to next level. Whenever you feel the pain then see the gain. Hebrews 12: 2 says “looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.”

Never be crushed by pain whenever it comes; rather, count the gain. Refuse to be blinded by pains; behold the gains that come thereafter. It will take a toll on you but it will make you stand tall in life. It will never become your turn to gain new height for as long as you keep turning away from pain and sacrifices. No one ever gets tall without a toll on him. You never get tall without paying a toll. The pain you are willing to bear will determine the crown you will be allowed to wear. Jesus Christ is wearing the greatest crown today because; He experienced the greatest pain on the cross of Calvary.

Your access to rose flower is at the mercy of your ability to endure the thorns that surrounds it. Never mind the “thorns” as you seek access to the rose. Like the Apostle, keep stretching and pressing for the prize of the high calling of Christ.

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to endure my cross in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am advancing no matter what!

entries.title: The Saving Grace
entries.summary: Grace simply means undeserved or unmerited favour. It simply means when God does for you what you don’t deserve.
entries.key_scripture_text: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

blocks.text: Grace simply means undeserved or unmerited favour. It simply means when God does for you what you don’t deserve. Jesus Christ is the custodian of Grace and therefore when you get connected to Him, you are expected to flow in unending and exceeding Grace - John 1:17, ‘For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.’ There is the Saving dimension of Grace. The greatest gift that Heaven gave humanity is salvation and it was by an act of Grace. How can you explain this; that a chronic sinner has simply become a celebrated saint. We were all living in sin until we experienced an extension of the hands of Grace upon our lives - Titus 3:7, ‘That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.’

Titus 2:11-14 also says ‘11 ¶ For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, 12 Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world; 13 Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ; 14 Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.’
As a Christian, you must always pray for the saving Grace to flow to the masses who don’t know Jesus and you must help others to experience the saving Grace by sharing the Gospel with them.

entries.prayer: O Lord, let Your Saving Grace flow throughout the world in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am saved by Grace!

entries.title: The Giving Grace
entries.summary: The Grace of God is the maker of men; no glorious destiny can be constructed without the ingredient of Grace.
entries.key_scripture_text: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ

blocks.text: The Grace of God is the maker of men; no glorious destiny can be constructed without the ingredient of Grace. So, when Paul was giving a summary of his exploits in the ministry, he stated emphatically without no apology ‘I am what I am by the Grace of God....’ – I Cor. 15:10. That is why the Apostle Paul in his letter to his spiritual son Timothy admonished him to be strong in the Grace of God - 2Timothy 2:1, ‘¶ Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus. ‘
There is a Sacrificial or Giving dimension of Grace
When this Grace comes upon you, you are joyful to spend and be spent for the Kingdom of God. You will do everything, give everything and go anywhere for God.
Paul - Ephesians 3:8 Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
The Macedonian Church

II Corinthians 8:1-4, ‘1 ¶ Moreover, brethren, we make known to you the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia:2 that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded in the riches of their liberality. 3 For I bear witness that according to their ability, yes, and beyond their ability, they were freely willing, 4 imploring us with much urgency that we would receive the gift and the fellowship of the ministering to the saints. 5 And not only as we had hoped, but they first gave themselves to the Lord, and then to us by the will of God. 6 So we urged Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also complete this grace in you as well. 7 ¶ But as you abound in everything--in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in all diligence, and in your love for us--see that you abound in this grace also.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, let the giving Grace come strongly upon me in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am ready to sacrifice my all for the Kingdom!

entries.title: The Healing Grace
entries.summary: Sickness and weakness are all satanic afflictions. They are arrows sent by the enemy to slow you down in the journey of life. You can be made strong out of your weakness.
entries.key_scripture_text: And He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My strength is made perfect in weakness.” Therefore most gladly I will rather boast in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me

blocks.text: Sickness and weakness are all satanic afflictions. They are arrows sent by the enemy to slow you down in the journey of life. You can be made strong out of your weakness. Sometimes, the devil will tell you, this sickness is unto death, you will never recover from it. In such times, you must say defiantly to the enemy, I AM BOUNCING BACK; OUT OF WEAKNESS, I SHALL BE MADE STRONG - Hebrews 11:32-34, ‘32 ¶ And what more shall I say? For the time would fail me to tell of Gideon and Barak and Samson and Jephthah, also of David and Samuel and the prophets:33 who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions, 34 quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, became valiant in battle, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.’

There is a special Grace for healing which can perfect your strength even in times of weakness - II Corinthians 12:7-9, ‘And lest I should be exalted above measure by the abundance of the revelations, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I be exalted above measure. 8 Concerning this thing I pleaded with the Lord three times that it might depart from me. 9 And He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My strength is made perfect in weakness.” Therefore, most gladly I will rather boast in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me’
Today, may the Healing Grace break every yoke of sickness in your life in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, let Your healing Grace flow into my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never grow weak!

entries.title: The Prosperity Grace
entries.summary: Very shortly, you will become an object of argument. Your hand will no longer be empty. Your pocket will no longer be empty. Your hand will not touch the bottom of your pocket or bag again.
entries.key_scripture_text: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

blocks.text: Very shortly, you will become an object of argument. Your hand will no longer be empty. Your pocket will no longer be empty. Your hand will not touch the bottom of your pocket or bag again. The era of begging and borrowing is over in your life in Jesus Name! - Isaiah 62:10, “10 ¶ Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.”
There is a wealth whose source is not traceable to the earth (Heaven made wealth). Financial explosion is a reality, the economic instability notwithstanding.
Abraham walked in financial explosion, as well as Isaac and all our covenant fathers.
Genesis 13:2, “ And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
Genesis 24:1, “ And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.”

However, you must understand that there is a Grace that can take you from the realm of financial struggles into a realm of financial rest; in spite of the prevailing harsh economic climate; you can still prosper. At this level, people cannot see your sweat but they simply cannot deny your effect. This is because there is SOMETHING WORKING FOR YOU THAT IS NOT WORKING FOR THEM (GRACE) - 2Co 9:8, ‘And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:’

entries.prayer: O Lord, connect me to the Prosperity Grace in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: Everything I do shall prosper!

entries.title: The Leading Grace
entries.summary: There is a Grace that will cause you to take the lead in all you do. It causes you to emerge as the head even among heads and to shine brighter even among stars (Deut. 28:13). In life, you go ahead by Grace and you also become the head by Grace.
entries.key_scripture_text: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.

blocks.text: There is a Grace that will cause you to take the lead in all you do. It causes you to emerge as the head even among heads and to shine brighter even among stars (Deut. 28:13). In life, you go ahead by Grace and you also become the head by Grace. Zechariah 4:7, ‘Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.’

Esther - Esther 2:17, ‘And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti’ Joseph – AMONG STARS HE WAS THE STAR – Gen. 37:9, ‘And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.’ This Grace that was upon Joseph was so strong that, in the house of Portiphar, he was the head; in the prison, he was the head and in the palace of Pharaoh, he was the head. Daniel – AMONG PRESIDENTS, HE WAS THE PRESIDENT Daniel 12:1-3, ‘1 ¶ It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom 2 And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage. 3 Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me shine no matter what in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am taking giant steps forward!

entries.title: How to Access Grace
entries.summary: 2Co 9:14, ‘And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.’
entries.key_scripture_text: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

blocks.text: In order for you to access Grace, you must do the following;
1. Engage in serious prayers- Heb. 4:16
2Co 9:14, ‘And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.’
Grace of God can be accessed through knowledge
2 Pet.1:2, ‘Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,’
Grace can be accessed through humility
1Pe 5:5 ¶ Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
4. But Grace of men can be duplicated via impartation.
You have to be teachable and sensitive to receive this kind of Grace.

Nu 11:25, And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease. Nu 11:26, But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp. Impartation is the atmosphere for circulation and distinction of grace for anyone and everyone who so desires it.

entries.prayer: O Lord, release Your abundant Grace upon me in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am living under the canopy of Grace!

entries.title: Labour to Be Blessed
entries.summary: The greatest threat to Christianity is Christians trying to make it to Heaven without doing anything for God. In life, we are owners of nothing but stewards of everything. Stewardship a call to labour.
entries.key_scripture_text: 1 ¶ After these things the Lord appointed seventy others also, and sent them two by two before His face into every city and place where He Himself was about to go. 2 Then He said to them, “The harvest truly is great, but the laborers are few; therefore pray the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest.

blocks.text: The greatest threat to Christianity is Christians trying to make it to Heaven without doing anything for God. In life, we are owners of nothing but stewards of everything. Stewardship a call to labour. We are not just workers but labourers in the kingdom. Jesus called labourers (fishers of men) - Matt.4:19

Jesus prayed for labourers because without an abundant supply of labourers the Kingdom of God cannot spread - Matt.9:37-38. The harvest demands labourers. If you are not prepared to labour, you are not fit to be a steward in this kingdom.
Only labours have reward. Lk.10:7
Only labourers are paid. Heb.6:10
Only labourers can be steadfast – 1 Cor.15:58
It is labourers that are favoured. Ps.102:13,14
What is Labour?
It is exerting force on your duty.
It is investing time into a project
It is expending energy on your assignment.
It is sweating to see your job done.
A labourer is one who does the least of work (dust) in this kingdom. You must do something for God this year. The most authentic route to greatness is servant hood.

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to work hard for the advancement of Your Kingdom in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never stop doing God’s work!

entries.title: In Pursuit of Wisdom
entries.summary: Many are working very hard and yet things are very hard for them, because they are not working with wisdom. Work is defined as applying force in the right direction. One of the major benefits of wisdom is also direction. Eccl. 10:10 says, ‘...
entries.key_scripture_text: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.

blocks.text: Many are working very hard and yet things are very hard for them, because they are not working with wisdom. Work is defined as applying force in the right direction. One of the major benefits of wisdom is also direction. Eccl. 10:10 says, ‘... Wisdom is profitable to direct.’ David became the toast and the darling boy of Israel because he added wisdom to his hard work. 1 Sam.18:5 says, ‘5 So David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved wisely. And Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.’

In order for one’s hard work not to be destroyed you have to work wise. Working wise is the complement to working hard. Working wise is the platform to unveil the effect of working hard. Working hard and not working wise will lead to weariness - Eccl.10:15. Working wise will save you from wasting energy. Motion is not equal to progress and sweat is not equal to profit. May you receive wisdom in order to become a pacesetter and a trail blazer in your field in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, direct my steps in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I work with wisdom!

entries.title: Be Strong in the Lord!
entries.summary: Those who dominate in the spiritual realm will automatically dominate in the physical realm. This is because everything is a spiritual situation before it becomes a physical condition. In this New Year, you must be fervent in spirit.
entries.key_scripture_text: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

blocks.text: Those who dominate in the spiritual realm will automatically dominate in the physical realm. This is because everything is a spiritual situation before it becomes a physical condition. In this New Year, you must be fervent in spirit. This simply means, you must not joke with your spiritual life. Never allow the activities and the busy-ness of life to kill your relationship and intimacy with God. To be fervent in spirit, you must engage in the following spiritual exercises
1. Be Persistent in Prayer: To be persistent means to hold firm or

steadfastly to something. Despite the odds, obstacles, defeats and set-backs, you stick to it. A classic example in the Bible is blind Bartimaeus. He screamed, ‘Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me’ People in the crowd said, ‘Shut up and die in your blindness’. He ignored them and simply kept on crying to Jesus until he was called out of the crowd. This year, ignore all the anti-prayer agents in your life (TV, too much conversation, too much sleep, etc) and continue to scream to God in prayer if you want to make it.
Study the Bible : Joshua 1:8 says ‘This Book of the Law shall

not depart out of thy mouth but thou shall meditate on it day and night...’. You must be addicted to the Word. Always carry your Bible around you and empty its deposits into your heart. Always live by the standards of the Word of God.
3. Wait on God in fasting: Fasting is the accelerator pedal of prayer.

As you learn the art of waiting on God, you will end as a heavy- weight in the spirit. Paul was a fervent in the spirit because he loved to fast. 2 Corinthians 11:27, ‘ In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often , in cold and nakedness.’

entries.prayer: O Lord increase my zeal for spiritual things in this New Year in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am strong in the Lord!

entries.title: Speak Up for Jesus!
entries.summary: As a child of God, you are the mouthpiece of God on earth. The only thing that will cause evil to grow its peak is for Christians to remain silence.
entries.key_scripture_text: For though I preach not the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me, yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the Gospel.”.

blocks.text: As a child of God, you are the mouthpiece of God on earth. The only thing that will cause evil to grow its peak is for Christians to remain silence. We must never dim our lights to accommodate the darkness around us but we must rather shine as light in this dark world.

Every Christian is appointed by God as a qualified and a certified watchman over the souls of men. Ezekiel 3:17-18 says, “Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me. When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked man he shall die in his iniquity; but HIS BLOOD WILL I REQUIRE AT THINE HAND”. Right here is a “Murder Charge ” against anyone who does not win souls. Since no murderer shall inherit the kingdom of Heaven, you must beware. The responsibilities of the souls of men have been entrusted into the hands of every believer .

When Paul met Jesus on the road to Damascus, the first question he asked was “ ...,Lord, what wilt thou have me to do?.......” Unlike Paul, a new convert will start by asking Jesus, “Lord, what will You do for me?” Clear case of misplaced priorities! No wonder we are suffering. The first commandment of Jesus to His disciples was evangelism (Matthew 4:19) and the last commandment was evangelism (Matt. 28:19-20).

Archibald Brown said, the Gospel is a fact therefore tell it simply . The Gospel is a joyful fact, therefore tell it cheerfully. It is an entrusted fact; therefore, tell it faithfully, It is a fact of the infinite moment; therefore preach Christ” . Share the Word! One person at a time and we would change this world for Jesus! No more silence! Speak up for Jesus! Plunder hell to populate Heaven!

entries.prayer: O Lord, let me be an active participant of Your agenda on earth in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am on the service team of God.

entries.title: Your Time, Your Life
entries.summary: You must master the art of investing your time because time lost can never be recovered. One of the dictionary definitions of investment is ‘to spend time or effort with the expectation of some satisfaction’.
entries.key_scripture_text: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

blocks.text: You must master the art of investing your time because time lost can never be recovered. One of the dictionary definitions of investment is ‘to spend time or effort with the expectation of some satisfaction’. To effectively invest your time, you must do the following; 1. Invest time in God

You invest in God by spending time to study the Bible, praying and fellowshipping with the Holy Spirit. The lives of all great men and women in the Bible reveal that they spent time with God. When we really spend time with God, we become transformed, we sense His Presence in our lives more and we receive strength and direction for the journey.
Acts 4:13, ‘Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.’
Invest time in Yourself
The greater your destiny, the more time you must invest in yourself. IN THE GAME OF LIFE, WHAT YOU PUT IN IS WHAT YOU
CAN WITHDRAW.

If you are student and you want to be counted among the achievers in your school, then you must go beyond the minimum. You must be diligent enough to study very hard. If you are in the ministry or in any other business you must develop a studious lifestyle in order to get to the top. Proverbs 22:29 ¶ Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men
Invest time in Eternity

God invested His son in us because of eternity. That is why we must do things that carry eternal rewards. When you win people to Christ, you are investing in something that will bring sure rewards in eternity. When you go out of your way to help a needy person; when you take care of an orphan and visit those in the prisons you are laying up treasures in Heaven. Matthew 6:19-20

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to use my time for profitable ventures in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I refuse to waste my time!

entries.title: Breaking the Chains of Pornography Addiction
entries.summary: Your eye is the door to your life. Whatever your eyes behold is what your heart will naturally pursue and determine the direction your body will follow. The birth of Samson was a mysterious one.
entries.key_scripture_text: Then went Samson to Gaza, and SAW THERE AN HARLOT, and WENT IN UNTO HER.

blocks.text: Your eye is the door to your life. Whatever your eyes behold is what your heart will naturally pursue and determine the direction your body will follow. The birth of Samson was a mysterious one. Angels actually prophesied about his birth and the exploits that he will do for God. However, instead of Samson to actualize his God-given destiny by being an instrument of glory; he became a tool of mockery in the camp of his enemies. What happened? He simply failed to guard his eyes. The Bible says in Judges 16:1 that when Samson went to Gaza, he SAW there an harlot and since whatever your eyes see, your body follows, he WENT IN UNTO HER.

Never watch what you don’t want to experience in your life. Your eye is the vision of your life. It is what it sees that will be eventually actualized. Your eye sets the pace for motion. It is your eye that attracts you to things. It is God who gave you eyes. Prov. 20:12 says, “The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.” God gave you those eyes for seeing only good things. Give direction to your eye to give direction to your destiny. Stop watching naked women and naked men doing their own things in movies and magazines!

Do away with pornography if you don’t want to destroy your destiny. Do you have any nude pictures in your room? Burn them today! Do you have any music videos with totally or partially naked women in them? Destroy them. Don’t deceive yourself. You are not stronger than Samson and you are not wiser than God. Be like Job who said in Job 31:1, “I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?” Guard your eyes!!

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to watch only the right things in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am seriously guarding my eyes!

entries.title: Stop the Excuses!
entries.summary: Losers always have a book full of excuses to tell you why they could not.
entries.key_scripture_text: But they all with one accord began to make excuses. The first said to him, ‘I have bought a piece of ground, and I must go and see it. I ask you to have me excused.

blocks.text: Losers always have a book full of excuses to tell you why they could not. We normally hear excuses like, ‘I am unlucky, I’m too young, I’m too old, the economy is bad, I’m handicapped, I’m not good looking, I’m not smart, I don’t have enough money and the list goes on....

In India, they have a particular strategy that they use in catching monkeys. Monkey-hunters use a box with an opening at the top, big enough for the monkey to slide its hand into. Inside the box are nuts. The monkey grabs the nuts and now its hand becomes a fist. The monkey tries to get its hand out but the opening is big enough for the hand to slide into but too small for the fist to come out of. Now the monkey has a choice, either to let go off the nuts and be free forever or hang on to the nuts and get caught. Guess what it p picks every time? You guessed it. He hangs on to the nuts and gets caught.

Most people are no different from monkeys. They hang on to the nuts that keep them from going forward in life. Such people keep on rationalizing by saying, ‘I can’t do this because...’ and whatever comes after ‘because’ are the nuts that they are hanging onto that are holding us back.

Those who were invited for the feast in Luke 14 began to MAKE EXCUSES. Excuses are made; they are not real. Never hold on to your excuses if you really want to excel in life. THE EASIEST WAY TO TRAP YOUR DESTINY IS TO HOLD ON TO YOUR EXCUSES! Your background should never be the grounds for your failure. You can make it no matter what!

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to overcome the things that are limiting my destiny in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I let go of any thing holding me back!

entries.title: The Most Important Prayer
entries.summary: Friend, the most dangerous place to be is to be outside the will of God for your life. It is only God who knows the ending from the beginning. Our parents got to know us after we were born, but God knew us even before we were born.
entries.key_scripture_text: Teach me to do Thy will; for Thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
