blocks.text: Friend, the most dangerous place to be is to be outside the will of God for your life. It is only God who knows the ending from the beginning. Our parents got to know us after we were born, but God knew us even before we were born. God is the Architect of our lives; He is the Master - designer of our destines. He holds the blue-print to our lives.

That is why Jeremiah 10:23 says, “.....It is not in man to direct his own steps” but the steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord (Psalm 37:23). That is why Jesus even in the Garden of Gethsemane wanted nothing but for the perfect will of God to be done. (Matt. 26:42)
Being in the centre of God’s will for your life is the greatest and the most important prayer.

Being in the centre of God’s will for your life is what makes you a centre of attraction in your generation. Being in the centre of God’s will is your security in the journey of life. The price for being in the centre of God’s will cannot be compared with the loss of being outside of His will.

That is why David prayed desperately in Psalm 40:8, “I delight to Thy will, O my God: yea, Thy law is within my heart.” Many Christians normally pray, “Lord bless what I am doing, but you must rather pray: Lord, let me do what You have blessed.” This prayer places you right the centre of God’s will.

entries.prayer: O Lord, place me at the centre of Your will for my life in Jesus Name. Amen!
entries.confession: My joy is to do God’s will!

entries.title: What You Have Can Create What You Need!
entries.summary: In life, you must understand that although you don’t have everything, you definitely have something . In fact, there is something within you that the world cannot do without.
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise

blocks.text: In life, you must understand that although you don’t have everything, you definitely have something . In fact, there is something within you that the world cannot do without. You are not like others and others are not like you; you are gloriously unique and hence there is no basis for comparison. There are many people who always want to compare their lives with those of others. This makes them to eventually lose grip of what they have and the resultant effect is inferiority complex.

What makes you unique is inside you – dig it out. Your greatness will not come from outside but from within. The poor widow’s children nearly lost his two sons to the creditors because he underestimated the bottle of oil that was in her house (II Kings 4). It was the rod in the hands of Moses that God used to do wonders in the land of Egypt. THIS MEANS THAT WHAT IS IN YOUR HOUSE OR HANDS CAN CREATE THE WONDERS YOU DESIRE.

Focus on what you have, build around it and make the most of it. In the process, you will suddenly discover that you have no basis for comparison with others. You may not have what others have but you possess within you what make you!
From today, begin to look upward for divine help and look inward for what you can do! It is a sign of foolishness to be comparing your life with other unique destinies!

entries.prayer: O Lord, open my eyes to what You have placed within me in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am too gifted to be grounded in life!

entries.title: The Mystery of Seeds and Harvest
entries.summary: One major thing you must remember is that what you are doing today whether good or bad is a seed; whatever is done to you tomorrow is your harvest. Your life today is just a reflection of your decisions, choices and actions yesterday.
entries.key_scripture_text: 7 Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.9 And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season, we shall reap, if we faint not.

blocks.text: One major thing you must remember is that what you are doing today whether good or bad is a seed; whatever is done to you tomorrow is your harvest. Your life today is just a reflection of your decisions, choices and actions yesterday. Therefore, if you don’t want the harvest you are experiencing, simply change the seeds you are sowing.

Whether it is your thoughts, actions, or behaviour, sooner or later they return and with great accuracy. Treat people with respect on your way up because you will be meeting them on your way down. Instead of a frown, give a smile; instead of pride; give humility; instead of hatred, give love; instead of retaliation, practice forgiveness; instead of discouragement, transmit hope and the list goes on.

Never allow the bad actions of others to destroy the goodness in you. Don’t allow your desire to revenge stop your blessings. Keep sowing good seeds in the journey of your life. What you make happen for others, God will definitely make happen for you. Galatians 6: 7, 9, says ‘7 Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.9 And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season, we shall reap, if we faint not.
Always remember that your seeds today is your harvest tomorrow!

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to always sow good seeds in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never stop doing good!

entries.title: You Are on the Mind of God
entries.summary: What did they call Zacchaeus in his hometown of Jericho? Most folks recognized him as the chief tax collector. The Romans may have identified him with a number. He was merely one instrument in the huge machine that brought revenues pouring into Rome.
entries.key_scripture_text: O Lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.

blocks.text: What did they call Zacchaeus in his hometown of Jericho? Most folks recognized him as the chief tax collector. The Romans may have identified him with a number. He was merely one instrument in the huge machine that brought revenues pouring into Rome. Zealots in Israel spoke of him as a traitor because he had sold out to the enemy. Others in the community may have called him names behind his back.

Yet Jesus, when He passed through the village, called Zacchaeus by his name. Looking up into the leafy tree where the little man was perched, Jesus said, “Zacchaeus, make haste and come down, for today I must stay at your house” – Luke 19:5. Although the two men had never met, Jesus called him by name. After that encounter with Christ, there was a dramatic transformation in his life.

Hearing our own name spoken means that we are known. God knows you intimately. He is keenly interested in your life. How you respond to Him will determine what you live for on this earth. It will also determine where you spend eternity. The Creator knows you well; Do you know Him at all?
If you don’t know Him, respond to His love today by accepting Him as Your Lord and Saviour.

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to know you more in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am on the mind of God!

entries.title: How to Make a Big Difference
entries.summary: What difference are we making? Big or small, it does not matter. If everyone made a small difference, we would end up with a big difference, wouldn’t we?
entries.key_scripture_text: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

blocks.text: What difference are we making? Big or small, it does not matter. If everyone made a small difference, we would end up with a big difference, wouldn’t we? For example: If every Christian made it a point to be an effective witness for Jesus Christ by sharing the Gospel, the whole world will be Christianised by now.
The torrential rains that we see come from small drops of water. That is why Job 36:27, ‘For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:’

A man was taking a morning walk on the beach. He saw that hundreds of starfish came in with the tide, and when the tide receded, the starfish were left behind on the beach. With the sun’s rays, they would die. The tide had just gone out and the starfish were still alive. The man took a few steps, picked one up, and threw it into the water. He did that repeatedly. Another man came along who couldn’t understand what this man was doing. He asked, what are you doing? There are hundreds of starfish. How many can you help? What difference does it make?’ This man did not reply, took two more steps, picked up another one’ threw it into the water, and said, ‘IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE TO THIS ONE.’ Yes! It is the little things that make a big difference. Your little prayer; your little encouragement, your little smile, your little generosity, your little acts of kindness etc. can make a big difference.

entries.prayer: O Lord, by all means let me impact my world in a positive way in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am making a big difference in my world!

entries.title: The Proof of Greatness
entries.summary: When God called Abraham, he was a nobody but by the time God was through with him, greatness had become the signature of his life.
entries.key_scripture_text: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south. And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold. And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents. And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents

blocks.text: When God called Abraham, he was a nobody but by the time God was through with him, greatness had become the signature of his life.

Abraham’s greatness was expressed and interpreted in Lot’s greatness. Gen.13:1-5. Abraham was not the only one who became great; he also made sure that his nephew Lot also became great. Don’t put everyone down in order for you alone to be at the top. No! To prove your greatness, make others great. To prove your success, make others succeed. This is the ultimate prove of success.

If you don’t want to be erased raise others. If you don’t learn to raise others you will soon erase yourself. Doesn’t just be a container of blessings but also a channel of those same blessings. Never end as a possessor of wealth but also a distributor of wealth. Real greatness is hidden in the system of making other people great. That is impact! From today, may you receive the Grace to carry others along on the journey of your success in Jesus Name!! Always be there to give a helping hand to the vulnerable.

The world measures by how materially rich a person is and the bank balance of a person. However, in the Kingdom of God, a truly great person seeks always, the success of others. He seeks to make others great as himself and even more. So, if no one around you is experiencing greatness then you are not a great person.

entries.prayer: O Lord, break any trace of self-centeredness in me in Jesus Name!!
entries.confession: I always help others to succeed!

entries.title: The Long Road
entries.summary: Ayoung girl gave her teacher a very special gift. It was a beautiful seashell. “Where did you get this?” she asked. The child told her that such shells are found only on a certain faraway beach.
entries.key_scripture_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

blocks.text: Ayoung girl gave her teacher a very special gift. It was a beautiful seashell. “Where did you get this?” she asked. The child told her that such shells are found only on a certain faraway beach.

The teacher was deeply touched, because she knew that the girl had walked many miles to find the shell. “You shouldn’t have travelled so far just to find a gift for me,” she said. The girl smiled and replied, “The long walk is part of the gift.”

This girl, wise beyond her years probably didn’t know that she was conveying a truth about Jesus Christ. He gives the wonderful gift of eternal life to all who believe in Him (Rom 6:23). It’s a treasure that carries with it forgiveness of all our sins, and God’s never-failing love.

Christ’s gift also began with a journey. He left the splendour and the grandeur of Heaven to come to our sin-soaked earth. He took upon Himself our humanity – John 1:14 and walked the long road to the Cross. There He bore our sin and all its penalty. And when I say to Him in gratitude, “It’s too much, Jesus. You shouldn’t have done it,” I can picture Him looking at me with love-filled eyes and saying tenderly, “The journey is part of the gift.” JESUS GAVE HIMSELF TO GIVE US SALVATION.
Do you know Him today? Accept Him into your heart and let Him be the Lord and Master of your life if you are yet to do so.

entries.prayer: O Lord, I appreciate You for the Gift of Your Precious Son Jesus Christ in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am in love with my Saviour and Lord Jesus Christ!

entries.title: Turning Misery into Ministry
entries.summary: God often uses sorrow in our lives to open our eyes to the pain of others and to equip us to comfort them. Something good happens when we get our eyes off our own pain and minister out of it to hurting people.
entries.key_scripture_text: 6 Even when we are weighed down with troubles, it is for your comfort and salvation! For when we ourselves are comforted, we will certainly comfort you. Then you can patiently endure the same things we suffer. 7 We are confident that as you share in our sufferings, you will also share in the comfort God gives us.

blocks.text: God often uses sorrow in our lives to open our eyes to the pain of others and to equip us to comfort them. Something good happens when we get our eyes off our own pain and minister out of it to hurting people. In the midst of comforting others through the power of the Holy Spirit, we find the comfort we crave.

Look at the life of the Patriarch Joseph. He started having a lot of wonderful dreams at a tender age and he was the favourite of his father Jacob. However, he started experiencing misery when out of hatred, his own brothers sold him into slavery. His troubles continued when he was falsely accused by the wife of Potiphar and finally landed in the prison.

However, Joseph while in prison turned his misery into ministry. He was a great source of hope and inspiration to other prisoners. He interpreted the dreams of the butler and the baker. Joseph finally landed in the palace because he made a concrete decision to always turn his misery into ministry.

The Apostle Paul always turned his misery into ministry. Listen to him in II Corinthians 1:6-7, ‘6 Even when we are weighed down with troubles, it is for your comfort and salvation! For when we ourselves are comforted, we will certainly comfort you. Then you can patiently endure the same things we suffer. 7 We are confident that as you share in our sufferings, you will also share in the comfort God gives us.’
This was how although he was a latecomer, he eventually became a frontliner in the early Church.
Receive Grace to always turn your misery into ministry in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, open my eyes to the hurts of those around me and make me a blessing to them in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am a blessing to many!

entries.title: The Greatest Mistake You Can Ever Make
entries.summary: The greatest mistake you can make in your life is to STOP DOING the very things that took you to the level you are today. T he SACRIFICES that changed your story must always be maintained if you don’t want to DIMINISH IN GLORY!
entries.key_scripture_text: ¶ But when he was STRONG, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

blocks.text: The greatest mistake you can make in your life is to STOP DOING the very things that took you to the level you are today. T he SACRIFICES that changed your story must always be maintained if you don’t want to DIMINISH IN GLORY!

When King Uzziah began his journey of leadership, he did a lot of right things and sought God under the Prophet Zechariah and because of that God prospered him. However, at the height of his prosperity and glory, he stopped doing all the right things that he was doing and he became proud. He finally lost his glory and experienced destruction - II Chronicles 26:4-5, 18 The exercises that brought you into power and glory must still be continued in order to maintain the power and glory. Whatever you did to get into a realm is what you must do in order to stay there and even go higher. No matter how far you go and no matter how high you reach, you must never forget where you came from. The higher you go in spiritual authority, the greater should be your spiritual exercises and sacrifices because it TAKES WIDTH to SUSTAIN HEIGHT. If you look at a triangle, the broader the base, the higher the triangle.
Anytime God brings you from the pit to the top; every time He brings you from the back to the front, never forget your history.
- Go back to your attitude of honour and humility
- Go back to fasting and prayers
- Go back to your lifestyle of deep praises and worship
- Go back to your lifestyle of meditating on God’s Word and the
reading of anointed books
- Start living a holy life again etc.
If you forget your ROOT, you automatically stop your FRUITS; if you forget your FOUNDATION, you will truncate your ELEVATION.

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to keep doing the right things in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never lose my throne of glory!

entries.title: How to Move to the Next Level
entries.summary: Everyone avoided going to take care of the flock of Jesse, except David. On that duty post, the anointing located him. King Saul, his soldiers and every Israelite avoided Goliath.
entries.key_scripture_text: The wicked run away when no one is chasing them, but the godly are as bold as lions.

blocks.text: Everyone avoided going to take care of the flock of Jesse, except David. On that duty post, the anointing located him. King Saul, his soldiers and every Israelite avoided Goliath. Nobody wanted to fight him but there was one person who RAN TOWARDS WHAT OTHERS RAN AWAY FROM. David courageously handled Goliath and that took him to HIS NEXT LEVEL!
Always learn to do the hard work that others avoid because you cannot make a difference until you are different!

You must always do more than what is really expected of you. Constantly think and look for extra ways to benefit others and to serve your organization because the best of life demands the best of you.
Your next level is at the mercy of your courage and boldness. Therefore, to function in timidity like others is to eventually end like them.

Everything you have ever wanted is on the other side of not giving up . You must therefore diligently utilize every opportunity in life to your advantage – Proverbs 10: 4 says, ‘He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, make me as bold as the lion in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never give up!

entries.title: Learn to Celebrate Others
entries.summary: King Saul instead of providing quality leadership for Israel vacated his throne and went into a chasing spree after an ordinary citizen of the land and a teenage shepherd called David.
entries.key_scripture_text: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before JEALOUSY?

blocks.text: King Saul instead of providing quality leadership for Israel vacated his throne and went into a chasing spree after an ordinary citizen of the land and a teenage shepherd called David. Since his throne became EMPTY, somebody else had to OCCUPY it and in his case, it was no other person than his perceived rival David. It is UNWISE, UNNECESSARY & UNGODLY to compare your success with those of others and at the end of the day become jealous - Proverbs 27:4 says, ‘Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before JEALOUSY?’
Jealousy is the CANCER OF THE SPIRIT, the JAUNDICE OF THE SOUL and the BREAKER OF THE BODY! In life, it is not just what you are eating but also WHAT IS EATING YOU UP!
Normal jealousy is a feeling that comes on in an instant, one which we can dismiss on our own.
Unhealthy jealousy happens when we indulge that feeling and engage in acts impulsively from a place of SUSPICION and INSECURITY

Jealousy is a breaker of focus. Instead of running your race and concentrating on your assignment, jealousy will cause you to waste your time trying to undo or outdo someone else. When you are jealous;
- You don’t celebrate anything except it is coming from
you; you always think the whole world should revolve around you. In jealousy there is more self-love than love.
- You are unwilling to accommodate and celebrate the
success as well as the victories of others
From today, learn to celebrate others and genuine appreciate what
others do because what you don’t admire, you can never attract.

entries.prayer: O Lord, eliminate the spirit of jealousy from my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always celebrate others!

entries.title: The Footprints of God
entries.summary: Several years ago, a great French scientist was crossing the Arabian desert under the influence of an Arab (Christian) tourist guide. Along the way, the sat down to take a rest and the guide started praying.
entries.key_scripture_text: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God...

blocks.text: Several years ago, a great French scientist was crossing the Arabian desert under the influence of an Arab (Christian) tourist guide. Along the way, the sat down to take a rest and the guide started praying. When he had finished, the scientist stood looking at him with scorn, and asked what he was doing. He replied, ‘I am praying’. The scientist said, ‘Praying! Praying to who? ‘To God’ replied the guide.

Then the scientist said, ‘Did you see God?’ Did you ever put out your hands and touch and feel God?’ The tourist guide answered ‘No’ to these two questions. Then you are a great fool to believe in a God you never saw, and a God you never put out your hand and touched! The Arab guide said nothing.

They finally retired for the night, rose early the next morning, and a little before sunrise, they went out from the tent. The French scientist said to his guide, ‘There was a camel round this tent last night.’ With a peculiar look in his eyes, the guide said, ‘Did you see the camel?’ ‘Did you hear the camel?’, ‘Did you put out your hand and touch the camel?’ The scientist also answered ‘No” to all these questions. ‘Well,’ said the guide, you are a strange man of science to believe in a camel you never heard, a camel you never put out your hand and touched.” Oh but the scientist said, ‘Here are his footprints all around the tent.’ Just then, the sun rising was rising in all its oriental splendour and with a graceful wave of his hand, the guide said, ‘BEHOLD THE FOOTPRINTS OF THE CREATOR, AND KNOW THAT THERE IS A GOD! “Clearly the untutored Arab had the best of the argument. EVERYWHERE IN THIS MAGNIFICENT UNIVERSE, WE SEE THE FOOTPRINTS OF THE CREATOR!

Man was created as a vessel to contain God. Without God, you are EMPTY! Embarking on the journey of life without God is an exercise in futility – John 15:5, ‘....He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.’ Never conclude in your heart or say with your mouth that there is no God – Psalm 14:1
The life of an orphan is very hard; like the prodigal son, RUN BACK TO YOUR FATHER (GOD) AND HE WILL RECEIVE YOU WITH HIS OPEN ARMS OF LOVE!

entries.prayer: O Lord, open my eyes to see my Saviour; I want to know Him more and more in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I will never forget my God!

entries.title: How to Be Fruitful in the Land of Suffering
entries.summary: I52 Joseph named his second son Ephraim, for he said, “God has made me fruitful in this land of my grief.”
entries.key_scripture_text: 51 Joseph named his older son Manasseh, for he said, “God has made me forget all my troubles and everyone in my father’s family.

blocks.text: I52 Joseph named his second son Ephraim, for he said, “God has made me fruitful in this land of my grief.”

t is one thing to experience significant suffering and to see with hindsight what God has done and how he has used it for good. It’s far more thrilling when we begin to allow God to use the suffering in our lives even while we are in the midst of it. God does not want to wait until everything is perfect in your life to begin to use you. He wants you to be fruitful right now even in the midst of your pain and suffering.

Joseph had many justifiable reasons to hold a grudge against his brothers; he loved them enough to send them food but they hated him enough to sell him as a slave to foreigners. He however decided to forget all their acts of wickedness against him. Joseph named his first son Manasseh meaning, I have forgotten and named his second son Ephraim which means fruitfulness – Gen. 41:51-52.

By this act, Joseph revealed the secret to being fruitful in the land of suffering – Forgetting the past. Unless you forget the past, you can never enter into the glorious future God has designed for you. You must be determined never to become a prisoner of your past; whether past failures or victories. You can simply not be driving on the highway of life and be looking back; you will have a fatal accident if you do that.
Always remember that before Ephraim (fruitfulness), there should be Manasseh (forgetfulness).

entries.prayer: O Lord, release my destiny from the prison of the past in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am fruitful in all I do!

entries.title: Learn to Do What Is Right Even When It Is Difficult
entries.summary: One of the greatest qualities you MUST possess as a person is the WILL TO DO WHAT IS RIGHT EVEN WHEN IT IS HARD AND DIFFICULT. Count on it, the day will come when ‘progress and success’ call for compromising your convictions and principles.
entries.key_scripture_text: Because of this, I always try to maintain a clear conscience before God and all people.

blocks.text: One of the greatest qualities you MUST possess as a person is the WILL TO DO WHAT IS RIGHT EVEN WHEN IT IS HARD AND DIFFICULT. Count on it, the day will come when ‘progress and success’ call for compromising your convictions and principles. The day will surely come when you will be tempted to break and bend the rules in return for a favour! In such moments, what hangs in the balance is your INNER STRENGTH & FORTITUDE!
Your accomplishments and fortunes may make your name known but your character will determine what people
associate with it.

For instance, when we mention the name of Joseph, the Bible character, you associate it with self-control and the fear of God. However, when we mention the name of another famous Bible character, Samson, you associate it to sexual immorality. Usually, once we are intoxicated by success, we start to believe that the rules don’t apply to us! We begin to think that the principles of the Bible no longer hold true in our lives.
Whoever you are, where ever you have gotten to
notwithstanding, it must become clear to all those around
you that progress, financial reward and progress are not
your gods; that you value something more, something you refuse to sacrifice on the altar of profit or popularity.

The fastest route to where you are today and where you will be tomorrow isn’t always the most honourable route! Develop clear and precise life principles based on God’s Word and decide to adhere to it even when it is difficult or unpleasant to do so – Acts 24:16
One wise man said; ‘BEFORE YOU SET YOUR GOALS, DETERMINE YOUR VALUES’!

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to always do what is right in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always do what is right even when it is difficult!

entries.title: The Value-System of Heaven
entries.summary: The measuring Scale of God is different from that of men because the values of God are completely different from those of men. The value-system of Heaven is different from that of men.
entries.key_scripture_text: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart” 2Co 10:7, “Do ye look on things after the outward appearance?

blocks.text: The measuring Scale of God is different from that of men because the values of God are completely different from those of men. The value-system of Heaven is different from that of men. Man judges the actions of others but God judges the motives behind those actions. God places premium on man’s heart than His act. As a matter of fact, the number one demand he places on man is for his heart. Proverbs 23:26 says, “My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways”.

Men commend us when they see our acts but God approves us when He sees our heart. Worldly values and priorities often clash with God’s Perspective. Luke 16:15 says, “What is highly esteemed among men is an abomination in the sight of God.” Our acts, no matter the number can never weigh as much as our heart before God. It is intention of heart that gives value to the extension of hands. The question is “Why did you do what you did and why are you doing what you are doing?” Is it for selfish reasons, the praise of men or fame?

David earned God’s approval not for His act but for his heart. I Sam. 13:14. God sees our hearts before he notices our acts (I Sam. 16:7, II Chron. 16:9). God weighs your heart to measure your part (Acts 8:21). God demands another heart to deliver your signs (I Sam. 10:9). God values services that come from genuine hearts than excellent acts (Col. 3:23). The state of your heart determines your place on earth. May God give you a right heart in Jesus Name! One day, when you stand before God, may you receive the Master’s well-done.

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a new heart in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I only seek the affirmation of Heaven!

entries.title: The Starting Point of Transformation
entries.summary: Every Samson who’s laid with a Delilah, every David who committed adultery with a Bathsheba and later betrayed his Uriah, every Judas who sold out his Jesus began his downfall with a THOUGHT.
entries.key_scripture_text: 21 For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders, 22 Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness: 23 All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

blocks.text: Every Samson who’s laid with a Delilah, every David who committed adultery with a Bathsheba and later betrayed his Uriah, every Judas who sold out his Jesus began his downfall with a THOUGHT. Your thought is the exact measure of your life; no one gets better than his or her THOUGHT LIFE - Proverbs 23:7 says, “...as he thinketh in his heart, so is he”

Purity is demonstrated in the heart’s most sacred thoughts –Mark 7:21-23. When an impure thought is not brought to captivity, it breeds evil imaginations, which breed carnal attitudes that make us vulnerable to temptation – II Cor. 10:5. Never expect to behave differently from the way you think. Your thoughts create a pattern for your character. Your thought is the seed of your life. Therefore, think right to live right.

One wise man said, ‘Sow a thought, reap an act; sow an act, reap a habit; sow a habit, reap a character; sow a character, reap a destiny. From today, decide to align your thoughts with GOD’S WORD! The RENEWAL OF YOUR MIND is the starting point of your TRANSFORMATION –
Romans 12:2 says, ‘And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.’

entries.prayer: O Lord, transform my mind by Your Spirit in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always think right!

entries.title: How to Achieve All Your Dreams
entries.summary: The Bible says in Daniel 11:32 that “... the people that do know their God shall be strong and do exploits”. It means that by our association with divinity, our abilities must take us to a realm of unending exploits.
entries.key_scripture_text: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.

blocks.text: The Bible says in Daniel 11:32 that “... the people that do know their God shall be strong and do exploits”. It means that by our association with divinity, our abilities must take us to a realm of unending exploits. Greatness must be our hallmark and trademark. However, what you must understand is that it takes a willing heart to produce a skillful hand. Willingness and performance are closely intertwined; you can’t separate one from the other. Our competence begins with our willingness. Willingness is the fountain of excellence and the source of all exploits. Success always awaits the willing hearted. That is why it is popularly said, “where there is a will’ there is a way.” A willing man is never clueless and stranded in the journey of life. A willing man can achieve all his dreams. This is because, his willingness can turn the better into sweet, shame to glory, breakdown into breakthroughs, obstacles into miracles and stopping stones into stepping stones”

Just anything is achievable by the hand of a willing man. Nehemiah was just a cup bearer but with a willingness of mind, he led a revolution that built the walls of Jerusalem in a record time of 52 days. It was not just Nehemiah who was willing, the virus of willingness spread like wildfire among the Jews and this accelerated the work greatly. Nehemiah 4:6 says, “So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.” It is true that you are destined for the top as a child of God but this must be coupled with your willingness to succeed. Ecclesiastes 9:10 says, “Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.”

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to do things with a willing heart in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I shall achieve all my dreams!

entries.title: Persevere No Matter What!
entries.summary: Most people fail in life not because they lack knowledge or talent but because they quit . When problems seem insurmountable, quitting may look like the easiest way out. It is true for every marriage, ministry, job and relationship.
entries.key_scripture_text: 1 ¶ Therefore we also, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which so easily ensnares us, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, 2 looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

blocks.text: Most people fail in life not because they lack knowledge or talent but because they quit . When problems seem insurmountable, quitting may look like the easiest way out. It is true for every marriage, ministry, job and relationship. The lack of persistence is the trait of losers. Life is a race and in the race of life we run with endurance. Even Jesus Christ had to endure the pains of the cross in order that He might obtain the joy that was set before Him (Hebrews 12:1-2).

The Apostle Paul was a man who run with endurance. In spite of all the challenges He faced in life, he still did not give up. In II Corinthians 4:8-9, he wrote, ‘8 ¶ We are hard pressed on every side, yet not crushed; we are perplexed, but not in despair; 9 persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed’

At the end of the journey of his life; the Apostle Paul emerged victorious in spite of all the odds he faced - In II Timothy 4:7-8, he said triumphantly ‘ I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.8 Finally, there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give to me on that Day, and not to me only but also to all who have loved His appearing.’
One man said, ‘A man is a hero not because he is braver than anyone else, but because he is brave for ten minutes longer’.

The Holy Spirit wants me to tell a Fresh Fire user today to hold on a little longer; never give up because you are at the edge of your miracle. Your night will be over soon; there is light waiting for you at the end of the tunnel. Run with endurance! Persevere no matter what!

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me the spirit of persistence in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: Giving up is not an option for me!

entries.title: How to Put a Smile on the Face of God
entries.summary: May the love of God that drove Christ to the cross now drive us to the lost. If soul-winning is not your priority then you are out of touch with Heaven.
entries.key_scripture_text: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, THESE THAT HAVE TURNED THE WORLD UPSIDE DOWN ARE COME HITHER ALSO “.

blocks.text: May the love of God that drove Christ to the cross now drive us to the lost. If soul-winning is not your priority then you are out of touch with Heaven. This is because what causes Heaven to jubilate and puts a smile on the face of God is when souls come to the glorious knowledge of the Gospel. God is looking for a generation of soul-winners who would rescue this generation of sinners from the greedy mouth of yawning hell. He wants people who will empty hell and fill Heaven; who will make hell sad and the devil mad but make Heaven glad. Every member of the Church must be an evangelism addict.

Consider Paul with a powerful anointing of the Holy Spirit upon him, he went out to ransack Asia Minor, preaching through its markets, stirring its synagogues, penetrating its palaces. Out he went, with the war cry of the Gospel in his heart and on his lips. This generation of Christians are too silent says the Lord. We talk about everything ranging from football, politics, Marriage issues, education, to recreation, but not the Gospel.

Our spirits are not stirred at all. Acts 17:16 says, “Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was STIRRED in him, when he saw the CITY WHOLLY GIVEN TO IDOLATRY” . Oh may your spirit be stirred as you are reading this material. May your spirit be stirred when you see your city and nation totally given to fornication, alcoholism, lesbianism, homosexuality, corruption, pornography, lies, etc.
Preach the word in season and out of season from today to bring a change your home school, Job, family and relationships. This is how we change the world!

entries.prayer: O Lord, make me an incurable soul-winner!
entries.confession: I am always on the move for God!

entries.title: The Biggest Problem of Every Person
entries.summary: When the 10 spies were saying it was not possible for the children of Israel to possess the promised land, Caleb said, ‘let us go up at once and possess the land, for we are well able to overcome it (Numbers 13:30)
entries.key_scripture_text: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

blocks.text: In life, you must speak right to live right; you must speak life to go up.

When the 10 spies were saying it was not possible for the children of Israel to possess the promised land, Caleb said, ‘let us go up at once and possess the land, for we are well able to overcome it (Numbers 13:30)
In life, never declare your condition but rather speak out your expectation
You were designed to have what you say and not to say what you have

Mr 11:23 For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
Your declarations are your prescriptions for God’s
manifestations in your life.

Numbers 14: 28 Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you: Your life turns in the direction of your tongue because your words are prophetic arrows into your future
I Peter 3:10 For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

A person’s biggest problem is not the problem itself but rather what they say about the problem. Therefore, speak the right words to create the right world around you; change your language to change your luggage in life!

entries.prayer: O Lord, touch my lips with your coals of fire in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: Everything is turning around for my good!

entries.title: The Creative Power of the Word
entries.summary: God’s Word has creative power and calls into existence the very thing of which it speaks. If you are sick, the Word can create your healing; if you are poor, the Word can bring into existence your victory.
entries.key_scripture_text: By the Word of the Lord were the heavens made; and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast”.

blocks.text: God’s Word has creative power and calls into existence the very thing of which it speaks. If you are sick, the Word can create your healing; if you are poor, the Word can bring into existence your victory.

The whole universe was created by the word of the Lord. He spoke the planets, the sun, the moon, the stars, plants, etc into existence. I love the way Psalm 33:9 put it, “FOR HE SPAKE, AND IT WAS DONE; HE COMMANDED AND IT STOOD FAST”.

Friend, is there anything missing in your life? If yes then I want to assure you that there is a creative power inherent in God’s Word. As you release God’s Word into your situation, there shall be a restoration. I don’t know what you are lacking but my God shall supply all your needs according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus. (Phil. 4:19)

entries.prayer: O Lord, do something new in my life today in Jesus Name.
entries.confession: God is doing new things in my life!

entries.title: The Accomplishing Power of the Word
entries.summary: Iwant you to develop a new approach to God’s Word. If you don’t change your negative approach to God’s Word, you will surely end as a reproach. The Bible says that God is not a man that He should lie (Numb. 3:19).
entries.key_scripture_text: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure. Calling a revenue bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far county: yea I HAVE PURPOSED IT, I WILL ALSO DO IT.

blocks.text: Iwant you to develop a new approach to God’s Word. If you don’t change your negative approach to God’s Word, you will surely end as a reproach. The Bible says that God is not a man that He should lie (Numb. 3:19). Again, the Bible says it is IMPOSSIBLE for God to lie (Heb. 6:18). God is therefore too faithful to fail.

In our world today, everything around us has failed. Governments have failed their nations, parents are failing children and vice- versa, the economic figures are not reflecting in the life of the ordinary person etc. That is why your faith and confidence must shift to God’s Word. When all else fail, the Word will always prevail.

God doesn’t make empty promises like some of our politicians do. His Word contains an accomplishment force. (Isaiah 55:10-11). In II Kings 4, there was famine in Samaria and the Word of the Lord came through Elisha that the economy of Samaria will experience an overnight turn around for the better. The right-hand man of the king doubted and missed all of God’s blessings. Those who believed saw the fulfilment of God’s Word in their lives.
May you never miss your blessings in Jesus Name

entries.prayer: O Lord, it is time for You to work in my life in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: God’s Word is working wonders in my life!

entries.title: God Can Handle It
entries.summary: In the realm of God, there is nothing which is impossible. What is beyond men is below God. Men can fail, but God will always prevail.
entries.key_scripture_text: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, with men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible”.

blocks.text: In the realm of God, there is nothing which is impossible. What is beyond men is below God. Men can fail, but God will always prevail. No matter the challenge you face in life, always declare, “God can handle it.” True faith does not look at the intensity/gravity of a problem, but the immensity of God’s power. Let’s look at some scriptures that changed my view about God’s dealings with men:
Matt. 28:18, “And Jesus came and spoke unto them, saying, ALL POWER is given unto me in heaven and in earth”.
Psalm 62:11, “God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this, that Power belonged unto God”.
Mark 10:27, “And Jesus looking upon them saith, with men it is impossible, but not with God, for with God, all things are POSSIBLE”.
Luke 1:37, “For with God nothing shall be IMPOSSIBLE”. Luke 18:27, “And he said, the things which are impossible with men are POSSIBLE with God”
Jer. 32:17, “Ah Lord God I behold, Thou has made the heavens and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm. And there is NOTHING TOO HARD FOR THEE?
Jer. 32:27, “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there ANYTHING TOO HARD for me?
Gen. 18:14, “Is there ANYTHING TOO HARD for the LORD?
Job 42:1-2, “Then Job answered the Lord and said, I know that thou CANST DO EVERYTHING...”

It can be clearly seen that your situation is not above God. I want you to meditate on and memorize these scriptures for 2023. Pray it out and confess it in the face of opposition and you rise above the storms of your life. If God can’t, then nobody can.

entries.prayer: Father, forgive me for ever doubting You. God of impossibilities, turn my life around in JESUS NAME!
entries.confession: I believe that my God can do all things!

entries.title: You Shall Experience a Change of Story
entries.summary: One of these days, you will wake up in the robes of a king in Jesus Name! What you must remember is that in every pain, there is a hidden gain. The challenges of life must never cause you to give up.
entries.key_scripture_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, see, I have set thee over all the Lord of Egypt”.

blocks.text: One of these days, you will wake up in the robes of a king in Jesus Name! What you must remember is that in every pain, there is a hidden gain. The challenges of life must never cause you to give up. Whenever you are down to nothing, God is surely up to something. In world today, most Christians are looking for slight things to backslide.

Look at the story of Joseph critically. Many Christians of today would easily backslide if they are to experience what this young man went through. Joseph was a dreamer. In fact, all the dreams pointed to one fact “that one day he will be a ruler and a great man”. However, what he went through did not look at it all. His own brothers conspired and sold him as a slave to the Israelites and he finally landed in Egypt. In Egypt, Potiphar’s wife again put him into trouble which landed him into prison. My God, how can a “future ruler” become a “present prisoner?”

You must know this in life, “your prison can be a blessing in disguise”. Do you know that testimonies are borne out of tests and without a battle there is no victory? One day in Gen.41, Pharaoh dreamt and no one could explain the dream. Only one man could give the interpretation and that man was a prisoner called Joseph. After Joseph interpreted the dream, Pharaoh was too enthused with his wisdom that he made him the next in command. Today, notwithstanding what you are going through, I see God taking you out of your prison into your palace. Maybe your story is bitter but your glory will be better!!!

entries.prayer: O Lord, do in my life and career, whatever good you did for Joseph, in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I shall surely experience my Greater glory!

entries.title: Stop Waiting, Wondering and Wishing
entries.summary: Most people have never learnt to take responsibility for their lives. When such people fail, they blame it on everyone apart from themselves. However, those who normally excel in the journey of life always take responsibility for their lives.
entries.key_scripture_text: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

blocks.text: Most people have never learnt to take responsibility for their lives. When such people fail, they blame it on everyone apart from themselves. However, those who normally excel in the journey of life always take responsibility for their lives. They know that what man can do, God will never do for them. Such people prepare, plan and take action rather than wait, wonder and wish to accomplish their goals in life.

A flood was threatening a small town and everyone was leaving for safe ground except for one man who said, “God will save me. I have faith.” As the water level rose, a jeep came to rescue him, the man refused, saying God will save me, I have faith.”. As the water level rose further, he went up to the second storey of his house, and a boat came to help him. Again he refused to go saying God will save me. I have faith. The water kept rising and the man climbed on to the roof. A helicopter came to rescue him, but he said, God will save me. I have faith. Well, finally he drowned. When he reached his Maker he angrily questioned, ‘I had complete faith in You. Why did you ignore my prayers and let me down?’ The Lord replied, “Who do you think sent you the jeep, the boat and the helicopter?”

Beloved, your faith must always be coupled with works. Faith is not just a fact but most importantly an act. James 2:20 says, ‘But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?’ When the prodigal son took steps, he landed in the welcoming arms of his father. As you also take steps from today, you will land in the arms of your miracle in Jesus Name!

entries.prayer: O Lord, help me to always act on my faith in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I am determined to take steps of faith!

entries.title: Overcoming Evil Decrees
entries.summary: As a Christian, you must never be ignorant of evil or demonic decrees. One of the major weapons the enemy uses to keep people in bondage is evil decrees.
entries.key_scripture_text: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.

blocks.text: As a Christian, you must never be ignorant of evil or demonic decrees. One of the major weapons the enemy uses to keep people in bondage is evil decrees. These evil decrees have caused many people to suffer failure, poverty, sickness, disease, untimely death etc. That is why David prayed a particular prayer unto God in Psalm 31:20, “Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.” The devil and his cohorts are found of making evil pronouncements in the demonic world to destroy the precious destiny of God’s people.

Evil decrees include curses – the greatest headache associated with a curse is that it goes to the roots of a person’s life. That is why when Jesus cursed the fig tree, it died from the roots. There are also incantations (an invitation of wicked demonic spirits to punish a person), Enchantments (by occultists and members of secret societies) and spells as well as demonic prophecies placed on people by herbalists, jujumen, mallams and false prophets.
In order to overcome these evil decrees, you have to do three things;
1. Reject it . I Samuel 2:1
Such evil decrees do not belong to you.
2. Reverse it. Isaiah 54:17
What you don’t want to remain, don’t watch, speak against it authoritatively.
3. Return it.
Revelations 13:10 says, “He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.”

entries.prayer: I fire back every demonic arrow back to the senders in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: No satanic arrow of the enemy will locate my destiny!

entries.title: The Road to Greatness
entries.summary: Performance in any duty or assignment is enhanced when you consider the task as a privilege. When you take any assignment for granted, you start failing at it. Every man is at his peak performance whenever it is seen as a privilege to serve.
entries.key_scripture_text: And Samuel said, when thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?

blocks.text: Performance in any duty or assignment is enhanced when you consider the task as a privilege. When you take any assignment for granted, you start failing at it. Every man is at his peak performance whenever it is seen as a privilege to serve. God always resist the proud but gives more grace to the humble. When King Saul was little in his own sight, God anointed him and made him king over all the tribes over Israel (I Sam. 15:17). However, when he became proud and disobedient, God dethroned him and he died like a man who was never anointed. II Sam. 1:21 says, “ Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.”

Don’t ever turn into a “big man” because “big men” cannot do small things and if you fail at doing small things you will never be assigned to anything bigger. You must remain small in your eyes to become qualified before God for greater task.

Moses assumed greatness before Pharaoh and in the land of Egypt because he resumed his task excitedly. The cup of greatness only fits well on the heads of servants. Remain a servant at heart to maintain your position on the throne. God does not anoint masters; He only anoints servants. Psalm 89:20 says, “I have found my servant David and with my holy oil have I anointed him”

entries.prayer: O Lord, give me a heart of a servant in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I always serve excitedly!

entries.title: The Mystery of Sacrifice
entries.summary: One of the greatest mysteries you must understand is the mystery of altars. An altar is a place where spirits meet; IT IS A PLACE OF SACRIFICE.
entries.key_scripture_text: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.

blocks.text: One of the greatest mysteries you must understand is the mystery of altars. An altar is a place where spirits meet; IT IS A PLACE OF SACRIFICE.

There are two kinds of altars; Divine altars (altars that Christians build in honour of God) and there are demonic altars (altars that the unbelievers build in honour of the devil). Life can be defined in simple terms as a battle between altars. This means that, if a Christian will lose in life, it will be because the altars of his enemies are stronger and greater than his.

You will realize that Abraham, one of the greatest fathers of faith always built altars for God. That is why he had a close relationship with God and became great in life. He knew that divine words need divine altars for them to be fulfilled. On the other hand, Lot was not accustomed to the building of altars unto God and suffered greatly for it.

Ge 12:7 says, ; And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him. Ge 13:18 also says, ‘Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.’

Never forget that there are demonic altars that are being built on a daily basis against our lives as children of God and we must do well to build counter divine altars. That is why as a Christian you must sacrifice your PERSON – Romans 12:1-2, your PRAYER – Col. 4:12, your PRAISE (Heb. 13:15) and your POSSESSIONS – Exodus 20:24 on a daily basis to God.

entries.prayer: O Lord, let my divine altars be stronger than those of my enemies in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I operate with a strong spirit of sacrifice!

entries.title: Check Who You Are Following
entries.summary: It is very surprising that most people pay attention to the quality of water they drink, the quality of food they eat, the quality of dress they wear, the quality of house they build and the quality of air they breathe BUT THEY RARELY PAY ATTENTION TO THE QUALITY & CALIBRE OF PEOPLE THEY FOLLOW!
entries.key_scripture_text: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

blocks.text: It is very surprising that most people pay attention to the quality of water they drink, the quality of food they eat, the quality of dress they wear, the quality of house they build and the quality of air they breathe BUT THEY RARELY PAY ATTENTION TO THE QUALITY & CALIBRE OF PEOPLE THEY FOLLOW!

In life, who you follow, will determine what will follow you. If you follow the wrong company, your life will attract only wrong things! Who you walk with determines what walks into your life or walks out of your life!
The kind of people you follow can either lead to your speedy destruction or continuous preservation.

The doom of Samson was sponsored by his association with Delilah and the premature death of Amnon was due to his connection with Jonadab. On the other hand, King David was constantly saved from death through his friendship with Jonathan. Your companions will direct your opinions; your company will determine your accomplishment and your association will determine your manifestations.
1Co 15:33 says, ‘Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.’

Popularity is not equal to relevance; it is an exemplary life-style that makes a person relevant enough for you to follow him or her. Therefore, before you call somebody a role model, the person must be a good example to you in all things. Worldly people should never be your role models! -II Cor. 6:18

Follow those who uphold godliness and spirituality and not those who are given to worldliness, profanity and insanity. - 1Ti 6:11 But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
Always remember that, Eagles don’t flock with turkeys.

entries.prayer: O Lord, empower me to always follow the right people in Jesus Name!
entries.confession: I only follow the right people!
